chapters.title: Chapter 851: The Fountain of Youth is Soul
paragraphs: In such a vast and boundless territory.
Could Little Mountain Sea swallow it whole?!
Ding Ling accelerated back to the Valley of Eternal Spring.
Passing by the Eight Trigrams Demon-Slaying Sword Array again, Ding Ling could clearly perceive the appearance and form of the Eight Immortals this time.
They were saluting Ding Ling.
“Thank you, young friend, for relieving our worries!”
“Hahaha, the Yangtze River’s new waves push the old ones. Unexpectedly, among the younger generation, a genius like young friend has emerged!”

“Young friend’s Divine Skill and Sword Skill are truly rare, a nemesis to the Void Nether Soul Zombie. We observed from afar and were filled with admiration. With such a remarkable guardian as young friend in this realm, we have no regrets. Hahaha, we are off!”
The voice fell.

In the reflection of Ding Ling’s Divine Meditation Technique, he saw the shapes of the Eight Immortals begin to transform into light, fleeing into the depths of the void, disappearing in mere moments.
“Where did they go?”
Ding Ling asked.
“Their obsessions have dissipated. Naturally, they have gone where they belong. As for where exactly they should go? I don’t know either.”
Little Mountain Sea seemed confused too.
“Were they strong in the Ancient Era?”
‘From the information left by my mother, very strong. They probably reached the War Immortal realm my big brother mentioned.’
“War Immortal?”
Ding Ling nodded:
“So, they perished together with the extraordinarily powerful Void Nether Soul Zombie?”
“That’s about right.”
Ding Ling felt relieved.
When Divine Mountain Sea was alive, she had the Immortal Gods of the Celestial Court assisting in battle. When she died, all the Immortal Gods perished.
The Void Nether Soul Zombie World died but seemed to still possess ‘spirituality.’
It could still tempt and enslave others.
It could still breed batch after batch of young Void Nether Soul Zombies; alive, the newly bred young Void Nether Soul Zombies would inevitably be stronger!
Fortunately, the Void Nether Soul Zombie World died.
The so-called adult Void Nether Soul Zombie had limited cultivation achievements, otherwise, Ding Ling might not be able to kill the Void Nether Soul Zombie.
Of course, it was because Little Mountain Sea sensed Ding Ling could kill the Void Nether Soul Zombie that she agreed to follow him to kill them.
In terms of understanding the Void Nether Soul Zombie, no one surpasses Little Mountain Sea!
Whoosh!

Ding Ling took a step forward, approached the Immortal Tree, and placed the little tree in front of it. The Immortal Tree dropped a branch, binding the little tree, and with a pull, embedded it into its trunk.
In the next moment.
Boom!
The Immortal Tree erupted with a mighty energy, which fell upon Ding Ling.
Ding Ling’s True Qi was refined!

The True Qi produced by the rapid devouring and refining of the Spiritual Vitality of the Void Nether Soul Zombie was refined over and over again until it became purer, and when practically no impurities remained, a massive Life Energy was born within the True Qi.
This energy surged powerfully toward Ding Ling’s limbs, bones, organs, and viscera.
In an instant.
Ding Ling’s vitality, endurance, and recovery received immense growth.
“My longevity increased by a full forty thousand years in one breath?!”
Ding Ling’s heart and spirit trembled.
This time, the increase in longevity is quite intense!
It also indicates how much World Qi the sapling refined!
Woo woo!
The entire body of the Immortal Tree emitted shimmering light, and in a sudden contraction, it absorbed the Fountain of Youth, Stone Monument, and other substances.
Not only that.
The ground and sky of the entire Valley of Eternal Spring seemed to be consumed by the Immortal Tree.
“Big brother, I’ll send you out!”
Before the voice fell.
A tunnel appeared out of nowhere in front of Ding Ling.
Ding Ling felt confused.
Little Mountain Sea explained:
“I’m going to transform now. The Valley of Eternal Spring, Celestial Court, all these places will become part of my shell. So, big brother, you need to leave first.”
Ding Ling was astonished:
“Aren’t you transforming into the Immortal Tree?”
“The Immortal Tree and Fountain of Youth can only be considered my soul and spirit.”
Upon hearing this, Ding Ling grew increasingly shaken.
He completely did not expect this outcome.
However, this incidentally seems to prove a point: that Divine Mountain Sea probably perished together with the Void Nether Soul Zombie World.
The unparalleled Celestial Maiden who planted the sapling and erected the Stone Monument before might have only been the soul and spirit of Divine Mountain Sea?!
The truth is unknown.
Ding Ling was also unclear.
Because his cultivation compared to Divine Mountain Sea and the Void Nether Soul Zombie World was still too weak.
So, he could not determine whether Divine Mountain Sea’s soul and spirit had been completely annihilated?
At least, from Little Mountain Sea’s mouth, one conclusion could be drawn: it seems Divine Mountain Sea is not dead? She is still hoping for Divine Mountain Sea’s reappearance?!
Ding Ling, filled with uncertainty, walked through the tunnel.
Swipe!
In an instant, Ding Ling was transported into the Wuliang Mountain Range, landing beside Zhong Ling and Li Canghai.
“Husband (Your Majesty)!”
Heavenly Mountain Granny, Mu Wanqing, and the Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, Chrysanthemum group saw Ding Ling, their eyes brightened, and they called out.
Ding Ling nodded, looking towards the previous mysterious tunnel.
At this moment.
He could still sense the aura of the Carefree Ten Extremes Array.
But soon.
The aura of the Ten Extremes Array disappeared.
Clearly.

The Ten Extremes Array had also been consumed by Little Mountain Sea, serving as nutrients for transformation? Or perhaps, as mentioned before, the Ten Extremes Array was merely part of Little Mountain Sea’s shell?

“The sapling and Fountain of Youth planted by Divine Mountain Sea turned out to be the soul and spirit of Little Mountain Sea. Indeed, among all things in the world, the spirit is the most important; with spirit, transformation is possible! Without spirit, however mighty and boundless, it is just a dead object.”
“It seems I am about to witness the birth of a Mountain and Sea Realm?”
Ding Ling pondered as he watched ahead, eyes bright.
Li Canghai, Heavenly Mountain Granny, and the Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling were extremely puzzled and couldn’t help but ask:
“We don’t know what Husband (Your Majesty) saw in the Valley of Eternal Spring?”
Regarding the occurrences related to Little Mountain Sea, Ding Ling could not explain in detail.
He only briefly mentioned the matters concerning the Void Nether Soul Zombie.
Even so.
It made Li Canghai, Heavenly Mountain Granny, and their group shiver.
If the Void Nether Soul Zombie is truly as sinister and terrifying as Ding Ling said, then any one crossing into the Jiuzhou Territory would lead to devastation and suffering!
Since no one can restrain them!
Perhaps only the Martial Dao True Understanding combined with Immortal Level skills could defeat the Void Nether Soul Zombie tribes!
If it were others, even with higher cultivation, without a method to restrain them, it’s hopeless.
Therefore.
Li Canghai, Heavenly Mountain Granny, and their group understood it, elevating their admiration, recognition, and respect for Ding Ling even further.
“Fortunately, Your Majesty took action; otherwise, if the floods of the Abyss truly spread to the outside world, and the Void Nether Soul Zombie emerged, our world would be finished.”
“Indeed. Your Majesty’s contributions are immeasurable. Having Your Majesty in this world is truly a blessing, and the people are fortunate to be protected by Your Majesty!”
Li Canghai and Heavenly Mountain Granny were not usually adept at praising.
But at this moment, they praised Ding Ling to the fullest, indicative of how turbulently their minds were stirred.

chapters.title: Chapter 852: Little Mountain Sea Takes Form
paragraphs: Ding Ling didn’t mention the matter of Master Xiaoyao to Heavenly Mountain Granny and Li Canghai.
Dust returns to dust, earth returns to earth.
Master Xiaoyao’s death should not taint the grand image he holds in their hearts, leaving them with cherished memories.
Perhaps, at the time of his death, Master Xiaoyao also wished for this.
Whoosh!
A sudden gust of wind appeared in the vicinity of this Earth Realm.
Ding Ling sensed it attentively and seemed to hear the cheers of Little Mountain Sea from within:
“Yay, I’m going to transform!”
He looked towards Heavenly Mountain Granny and the others.
They were unaware. Obviously, they couldn’t hear the voice of Little Mountain Sea.
“I wonder if they will be able to see her after Little Mountain Sea transforms?”
They should be able to see her.
After all, she’ll have a physical form!
Just as he was thinking this, the space in front of him suddenly wrinkled!
Bam! Then the space shattered like a mirror, and a little girl emerged from within.
The girl looked no more than two years old, with short arms and legs, exquisitely carved like jade, and big, bright eyes that made one like her instantly.
She wore green clothes, with a head of green hair. Except for her hands, feet, and face, she was lily-white, and looked like an elf walked out of the forest.
Upon landing, she looked directly at Ding Ling and grinned:
“Big brother.”
“Little Mountain Sea?”
Ding Ling was moved.
“Yes, big brother. I’ve transformed.”
Little Mountain Sea hopped and skipped in front of Ding Ling, tilting her head to look up at him:
“Big brother, give me your hand.”
Ding Ling was puzzled, but he bent down slightly and extended his hand.
Little Mountain Sea also reached out her tender little hand and pointed her index finger towards Ding Ling’s index finger.
In the next instant.
They both involuntarily shivered.
In the dark night.
Ding Ling felt he had formed some mysterious connection with Little Mountain Sea, sensing her location and also her inner physical condition.
“This feeling?!”
“It’s a contract.”
Little Mountain Sea hopped around excitedly:
“I’ve signed a contract with big brother. From now on, I, Little Mountain Sea, am your person.”
Ding Ling was bewildered and astonished. A contract? That’s it? Why does it seem somewhat frivolous?
Little Mountain Sea seemed to know what Ding Ling was thinking and cheerfully explained:

“This is an inherent ability of mine. As long as I acknowledge a person, a contract can be bound in the moment of index finger contact. Big brother, rest assured. This contract has only benefits, no downsides for you.”
Ding Ling said:
“I’m not worried, just puzzled. You, you’ve devoured that Void Nether Soul Zombie so quickly?”
“No.”
Little Mountain Sea shook her head:
“But I can continuously devour its form. This way, I can grow stronger every moment. As I grow, I can give feedback to big brother in time.”
“Feedback?”
Ding Ling recalled Little Mountain Sea’s previous feedbacks.
“Yes. After signing the contract, no matter where big brother is, you can receive my feedback remotely.”
“I see.”
Ding Ling understood, moved:
“You’re giving me such a precious contract opportunity?”
The more he sensed the contract.
The more Ding Ling realized the rarity of this, most likely, a lifelong contract with one person!
“Big brother is the best person I’ve met. Who else would I give it to?”
Little Mountain Sea said without hesitation:
“Big brother. Let’s not talk about this. Now that I’ve transformed for the first time and come to the human world, can you take me to see this world?”
Her face was full of eager curiosity, causing Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, Chrysanthemum, Li Canghai, and Heavenly Mountain Granny to look at each other.
Plum, Orchid, Bamboo, Chrysanthemum couldn’t help but speak directly:
“Husband, this Little Mountain Sea, she is...”
“She is a god.”
Divine Mountain Sea is definitely a god.
Little Mountain Sea is a descendant of Divine Mountain Sea, so naturally, she is also a god.
The truth of the dragon giving birth to a dragon, phoenix giving birth to a phoenix has been unchanged since ancient times.
“God?!”
The group with Heavenly Mountain Granny was astonished, their desire to explore Little Mountain Sea became increasingly strong and intense.
Ding Ling then briefly explained the situation of Little Mountain Sea.
Of course, some details weren’t shared.
The deeds of Divine Mountain Sea, Ding Ling also didn’t mention.

Little Mountain Sea stood next to Ding Ling, clutching his pant leg, her half body leaning on Ding Ling’s leg, tilting her head, watching Heavenly Mountain Granny and others curiously with her big, bright eyes, without speaking.
“Let’s go.”
Having said that, Ding Ling picked up Little Mountain Sea, waved his hand, and the golden sword suddenly enlarged as Ding Ling stepped into the Half-Step Primordial Spirit Realm.
The power of his Celestial Escape Swordsmanship unleashed became increasingly powerful.
The golden sword could instantly enlarge to the size of three doors, enough to hold more than ten people.
Heavenly Mountain Granny and others watched, impressed and awed, knowing that Ding Ling’s strength had surely increased once again.
“Unbelievable, how short a time?! It seems His Majesty has indeed encountered some fortuitous events in the Valley of Eternal Spring.”
What kind of fortuitous event was it?
Ding Ling didn’t say.

They naturally didn’t dare to ask further, only watching Ding Ling and Little Mountain Sea, along with the Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling, chatting and laughing, Li Canghai and Heavenly Mountain Granny exchanged glances, speechless, yet for the first time felt like outsiders.
The thoughts they had buried in their hearts earlier resurfaced.
But soon, they blushed and decisively extinguished those thoughts.
Only because those thoughts were really inappropriate in both emotion and reason!
Time passed like water.
In the blink of an eye, a month had passed.
The Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling had all advanced to the Shattered Realm!
Ding Ling then considered leaving this world.
Before leaving, Ding Ling gave the plaque of the South Celestial Sect to Little Mountain Sea.
This plaque was an important treasure of the Celestial Court, enhancing Little Mountain Sea’s power.
And Ding Ling could not refine this plaque, holding it was useless, so naturally, he chose to return it to its rightful owner.
Perhaps due to the contract signed with Little Mountain Sea, or maybe because she was by his side.
Originally thought it would take at least half a year, even a year, to help the Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling break through to the Shattered Realm.
Unexpectedly, the goal was achieved within a month.
Ding Ling was initially puzzled.
Later, after careful exploration, he had an epiphany.
It turned out that the cultivation barrier in the region within a five hundred meter radius of Little Mountain Sea had been elevated to the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit Realm!
That is to say.
As long as one stays by Little Mountain Sea’s side, they can smoothly cultivate all the way to Martial Arts Primordial Spirit!

Because of this, Ding Ling was delighted, sharing this discovery with the Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling, Li Canghai, and Heavenly Mountain Granny, allowing them to take care of Little Mountain Sea while staying beside her, thus it would be more beneficial to break barriers and reach a higher cultivation realm.
Not only that.

As Little Mountain Sea continued to devour and refine the world shell of the Void Nether Soul Zombie, her aura grew increasingly strong, and not only did this range keep expanding, the Spiritual Vitality in her domain was also becoming more and more rich.
The closer you get to her.
The denser the Spiritual Vitality, and the higher the quality and level!

chapters.title: Chapter 853: The Celestial Court on the Immortal Platform
paragraphs: Ding Ling also received two feedbacks as a result.
His longevity increased by another thirty thousand years.
Now, his lifespan had reached a terrifying one hundred and ten thousand years!
Not only that.
His True Qi was also tempered twice, becoming increasingly refined, resilient, and sharp!
In terms of strength, it had doubled.
The attack power of Ding Ling could be easily imagined!
“Sure enough, the benefits after signing the contract are great.”
Ding Ling sighed with emotion.
As he continually interacted with the Little Mountain Sea, Ding Ling once used his Sword Thought to explore the inner Dantian of the Little Mountain Sea.
Sure enough, he saw within it an Everlasting Valley that had expanded by at least a hundredfold!
In the position above this Everlasting Valley, a Rainbow Bridge was hanging!
Moreover, a Celestial Ladder connected the Rainbow Bridge, reaching straight into the clouds.
And the end of this Celestial Ladder was located in the position of the head of the Little Mountain Sea.
An Immortal Platform had formed atop her head!
On the Immortal Platform, a Celestial Court was cast!
This Celestial Court was almost identical to the one Ding Ling had seen before, with crumbling walls and ruins everywhere.
But there were also differences; the chasm, miasma, and floods were gone!
Moreover, this Celestial Court kept expanding day by day.
Witnessing such strange changes, Ding Ling couldn’t help but be amazed.
He gained a clearer understanding of the so-called Mountain and Sea Realm.
“So this is how the so-called Mountain and Sea Realm was formed!!”
The Dantian is the Human Realm.
The meridians serve as bridges.
The head Sea of Consciousness gives birth to the Immortal Platform!
And this is just the initial state.
As the vast Earth Realm of the Void Nether Soul Zombie is continuously devoured, the Human Realm and Celestial Court will grow increasingly vast until they one day become two enormous worlds!
Thinking of that time, the Little Mountain Sea would truly become the Divine Mountain Sea!
“No wonder the Everlasting Valley’s situation is completely different from the Celestial Dragon Plane; they seem like two worlds because they were originally different worlds!”
The Little Mountain Sea is likely the offspring born from the essence left after the fall of the Divine Mountain Sea.
It is a point of spirit born from the ruins and debris.
Such is the Divine Mountain Sea.

The Void Nether Soul Zombie World seems to be the same, and judging by the situation, the spirit born from the Void Nether Soul Zombie World is stronger than the Little Mountain Sea, but Ding Ling came, and he sided with the Little Mountain Sea, allowing it to win this ‘world war between the descendants of the Divine Mountain Sea and the Void Nether Soul Zombie!’
Such world wars are cruel.
The victorious party can devour the defeated side’s world remnants to continuously strengthen itself!
“This method of cultivation is so strange and powerful.”
Ding Ling also asked the Little Mountain Sea about her cultivation technique.
She couldn’t specifically describe it either; she just somehow knew this cultivation method, but when it came to stating the specifics, she knew what it was but not why, unable to explain it.
To put it more vividly.

It’s like how a person knows how to walk, and just like being born with eyes, nose, hands, and feet, but asking why one has them instead of something else? Or how to specifically form a nose and limbs?
Many people would be quite puzzled.
This is the case with the Little Mountain Sea; for her, her transformation should be this way!
“No wonder the Mountain and Sea Realm has only nine entities!”
Ding Ling suddenly understood.
Compared to the human understanding of why we have a nose and limbs.
Why can worlds condense within the body of the Mountain and Sea Realm, and why spirits can be nurtured, is thousands of times more complex!
To understand it? How difficult it is.
If not so, the Mountain and Sea Realm in the Upper Realm wouldn’t just be a simple nine entities, but many more, after all, this method is too strong.
Just like the Little Mountain Sea.
She may seem ordinary, without True Power or cultivation, but any punch or kick from her is like two worlds exerting force!
The power is unimaginable.
To kill her.
One must destroy from within, thoroughly demolishing the world inside her body; only when her world is destroyed, her form would begin to perish, leading to her downfall.

Ding Ling knew these things naturally because he signed a contract with the Little Mountain Sea, resulting in an immensely close connection, an ordinary person could never know her details or how to kill her.
Ding Ling decided to leave the Celestial Dragon Plane.

Before leaving, he spent a intimate moment with the Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling and instructed them to stay by the Little Mountain Sea’s side to cultivate, and only ascend when they reached the absolute bottleneck with their Martial Dao True Understanding.
The Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling naturally heeded Ding Ling’s words.
The next day.
The Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling, Xiaoo Feng, and others came to see Ding Ling off.
The Little Mountain Sea looked at Ding Ling with watery eyes full of reluctance:
“Big brother, when can we meet again?”
“When you finish refining the Void Nether Soul Zombie, and Zhong Ling and the others cultivate to the Extreme Realm, perhaps you can bring them to ascend together and find me.”
After speaking a few words to the Little Mountain Sea, Ding Ling smiled at Xiaoo Feng and them, then with a single stride, he disappeared from the spot.
“Your Majesty just left like that.”
Xiaoo Feng felt a sense of loss.
Although Ding Ling had been in the Lower Realm for several months.
It felt like he left in the blink of an eye.

“Indeed. Perhaps His Majesty came to the Lower Realm to resolve the troublesome situation in the Everlasting Valley? Now that the calamity has been resolved, it is naturally time for His Majesty to leave.”
Xiaoo Yuanshan spoke with admiration:

“Feng’er, you should listen to His Majesty, and quickly complete the abdication. Move to Chang’an, stay by the Little Mountain Sea’s side, and cultivate the Martial Dao True Understanding diligently. Once our strength improves, we can go to the Upper Realm with the Empress and the Queen together.”
Ding Ling stood before the Gate of Glory.
This time he watched the three great paths inside the gate: World’s Number One, The Legend of Great Tang Double Dragons, Fengyun!
There was a strong feeling.
He could freely choose one of the planes.
“Is it really possible?”
Ding Ling carefully sensed, then realized this strong feeling came from the Little Mountain Sea.
After contracting with the Little Mountain Sea.
He not only received feedback from the Little Mountain Sea.
He also had a certain link with her instinct for Divine Techniques!
Since the Little Mountain Sea is a descendant of the Divine Mountain Sea, she can freely enter and exit the Upper Realm and can freely choose the Plane Worlds Ding Ling has visited.
This is a peculiar sense in the void, and also a way to locate Ding Ling’s aura.
As long as it’s a world Ding Ling has been to.
The Little Mountain Sea can lock onto it.
“I see.”
Once Ding Ling understood, he stepped into the Gate of Glory and chose the Wind and Cloud Plane.
The next moment.
A torrent swept him to the Heaven-Reaching Dao of the Wind and Cloud Plane.
“It indeed works.”
Ding Ling was both surprised and delighted.
“It seems from now on, in the Plane Worlds I’ve been to, I can freely locate them. This can indeed save a lot of chances to go to the Lower Realm.”

As Ding Ling was thinking this, his vision darkened, and before long, it brightened again. Instinctively operating his Divine Meditation Technique, he instantly reflected the surroundings for over a hundred miles, allowing him to see the situation of this Earth Realm clearly.

chapters.title: Chapter 854: The Smiling, Proud Wanderer
paragraphs: Ding Ling’s Divine Meditation Technique.
In The Deer and the Cauldron World, it can reflect a radius of a thousand miles, Dragon Gate Flying Armor is five hundred miles.
Celestial Dragon Eight Books is two hundred miles.
Valley of Eternal Spring can only reflect a radius of one hundred miles.
Logically, this Wind and Cloud World should be even less.
But Ding Ling’s cultivation has improved a lot, causing his Divine Meditation Technique in the Wind and Cloud Plane to reflect over a hundred miles, nearly two hundred miles!
Thus, as soon as he made a thought.
He knew clearly now which realm he was in.
“Lake Heart Pavilion of the World Association?”
“Unexpectedly landed here. I wonder who’s managing this realm now?”
As Ding Ling was pondering this, a person walked out from the garden. She was graceful and enchanting, exceptionally beautiful—it was none other than Xiong Ba’s daughter, Youruo.
Upon seeing Ding Ling, she was clearly taken aback. Confirming she wasn’t hallucinating, she hurriedly knelt on the ground and performed a great ceremonious bow to Ding Ling:
“Greetings, My Emperor, may you live forever!”
“Rise.”
Ding Ling waved his hand, a gust of vigorous energy swept over, lifting Youruo up:
“Why are you here? Where’s Nie Feng?”
“Nie Feng?”
Youruo’s expression turned melancholic:
‘He’s with Mingyue.’

Ding Ling stopped talking, Youruo openly admired Nie Feng, but it seems the unrequited love was to no avail, and Nie Feng finally ended up with Mingyue. He comforted her with a couple of casual words, then took a step forward and vanished from the World Association.
“Your Majesty...”
Youruo was stunned:
“Won’t you stay for a while? I was about to offer Your Majesty a pot of tea I brewed?”
She sighed.
Turning around, she stepped back into Lake Heart Pavilion, her silhouette looked somewhat lonely, desolate.
Ding Ling’s comfort only aggravated her feelings.
Yet matters of emotion cannot be forced for success.
After Ding Ling returned to Luoyang, he reunited with the delighted Little Zhao for several days.
Then he prepared to head to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.
This time, he could not bring the Sword Pill to the Lower Realm. He temporarily entrusted it to Little Zhao, asking her to take care of it.
Meanwhile.
He also took out the previous Green Pearl, using the technique of Celestial Escape Swordsmanship to refine the Green Pearl, as expected, this Green Pearl was also a Sword Pill!
But it was not the poisonous sword Ding Ling imagined.
Instead, it was a Divine Sword corroded by poisonous gas.

Ding Ling, immune to all poisons with an exceptionally strong Martial Dao True Understanding, could refine the toxic gas for himself, thus he directly purified the poison, restoring the Divine Sword to a dazzling green, crystal-clear state.
Clang clang!
This Divine Sword was also an incredibly spirited sword, although not as splendid as the Gold Sword, it was on par with the Red Sword.
Ding Ling granted this Sword Pill to Little Zhao.

Little Zhao now had the Emperor’s Sword for protection, theoretically sufficient, but the fifty-fold amplification of the Emperor’s Sword had a limit, whereas the Sword Pill, even in Martial Arts Primordial Spirit Realm or Martial Arts Dharma Phase Realm, could unleash extraordinary power, which the Emperor’s Sword could not match.
Afterwards.
In Little Zhao’s reluctant affection, Ding Ling chose to return to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer in the Imperial Palace’s back garden.
[Player Ding Ling, do you wish to return to The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World now?]
[Note 1: Only one chance to travel back and forth. Time is unlimited. And you can only bring one set of clothes to the Lower Realm.]
[Note 2: Choose a fixed location for the travel. The location to and fro in the world is fixed, no longer random.]
Yes!
[Choice confirmed. Location fixed. Portal opened.]
Kong!
A portal formed by condensed golden light appeared out of nowhere.
Ding Ling stepped into it.
The familiar dizziness came.
But much better than last time, evidently the improvement of cultivation greatly benefited Ding Ling.
Da da!
Ding Ling landed on the ground, looking around, indeed, this place was also in Luoyang’s Imperial Palace location.
Ding Ling didn’t want to entangle with this world’s dynasty, upon seeing someone approaching, he used Void Stepping, covering hundreds of miles in an instant, vanishing without a trace.
Leaving the princesses who sensed a disturbance in awe, momentarily suspecting they were seeing things.
“I think I just saw an Immortal, so handsome!”
“I saw it too!!”
Ding Ling soon arrived at Huashan Peak.
Divine Meditation Technique reflected the Ten Directions Realm.
In an instant, a 3D map of over a thousand miles of the realm manifested minutely in the Sea of Consciousness.
Ding Ling saw many things he shouldn’t have seen, his face slightly flushed, then chose to automatically block these scenes, instead looked towards Huashan’s location.
Sure enough.
He saw Zhang Hex, Taishi Ci, Qu Feiyan, and others diligently cultivating.
Counting.
It’s been six years since he last saw Qu Feiyan and them.
During this time, their cultivation had advanced considerably, but still hadn’t reached this world’s maximum value.
Clearly indicative of the world’s impoverished Spiritual Vitality and Primordial Qi.
An ancient saying; shallow waters cannot nurture true dragons!
A world too poor cannot nurture true supreme masters!
Whoosh!
Ding Ling instantly appeared in the cave at Reflection Cliff.
Qu Feiyan and her group should regularly be here secluded in practice.
Ding Ling’s arrival did not disturb them.

Except Lin Pingzhi, whose skills were relatively shallow, seemingly lacking diligence, or having just finished meditating, he was looking ahead with open eyes, and at that glance, he happened to see Ding Ling.
Initially thinking it was an illusion, after rubbing his eyes and confirming it was real, he couldn’t help but joyfully leap up, shouting:
“Master!”
“Hmm?!”
Zhang Hex and the others quickly opened their eyes, indeed it was Ding Ling, all were shaken, delighted beyond words.
In unison, they knelt to greet Ding Ling, calling him Great Emperor.
Clearly understanding Ding Ling’s current status.
Undoubtedly.
Though they diligently practiced day and night, under the deliberate flattery of players, their understanding of Ding Ling was evidently profound.
Compared to The Deer and the Cauldron, Green Blood Sword these worlds, the number of players in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer is significantly more.
Especially in Huashan Realm.
The player count is even higher.
These players often traded Ding Ling’s information with Qu Feiyan, Zhang Hex, Taishi Ci in exchange for Zhang Hex’s Kung Fu, guidance, teachings!
This method was very effective.

To Qu Feiyan, Ding Ling was her everything, her first action upon awakening each day was to inquire about Ding Ling’s news from players. Hearing about Ding Ling was the happiest thing in the world for her.
She naturally knew about Ding Ling’s numerous deeds in recent years.

Especially upon learning that Ding Ling became the Immortal Realm Emperor in the Lower Realm, aiding Diao Chan and others in becoming Deities, becoming undying was immensely exciting, admiring, and worshiping.
Thus, she managed to suppress the eager heart to see Ding Ling, remained at The Smiling, Proud Wanderer waiting for Ding Ling.
If not for this.
Ding Ling wouldn’t have met Qu Feiyan and them.
“Brother Ding!”
Upon really seeing Ding Ling, Qu Feiyan instantly forgot all the simulated scenarios in her mind, with reddened eyes, she wanted to rush towards him.

chapters.title: Chapter 855: Qu Feiyan and Fan Kuai
paragraphs: But when Qu Feiyan actually ran up to Ding Ling, she felt a bit shy and didn’t dare approach.
She had simulated and rehearsed this day, this moment, countless times in her mind.
But in the actual experience, her mind went blank, and she was completely at a loss!
It was just because Ding Ling appeared so suddenly. Amidst excitement and joy, she had no mental preparation.

All she thought about was, ‘How do I look today?’ ‘Do I look very haggard?’ ‘Will Brother Ding recognize me?’ ‘Will Brother Ding treat me the same as he did six years ago?’ ‘Will Brother Ding like me?’ ‘How will Brother Ding view me later?’ ‘Brother Ding... Brother Ding...’
Her mind over the years was filled with her Brother Ding.
So when they met, amidst excitement and happiness, she was bewildered, uneasy, and didn’t know what to do.
Seeing Qu Feiyan standing still in front of him without knowing what to do, Ding Ling also sighed deeply in his heart.
Six years without seeing Qu Feiyan, and now seeing her again, she has transformed from a young girl into a grown woman!
Her figure is even more graceful than before.
Her appearance has transformed as if into a Celestial Immortal.
Compared to her past charming and lively demeanor, the current Qu Feiyan has gained a few more degrees of poise, beauty, and composure.
Her natural beauty, fitting into the painting at every angle, surpasses even Ren Yingying by three points.
At this moment, her helpless and bewildered appearance evokes tender affection.
Looking at her, Ding Ling smiled, “What? Aren’t you going to give me a hug?”
“Brother Ding.”
Qu Feiyan was overjoyed and rushed over without further hesitation, throwing herself into Ding Ling’s arms.
She hugged Ding Ling tightly, as if afraid that if she let go, Ding Ling would run away.
She had red eyes and tears streaming down.
But these were tears of joy.
Her Brother Ding recognized her and was willing to embrace her.
This was the best news for her!

In that moment of embracing Ding Ling, she felt like she was holding the entire world, and the feeling of happiness in her heart surged to her head instantly, and she felt her whole being had sublimed and refined!
Who is Ding Ling?
He can see through Qu Feiyan’s feelings at a glance. After all, Qu Feiyan makes no attempt to hide anything from Ding Ling, how could Ding Ling not see through?
He comforted her with a few words, and as she came out of his embrace blushing, Zhang Hex, Taishi Ci, Huang Zhonggong, Fan Kuai, and others all showed knowing and kind smiles.
Seeing this made Qu Feiyan’s face even hotter, she couldn’t help but cover her face, standing behind Ding Ling.
Six years ago, Qu Feiyan was still a young girl, lively, witty, eloquent, and naturally gifted with a smart mind.

Six years later, although she remained wise and clever, she was no longer as lively as before. It’s probably the six years of cultivation and seclusion that have tempered her heart and made it much more stable.
“This time, I came down from the lower realm to teach you some Cultivation Techniques.”
Ding Ling glanced around:
“Where is Senior Feng Qingyang?”
“Feng Qingyang has gone south to Yangzhou. I’m afraid it will take a while before he returns.”
“For what reason?”
“I heard Linghu Chong got into trouble, and he went to clean up the mess for Linghu Chong.”
Fan Kuai actively chimed in:

“When Linghu Chong was on Huashan, although unruly, he was considered candid and straightforward. Since he went down the mountain and mixed with various drifters, he’s become even more reckless. But he acts on his instincts, bold and unrestrained, and ordinary people cannot persuade him, nor make him change his ways. Later, he and the Great Emperor had some conflicts, and from then on, he raced down the wrong path, never to return...”
Ding Ling listened carefully for a while and nodded. As for Linghu Chong, he had no particular thoughts or opinions; whether Linghu Chong lived or died was of no concern to him.
He hadn’t realized Linghu Chong’s resentment towards him was so severe; perhaps he inadvertently hurt Linghu Chong’s pride?
Whatever the case, Ding Ling didn’t bother to dwell on it. He asked everyone to sit down and then went over one by one to empower them.
Empowering and transmitting skills was something Ding Ling had become quite proficient at.
Moreover, given his current cultivation power, True Qi Quality, and level are not what they used to be, making the transmission of skills faster.
In almost a breath, he broke through one person’s Eight Meridians, then injected a stream of True Qi, allowing them to smoothly enter the Innate Realm, reaching the Extreme Realm of this world.
Zhang Hex, Taishi Ci, Huang Zhonggong, Qu Feiyan, and others all successively reached the Extreme Realm of this world.
“This, this...”
Zhang Hex, Taishi Ci, and others could not believe it.
To reach the Extreme Realm of this world so easily!
It felt like a dream!
Although they had heard many of Ding Ling’s mythical stories, actually experiencing it themselves still left them shocked beyond Binary System comprehension!
A thousand waves surged in each person’s Heart Lake, unable to calm down for quite some time.
Fan Kuai was especially so!
He guarded Qu Feiyan on the Reflection Cliff for over six years!
He gambled that Ding Ling, being loyal and committed, would not abandon Qu Feiyan and would return to see her!
And now!
He was right to gamble!
Ding Ling even passed to him Divine Skills and Secret Techniques, along with a stream of powerful True Qi.
With such assistance, he saved years of hard work, ascending to the peak in an instant!
“Indeed, as the Alien said, as long as you cling to the Great Emperor Ding Ling’s leg, you can soar to the sky! Leap through the Dragon Gate!”
Fan Kuai was excited, ecstatic!
It was worth all those years of diligently guarding beside Qu Feiyan!
This time, he struck gold!
There is no greater opportunity in life than this!
“Thank you, Great Emperor!”
Zhang Hex, Taishi Ci, and others were extremely moved, bowing in gratitude.
This gift was too big!
They felt even more strongly that they must loyally follow Ding Ling in the future and protect Ding Ling’s wife well! Only then could they be worthy of Ding Ling’s cultivation!
“Brother Ding.”
Qu Feiyan looked at Ding Ling with almond eyes like water, with pride and honor almost bursting out of her eyes!
Ding Ling’s return.
Gave her such a huge surprise and honor! Who else in the world could treat her so kindly?
In the following days.
Ding Ling guided Qu Feiyan and the others in cultivating Martial Dao True Understanding.
During this time, Yue Buqun and Ning Zhongze received the news, both coming to Reflection Cliff to greet Ding Ling with faces full of excitement and joy.
Knowing that the couple had taken good care of Qu Feiyan, Ding Ling gave them a Divine Skill Secret Manual as well.
What he gave was the Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique!
When cultivated to the extreme, this technique can reach the Shattered Realm and can prolong life, living for hundreds of years with no problem.

After Yue Buqun and Ning Zhongze studied the Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique, they were incredibly moved and enlightened to the greatness of this Cultivation Technique, comparing it with the Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique, Purple Mist Divine Skill seemed like trash!
They once regarded Purple Mist Divine Skill as a treasure of the mountain, now it seems like a joke!
It’s like a beggar with a broken bowl facing an emperor who possesses a Gold Mountain! Completely incomparable.
“No wonder he is the Immortal Realm Emperor!”
Yue Buqun and Ning Zhongze sighed and envied deeply.
Ding Ling casually gave out a technique that left them disoriented.

chapters.title: Chapter 856: Marriage
paragraphs: From this, it can be seen that Ding Ling’s cultivation is now profound, and his divine skills are unfathomable, surely reaching a level they can only hope to attain.
Yue Buqun and his wife are sensible people. After receiving Ding Ling’s gift, they became increasingly enthusiastic towards Ding Ling’s group, offering the utmost courtesy.
Yue Lingshan was also called back from abroad just so she could serve tea to Ding Ling.
Meeting Ding Ling again after years.
Yue Lingshan’s behavior, however, became more reserved.
She was already married, yet when she looked at Ding Ling, she still felt he was so radiant that he was hard to gaze upon.
She knew that she and he belonged to two different worlds.
This time meeting him again further proved that point; she even dared not look directly into Ding Ling’s eyes.
Thinking about the first time she met Ding Ling several years ago, her wariness towards him made her find herself back then ridiculous and naive.
Looking back, most of her past was unbearable.
Precisely because of this, Yue Lingshan felt uncomfortable everywhere in Ding Ling’s presence, and every extra moment spent with Ding Ling added to her pressure!
Ding Ling’s aura, profound and boundless, his demeanor extraordinary and supreme, made her feel inferior.
Ding Ling noticed it and told her she didn’t need to serve him; with Qu Feiyan around, he didn’t need anyone else to take care of him.
Qu Feiyan, listening beside them, understood and wildly nodded her head, smiling as she said:
“That’s right, that’s right. Miss Yue, we appreciate your kindness. You can go back.”
“Yes.”
Yue Lingshan sighed with relief and felt a bit ashamed, instinctively glancing at Qu Feiyan.
She saw Qu Feiyan looking at Ding Ling with a face full of admiration.
Her heart stirred, and she impulsively asked:
“I wonder when you two will tie the knot? I will definitely send my blessings then.”
Swoosh!
Qu Feiyan’s face turned as red as fire, extending to the base of her ears.
But she did not evade; instead, she summoning courage, her eyes shining brightly, looked at Ding Ling with anticipation written all over her face.
Seeing this, Ding Ling said:
“There is no better time than now, let’s do it tomorrow. Keep it simple.”
He looked at Qu Feiyan:
“Feiyan, what do you think?”
“I’ll follow Brother Ding’s decision.”
Qu Feiyan’s heart melted, and her whole body almost collapsed into Ding Ling’s embrace.
Her eyes were a bit moist, yet she was extremely excited and happy!
Waiting for this day.
How many years had she waited?
The dawn had finally arrived!
She cast grateful eyes towards Yue Lingshan.

Yue Lingshan actually regretted it after speaking, but seeing the two in front of her like this, she was stunned, especially Qu Feiyan’s grateful look made her realize she had inadvertently revealed Qu Feiyan and Ding Ling’s current vague relationship, allowing them to further develop.
Her heart was also delighted.
To receive importance from Qu Feiyan!
Was it tantamount to catching hold of Ding Ling, the real dragon’s tail, after all? Could she, Yue Lingshan, soar into the sky?
But thinking she was already married, she couldn’t help but sigh inwardly.
She had married an official who only knew how to serve the country and the people.
The two had met by chance and, after several hardships, knowing and loving each other, had come this far. She couldn’t leave her husband to go to the Upper Realm.
Thinking of this, she smiled and said:
“In that case, I have to offer blessings to the Great Emperor and Miss Qu. I’ll go tell my parents so they can arrange things for you two.”
“The simpler, the better, there’s no need to make it known worldwide.”
Ding Ling advised.
His ‘wedding’ with Diao Chan, Cai Wenji, and others was also very simple.
He’ll strive to treat everyone equally!
“Yes, Great Emperor.”
Ding Ling and Qu Feiyan got married.
This marriage.
The two naturally no longer lived on Reflection Cliff but stayed in a Huashan guest room, starting the secret techniques that only a married couple could cultivate.
Given Ding Ling’s ability to shatter the void, with cultivation several times stronger than two years ago.
Coupled with True Qi being tempered several times by Little Mountain Sea, it had become indestructible while possessing extremely strong restorative and vitality power.
Therefore, when he and Qu Feiyan cultivated divine skills and secret techniques, the progress was extremely fast.
In less than half a month.
Qu Feiyan broke through to the Grandmaster Peak realm level!
After another month, Qu Feiyan successfully broke into the Shattered Realm.
Previously, the Seven Ladies of Zhong Ling also took a month to break into the Shattered Realm.
And now Qu Feiyan alone did the same.
And the reason for this.
Naturally, because the Little Mountain Sea was not by their side, Ding Ling had to spend time and effort to break the world’s shackles.
If the Little Mountain Sea were around, there would be no need to break this shackle, they could smoothly cultivate to the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit Realm!
And having reached this point.
Ding Ling was preparing to leave The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World.
Before leaving, he reminded Qu Feiyan to stay beside the Little Mountain Sea if she ever arrived at the Celestial Dragon Plane, and ascend to the Upper Realm together.
Qu Feiyan was very reluctant about this.
To her.
These nearly two months were the happiest times of her life.
Now Ding Ling was about to leave, naturally, she didn’t want him to go, but she knew he had more long-term goals, so even though she was reluctant, she could only say:
“Don’t worry, Brother Ding, I’ll listen to you. I’ll pray for you from the Lower Realm!”
Before leaving.
Ding Ling went to Yangzhou.

He found Feng Qingyang and imparted the Fundamental Technique of Martial Dao True Understanding 1.0 version to Feng Qingyang, considering it a repayment for the favor of teaching and enlightening him back then.
Feng Qingyang was extremely moved and ashamed:
“Alas. At the time, you passed seven barriers before I transmitted my skills to you. Now I receive your generous assistance, feeling undeserving!”
He solemnly declared:
“In the future, wherever Feng Qingyang can be of help, I will spare no effort!”
Although he knew Ding Ling needed his help was near to impossible.
Feng Qingyang still decided to make a statement and decided to ensure his future words and actions were consistent!
He had to repay Ding Ling’s kindness.
“You’re too polite, senior.”
Ding Ling smiled, discussing Dao with Feng Qingyang for half a day, then bid farewell; before leaving, Ding Ling saw Linghu Chong who just opened the door to enter.
His mental state had improved quite a lot compared to before.
Clearly, Feng Qingyang hadn’t truly given up on this disciple, his guidance and persuasion were somewhat effective.
Ding Ling felt indifferent towards Linghu Chong, merely glanced at him, then lifted his legs and left.
He arrived, invisible and traceless.
Left, also without a trace.
No one could perceive it at all.
Feng Qingyang looked on, amazed and dazzled:
“Just a mere six years have passed. Who would have thought Ding Ling had already advanced to such a ghostly and divine Realm of Creation, truly too powerful!”
He stood up, his passion also reignited:
“It seems I must leave this world too. Always complacent, and I’m failing Ding Ling for passing on his skills!”
“Master-uncle, are you leaving?”
Linghu Chong was stunned.
“Yes.”
Feng Qingyang stroked his beard and sighed:
“Linghu Chong, I’ve taught you all I can. I hope you can work hard to always walk on the righteous path of the Dao!”

chapters.title: Chapter 857: The Statue of Guanyin Through Yilin's Eyes
paragraphs: Feng Qingyang finished speaking, and without waiting for Linghu Chong to reply, he used his Lightweight Skill and floated away.
“Martial Uncle Ancestor!”
Linghu Chong chased after him for a few steps, but the more he chased, the further the distance became. He stood there dejectedly, looked up to the sky, and murmured:
“Could it be that Ding Ling is truly my nemesis?”
If Ding Ling didn’t come, he got along well with Feng Qingyang.
But as soon as Ding Ling arrived, Feng Qingyang left him!
“Ding Ling!”
Linghu Chong gritted his teeth, feeling both envy and more than that, resentment towards Ding Ling!
Before Ding Ling appeared, he was the favored one in the eyes of many, but after Ding Ling appeared, everything changed.
Not only had his circumstances changed, but even the friends he valued were slaughtered by Ding Ling’s followers!
He initially planned to achieve great cultivation.
And then go settle the score with Zhang Hex and the others.
But now, it seemed he might never have that chance.
Ding Ling’s power was already suffocating him to the point where he almost couldn’t breathe!
Just a glance from Ding Ling made him feel as if he was being targeted by Celestial Punishment, almost causing his knees to buckle!
The intimidation of Ding Ling, the profundity of his cultivation, the unfathomable nature of his Divine Techniques, were all evident!
“The gap is growing wider and wider. Could it be that what the Alien said is true.”
Thinking about the Alien’s description of Ding Ling.
And recalling Ding Ling’s Lightweight Skill, disappearing in an instant.
Linghu Chong felt even more dejected and disheartened:
“Perhaps in this lifetime, I can never catch up to Ding Ling! No!”
Thinking of Ren Yingying, thinking of his little junior sister.
Linghu Chong gathered his spirits:
“Since I can’t find an opportunity in the Lower Realm, I’ll go to the Upper Realm! One day, I, Linghu Chong, will stand openly and proudly before Ding Ling and challenge him!!”
Ding Ling, with a few strides.
Appeared at the end of the Celestial Ladder.
In The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, his only concern was Qu Feiyan.

Thus, even though there were many acquaintances in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer, even when he passed through the territory of Heng Mountain, he once again saw that elegant and rare beauty, the serene and dignified nun, Yilin.
Although more than six years had passed, time did not leave marks on Yilin’s face, only adding a bit more grace and tranquility, making her seem more Buddha-like.
Ding Ling glanced at her and then left.

And what he didn’t know was, just from that one glance, Yilin seemed to have sensed something, stopped her hand ringing the wooden fish, raised her delicate head slightly, and looked toward the direction of the sky:
“Is it an illusion? Why does it seem like I saw Hero Ding?”
“Silly child.”
Nun Dingyi sighed deeply:
“If you really want to see Hero Ding. Why don’t you go to Huashan now?”
Yilin hesitated, subconsciously glancing at the Statue of Guanyin, in her eyes, it shone brightly, with many Swastika Patterns pressing towards her forehead.
Each additional Swastika Pattern on her body.
Would increase the Buddha-like aura she emanates.
This situation had persisted for over a year.
And throughout Heng Mountain, besides her, no one else could see these Swastika Patterns or sense the changes in the Statue of Guanyin.
She told Nun Dingyi about this.
But Nun Dingyi did not believe her.
She could only bear the pressure and transformation brought by the Swastika Patterns entering her body, alone.
She believed this was the blessed message, the Buddhist Fate from Guanyin, so she passively accepted it.
But just now, Ding Ling’s presence, which she sensed, briefly stirred up waves in her Heart Lake, unsettling her Buddha Heart.
“There’s nothing but. You should go.”
“Yes. Master.”
Yilin listened carefully to Nun Dingyi’s advice, put down the Wooden Fish Hammer, stood up, finally bowed deeply to the Statue of Guanyin, then turned and left.
“Yilin, if you meet Hero Ding, give him my regards.”
“Alright, Master.”
Ding Ling stood before the Gate of Glory, gazing at the three great paths within: Romantic Swordsman, Dragon Gate Flying Armor, Divine Condor.
This time, he once again felt exactly the same as the previous time.
He could freely choose a great path that he had traversed before.
“It seems I can.”
Ding Ling sighed with relief, he previously thought this ability came from Little Mountain Sea, and could only be realized in the Plane World of Little Mountain Sea.
As it turns out.
This ability had already manifested in him.
The opportunity to descend to the Lower Realm in the future can be saved considerably.

Ding Ling was delighted, stepping forward, thinking about going to the Divine Condor Plane, and sure enough, in the next instant, a light swept over, carrying him to the path of the Divine Condor Plane.
“Great.”
Ding Ling allowed this force to carry him into the Dimensional World Layer, and in just a moment, his vision brightened, arriving at a valley.
He glanced around.

With verdant fields, flowers dotted amongst them, and mist pervading the Ten Directions Realm, complemented by birds occasionally flying by, and young maidens flitting through the flowers, this area seemed like a human wondrous Immortal Realm, extraordinarily beautiful.
“Valley of Heartless?”
Ding Ling recognized this place at a glance.
He saw Gongsun Lu’e.
She was leading a group of young maidens picking flowers, seemingly just finished, and as she slightly raised her head to look in Ding Ling’s direction, she locked eyes with him.
“Prince, Prince, Prince?!”
Gongsun Lu’e couldn’t believe her eyes, she wiped her eyes, but when she looked again, where could she see Ding Ling’s figure?
“An illusion?”
Gongsun Lu’e sighed, her flower-picking actions slowed down, and she seemed somewhat uninterested.
“Valley Master, I seemed to have just seen the Prince.”
A charming young maiden exclaimed:
“He disappeared in the blink of an eye. Oh my! The Prince truly is like what the Alien said, he has become a deity!”
“Yes, I saw him too.”
Listening to the chatter around her.
Gongsun Lu’e’s heart began to race:
“So it wasn’t an illusion just now?!”
“The Prince has descended?! And his first stop wasn’t to see his Queen, but to come to me, what does he intend?”
Ding Ling didn’t want any entanglements with Gongsun Lu’e and the others, so he vanished from their sight in an instant.
Since Gongsun Lu’e chose this secluded, peaceful life.
Ding Ling decided not to disturb them anymore.
So, he chose to step out of the Valley of Heartless.
Just as he landed.
Ding Ling saw an old man in tattered clothes, walking on his hands upside down, yet swift as a galloping horse.
He was rapidly heading towards Ding Ling, shouting:
“Hahaha, I am the world’s number one, what Ding Ling, what Immortal Realm Emperor, they are all no match, I am the world’s number one...”
“Ouyang Feng?”
Seeing the man’s appearance.
Hearing what he said.
Ding Ling immediately knew who he was.
Previously in the Divine Eagle World, Ding Ling didn’t have much interaction with Ouyang Feng.
Unexpectedly, on this descent.
He met Ouyang Feng outside the Valley of Heartless.
Clearly, he was still mad and hadn’t been cured.

“Martial Uncle Ancestor!”

chapters.title: Chapter 858 847: Divine Condor Lovers
paragraphs: Ding Ling couldn't bring himself to repay Ouyang Feng's harm with kindness, forgiving the injury he caused Little Dragon Girl.
If not for Yang Guo's pleas and keeping face.
Ouyang Feng would have been ordered to be killed by him a few years ago.
Therefore, seeing Ouyang Feng rushing toward him, Ding Ling didn't hold back and slapped him directly.
Smack!

The White Rainbow Palm Force struck Ouyang Feng's face, causing him to spit blood and be sent flying tens of meters away. Bang! He fell heavily to the ground, his entire being seemed to awaken from a state of madness, looking at Ding Ling with complete disbelief:
"Such strong palm power, who are you?!"
Ding Ling didn't pay attention to him, but instead said calmly:
"If it happens again, I'll kill you!"
When his words fell.
Ding Ling disappeared like a wisp of breeze in an instant.
Even though Ouyang Feng stared wide-eyed, he couldn't see how Ding Ling had vanished!
Ding Ling seemed to have disappeared into thin air!
"Such speed, such Lightweight Body Technique?! So strong, who is he? Could it be..."
Ouyang Feng recalled the descriptions of Ding Ling's appearance by the aliens and Yang Guo and others, his heart trembling:
"Was that person Ding Ling just now?!"
"That world's number one, unparalleled, the Ding Ling even the old beggar admires wholeheartedly?!"
He took a deep breath, and the murkiness in his eyes seemed to dissipate a lot:
"Comparing to him, what do I matter?"
He became despondent, discouraged, unwilling, and then invigorated, eventually succumbing to madness, unable to stop roaring:
"I don't accept it! I'm the world's number one! Ding Ling, I must defeat you!"
In an instant, Ding Ling traveled hundreds of miles.
A few steps brought him to the outskirts of the Imperial City.
He watched the bustling crowd at the city gate.
Seeing the smiles on every face, he knew that the governance of Guo Jing and Huang Rong had taken effect.
Ding Ling felt quite relieved.
At least as of now, the emperors he chose were excellent candidates.
From Cao Mengde, Guo Jing, to Xiao Feng, Little Zhao, they were all excellent choices.
Under their governance, the nation's power was rising, an undisputed fact!
But just at that moment.
"Hyah!
Accompanied by loud shouts.
Two strong horses galloped past Ding Ling on the avenue beside him.

These two men were striking in appearance, handsome and fitting, but had gloomy expressions, seemingly in a terribly bad mood, galloping on horseback, their whips snapping the air with crackling sounds, seeming to warn the common folk to clear the way quickly.
The City Gate Officer holding a telescope saw these two men approaching from afar and immediately shouted:
"Clear the way, make a path for the Military Generals to pass through quickly!"
The common folk immediately separated, allowing the two Military Generals to pass through quickly.
"Wu Xiwen, Wu Dunru. Haven't seen them in years. These two brothers have greatly enhanced their cultivation. And it seems their temper has grown too."
Ding Ling was surprised:
"At the entrance to the Imperial City, in broad daylight, these two dare to act so arrogantly, their status must have significantly improved over the years."
Ding Ling shook his head.
He had no fondness for these brothers.
They were the typical people with little skill but high aspirations.
When Ding Ling first went to the Guo Mansion, he had conflicts with them, and if not for considering Guo Jing and Huang Rong at that time, the brothers would likely have been killed.
Meeting again.
The two brothers were acting the same way, making Ding Ling have even less favorable impressions of them.
"Forget it. Avoiding troubles is better."
Ding Ling was not someone who liked to meddle in other people's affairs.
As long as the Wu brothers didn't hinder him, he didn't want to bother.
His only concern in this Divine Eagle World was Little Dragon Girl.
He came to the Divine Eagle World this time for Little Dragon Girl. The life and death, safety and danger of others, he doesn't truly care.
Of course, Yang Guo, Hong Qi, Huang the Herbalist, among others, were exceptions.
These people were connected to him through family ties.
Ding Ling wasn't a heartless person, so of course, he couldn't ignore their life and death.
Whiz!
Ding Ling wanted to avoid further troubles, so he chose not to go through the city gate but instead stepped out and vanished instantly, causing the nearby pedestrians to exclaim in surprise.
At that moment, some of them also realized that Ding Ling might be the rumored Prince!
"Didn't expect the Prince to descend to the lower realm!"

"Indeed. We often hear aliens talk about the Prince's stories, but we never believe it to be true. But just seeing the Prince's speed, it seems the aliens' words are true. The Prince has indeed reached a level unfathomable by us mere mortals!"
Earlier, Ding Ling stood by the roadside.
Although his aura was extraordinary, standing out from the crowd, the natives had seen plenty of similarly graceful Ascenders, so they weren't surprised.
In the Divine Eagle World, it's common to see a group of exceptionally powerful and transcendent Ascenders appear occasionally.
Anyone would grow numb seeing it continuously for years!
This was the reason Ding Ling stood by the roadside without attracting the natives' attention.
Of course, this was also because there were no players on the roadside just then, otherwise, things wouldn't be so simple.
Outside the Imperial City in the Divine Eagle World, players had almost disappeared, offering a glimpse that more players had moved to higher realms to develop further.
Whoosh!
As a gentle breeze passed.
Ding Ling appeared within the Prince's Mansion.
His Divine Meditation Technique illuminated the surroundings, instantly locking onto the backyard of the Mansion and then arriving there, seeing Little Dragon Girl.
Not seen for a few years.
Little Dragon Girl remained as graceful as a fairy, dazzlingly beautiful!
But compared to before.
She had become much slimmer, and her back carried an additional trace of cold and solitary aura.
Ding Ling felt a sense of pity and couldn't help but sigh.

Little Dragon Girl, keen in hearing and sight, seemed to sense something, her body trembled, her apricot eyes widened in an instant, instinctively turning swiftly to look, and once she saw, her eyes could not move away.
'Ding, Ding, Ding Ling?!'
She couldn't believe that the person she longed for was actually there.
She doubted it was a hallucination.
Because in the past few years.
She had similar dreams.
Each time the dream shattered, she would fall into melancholy, feeling lost and sad for a long time.
So upon seeing Ding Ling again this time.
She even dared not close her eyes, fearing that once closed, the dream would shatter, and she would no longer see Ding Ling.
"It is me."
Ding Ling, using his Observing People Skill, knew what Little Dragon Girl thought.
Because Little Dragon Girl never hid anything from him, always opening her heart to him.
Because of this clarity, Ding Ling's heart was stirred with emotion.
Little Dragon Girl was too pure.
It seemed she really remained in the palace's backyard without ever going out, just quietly waiting for him.
Ding Ling was moved, he approached her and embraced her:
"You have not seen wrong, it is me."
He placed her hand upon his face:
"Can you feel my warmth?"

chapters.title: Chapter 859: Yelv Yan
paragraphs: “Can you touch my face?”
“It’s me. I am your husband, Ding Ling.”
Ding Ling spoke softly a few words.
Little Dragon Girl was already in tears, tightly holding onto Ding Ling, as if letting go would cause him to fly away like a kite.
The person she thought about day and night truly arrived.
So real.
Little Dragon Girl felt her heart leap with joy.
Even the air she breathed became as sweet as honey.
A stream of happiness welled up from deep within her heart, flowing to every part of her body, filling her with a warmth and joy.
The two stayed together for several hours.
In that time, they shared all manners of sweet words between husband and wife.
Even the usually reticent Little Dragon Girl found herself telling Ding Ling many heartfelt things.
These were her innermost feelings.
She had never mentioned them to anyone, but once she spoke to Ding Ling, it was like a dam breaking.
Ding Ling listened with a constant smile, occasionally chiming in with warm, reassuring words.
This made Little Dragon Girl even happier.
Yet Ding Ling had not forgotten his mission from the Lower Realm.
When their conversation reached a certain point.
Ding Ling prepared to perform a rite on Little Dragon Girl, and just then.
A slender, tall, charming woman burst into the garden of the Prince’s Mansion, shouting loudly:
“Queen, something’s wrong, something’s wrong!”
“Hmm?”
Ding Ling frowned.
Little Dragon Girl gently smoothed the frown on Ding Ling’s forehead and said softly:
“Husband, the person who came is probably Guo’Er’s fiancée, Yelv Yan. Her urgency must mean something is wrong, let’s go and see.”
After the two had spent several hours together.
Little Dragon Girl’s way of addressing Ding Ling also changed.
Naturally, Ding Ling followed her lead, took her hand, and with a step, they moved to the rear garden, where he looked at the charming and tall woman, calling out:
“Yelv Yan?”
Yelv Yan’s brows flew upward, exuding a heroic spirit.
Though not absolutely stunning, she was far superior to ordinary women.
Regarding Yelv Yan, it was Ding Ling’s first time seeing her, but he knew she was the daughter of a Mongolian official, Yelv Chucai, and sister to Yelv Qi.
And Yelv Qi was a disciple of Old Playful Zhou Botong, and originally, following the plot, Yelv Qi would marry Guo Fu and become the Beggar Gang Leader.
But the storyline of the Divine Eagle World had completely crumbled years ago.
The fates of Yelv Yan, Yelv Qi, and others were thus entirely altered and transformed.

Now, meeting Yelv Yan again in this Imperial City was quite a surprise for Ding Ling, as he thought the siblings had gone to develop in other regions, never expecting they’d end up related to Yang Guo and the others after all.
Yelv Yan actually had a marital bond with Yang Guo?!
This was something Ding Ling did not expect.
“Who are you?!”
Yelv Yan was startled upon hearing the voice and turned to look, only to be stunned.
To her eyes.
The Little Dragon Girl, usually as cold and ethereal as Immortal Chang’e from the Celestial Palace, was now leaning happily and fondly on a man’s shoulder!!
She was thunderstruck, her pupils dilated, and she was completely at a loss!
It was as if a fan saw their aloof idol suddenly become a comedic star, the contrast was so eye-catching!
Now, this was how Yelv Yan viewed Little Dragon Girl.
“He is my husband.”
Little Dragon Girl said softly:
“Yelv Yan, speak clearly if something’s wrong. What happened? Why the rush?”
“Yes, yes, I came for something urgent.”

Yelv Yan regained her composure, glanced in surprise and astonishment at Ding Ling, wondering if he was the Queen’s husband? Could he be the legendary world’s number one, the First-Rank Prince of Great Ming, the reigning Grand General, the World’s Number One War God?!
Ding Ling the Hero, known as the Martial Arts Myth?!
Yelv Yan was incredibly amazed; she never expected to meet this mythical character today, truly a rare fortune!
But then she thought of Yang Guo, suppressing the tumultuous waves in her heart, she quickly said:

“Greetings, Prince, Queen. Yang Guo is surrounded by the troops led by the Wu Brothers at the Vice Minister of the Ministry of War’s Mansion. He’s in great danger, and if he isn’t rescued in time, something terrible might happen!”
“Oh?”
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow, the Divine Meditation Technique instantly reflecting the Ten Directions Realm.
In a flash, the 3D map of the area spanning hundreds of miles instantly mirrored clearly in Ding Ling’s Sea of Consciousness.
Ding Ling activated the Sword Spirit’s Spiritual Eye and Heaven-Reaching Ear.
Soon, he locked onto the Vice Minister’s Mansion.
He saw no fewer than ten thousand soldiers heavily surrounding the mansion.
Wu Xiwen spurred his horse, breaking into the Vice Minister’s Mansion, shouting loudly:
“Yang Guo, I’m giving you one last chance, if you’re sensible, treat Sister Fu well! Otherwise, don’t blame me for being unkind!”
“What do you intend?”
Years without seeing Yang Guo.
He had grown even more dashing and spirited, unafraid despite being surrounded, his eyes blazing as he gazed at Wu Xiwen:
“Under the Emperor’s eyes, you mobilize troops to surround the Vice Minister’s Mansion on your own, are you planning a rebellion?!”
“Hmph!”
Wu Xiwen hadn’t spoken yet when Wu Dunru snorted angrily, pointing his whip at Yang Guo, chastising him:
“Yang Guo, you’ve been greedy beyond reason, truly deserving death. Today, even if Your Majesty and the Queen were here, you’d still deserve a beating to quell our anger!”
He waved his hand:
“Go! Catch him for me!”
Whoosh!
A group of soldiers surged forward.
Leading them was none other than Xiaang Wentian, whom Ding Ling knew!
He wielded a Great Guan Saber, charging forward, and upon reaching Yang Guo, he swung his saber toward Yang Guo’s shoulder, clearly not intending to harm Yang Guo’s life:
“Brother Yang, heed my advice, surrender!”
Clang!
Yang Guo quickly drew his sword, blocking Xiaang Wentian’s mighty blow, his body trembling slightly, he retreated two steps, then with a swift move, landed on a flower bed, shouting loudly:
“Wu Dunru, Wu Xiwen, you dare to really use weapons, you must have enormous courage!”
“Go, catch him!”
Wu Xiwen pointed at Yang Guo:
“Catch him and beat him first, then we’ll talk about other matters!”
Ding Ling, seeing this.
Roughly understood the situation, and casually said to Yelv Yan:
“Don’t worry, Yang Guo will be fine. I’m just curious. Why did the Wu Brothers suddenly take action against Yang Guo?”
“It’s all because of me.”
Yelv Yan felt relieved knowing Yang Guo was safe, but upon considering Ding Ling’s question, she couldn’t help but blush slightly, a bit shyly saying:

“Although Guo Fu and Yang Guo were engaged, they never married. And during their interactions, irreconcilable conflicts often arose. Then four years ago, by chance, I met Yang Guo, and we came to know and love each other.”
“Indeed.”

sentences.text: “Can you touch my face?”
“It’s me.
I am your husband, Ding Ling.”
Ding Ling spoke softly a few words.
Little Dragon Girl was already in tears, tightly holding onto Ding Ling, as if letting go would cause him to fly away like a kite.
The person she thought about day and night truly arrived.
So real.
Little Dragon Girl felt her heart leap with joy.
Even the air she breathed became as sweet as honey.
A stream of happiness welled up from deep within her heart, flowing to every part of her body, filling her with a warmth and joy.
The two stayed together for several hours.
In that time, they shared all manners of sweet words between husband and wife.
Even the usually reticent Little Dragon Girl found herself telling Ding Ling many heartfelt things.
These were her innermost feelings.
She had never mentioned them to anyone, but once she spoke to Ding Ling, it was like a dam breaking.
Ding Ling listened with a constant smile, occasionally chiming in with warm, reassuring words.
This made Little Dragon Girl even happier.
Yet Ding Ling had not forgotten his mission from the Lower Realm.
When their conversation reached a certain point.
Ding Ling prepared to perform a rite on Little Dragon Girl, and just then.
A slender, tall, charming woman burst into the garden of the Prince’s Mansion, shouting loudly:
“Queen, something’s wrong, something’s wrong!”
“Hmm?”
Ding Ling frowned.
Little Dragon Girl gently smoothed the frown on Ding Ling’s forehead and said softly:
“Husband, the person who came is probably Guo’Er’s fiancée, Yelv Yan.
Her urgency must mean something is wrong, let’s go and see.”
After the two had spent several hours together.
Little Dragon Girl’s way of addressing Ding Ling also changed.

“Yelv Yan?”
Yelv Yan’s brows flew upward, exuding a heroic spirit.
Though not absolutely stunning, she was far superior to ordinary women.
Regarding Yelv Yan, it was Ding Ling’s first time seeing her, but he knew she was the daughter of a Mongolian official, Yelv Chucai, and sister to Yelv Qi.
And Yelv Qi was a disciple of Old Playful Zhou Botong, and originally, following the plot, Yelv Qi would marry Guo Fu and become the Beggar Gang Leader.
But the storyline of the Divine Eagle World had completely crumbled years ago.
The fates of Yelv Yan, Yelv Qi, and others were thus entirely altered and transformed.

Now, meeting Yelv Yan again in this Imperial City was quite a surprise for Ding Ling, as he thought the siblings had gone to develop in other regions, never expecting they’d end up related to Yang Guo and the others after all.
Yelv Yan actually had a marital bond with Yang Guo?!
This was something Ding Ling did not expect.
“Who are you?!”
Yelv Yan was startled upon hearing the voice and turned to look, only to be stunned.
To her eyes.
The Little Dragon Girl, usually as cold and ethereal as Immortal Chang’e from the Celestial Palace, was now leaning happily and fondly on a man’s shoulder!!
She was thunderstruck, her pupils dilated, and she was completely at a loss!

Now, this was how Yelv Yan viewed Little Dragon Girl.

chapters.title: Chapter 860: Cheng Ying
paragraphs: Little Dragon Girl responded:
“Guo’er told me about this matter. I only thought it was normal squabbles and complaints between youngsters, but I never imagined their conflict had intensified to this point.”
“Indeed.”

Yelv Yan felt apprehensive and shy, after all, Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl were Yang Guo’s uncle and aunt by marriage, considered his elders. Faced with these elders, especially Ding Ling, a martial arts myth, Yelv Yan felt entirely stiff and uncomfortable, and could only speak methodically:

“A few months ago, they had a major disagreement, and after that, Yang Guo said he wanted to marry me. I naturally liked him and did not oppose. However, I never expected the Wu Brothers would come and disrupt our happy day today.”
He looked despondent:
“It even implicated my brother.”
“Your brother?”
“Yes. He is also getting married today.”
“Oh?”
Ding Ling utilized his Divine Meditation Technique to scan various places, and sure enough, he saw another Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue’s mansion, also brightly decorated.
To his surprise, he recognized someone: Hong Lingbo!
“Your brother’s wife is Hong Lingbo?”
“Yes.”
“I truly didn’t expect Hong Lingbo would end up marrying Yelv Qi.”
This could be counted as a stroke of luck amidst misfortune.
It seems Hong Lingbo will have a change of fortune.

She and Lu Wushuang were both Great Ming Female Officials, and Ding Ling had been guided by them a few years ago to meet Zhou Botong. Speaking of, Ding Ling managed to complete his mission rapidly by finding Zhou Botong, all thanks to these two young ladies.
Unexpectedly, a few years later, Hong Lingbo and Yelv Qi are now getting married.
I wonder how Lu Wushuang is doing?

Ding Ling’s Divine Meditation Technique scanned again, and soon, at the corner of the Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue’s great hall, he saw her chatting with another exceptionally beautiful young lady:
“Cousin, what are we going to do? They’ve started fighting!”
Cousin?
It’s likely Cheng Ying.
Looking closely.
She was dressed in a faint-colored azure gown, her figure slim and graceful, with a slender waist—extremely charming!
Her face was as luminous as snow, and her eyes seemed to be like ink dots.
Standing beside Lu Wushuang, in terms of beauty, the distinction between the two was hard to tell, but her demeanor was as peaceful as a chrysanthemum, like a noble woman, making her more likable.
Upon hearing Lu Wushuang’s words, Cheng Ying sighed:
“It’s a pity the Emperor and Empress are away. Hong Qigong and my master have gone to the Upper Realm. If not, how would the Wu Brothers be allowed to act so audaciously!”
“It’s all Guo Fu’s fault!”
Lu Wushuang gritted her teeth in anger, her face full of wrath:
“And the Eldest Princess! Utterly clueless! Lacking any upbringing!”

“Guo Fu’s actions are reckless and arrogant; she is self-important and prideful. Even if Yang Guo marries Yelv Yan, he would never marry her. She feels humiliated and in rage, tricked the Emperor and Empress, commanding the Wu Brothers to capture Yang Guo; it almost makes sense.”
Cheng Ying sighed:

“Especially in recent years, her conflict with Yang Guo has become widely known. She repeatedly intimidated Yang Guo and demanded his cooperation. But Yang Guo is someone who reacts to persuasion but not coercion. Being intimidated by her naturally enrages him, making their relationship drift further apart, which is quite normal.”
“Guo Fu becoming the Eldest Princess is truly the misfortune of the Emperor and Empress.”
Lu Wushuang was indignant and disdainful:

“She’s just lucky. With her personality, if she wandered Jianghu, not even a hundred lives would be enough for others to kill! Furthermore, how could she impulsively trick the Emperor and Empress? Could there be a master behind the scenes guiding her?”
“No.”
Cheng Ying said:
“Coincidentally, something happened in the Western Region that necessitated the Emperor’s presence. The Empress, worried for the Emperor’s safety, accompanied him.”
“Oh?”
Lu Wushuang’s eyes turned:
“Why not invite the Little Princess? I believe if she steps in, this matter will certainly have some effect, at least prolonging the situation to allow the wedding to proceed!”

“The Little Princess is extremely clever, but she is very young and difficult to command respect. Moreover, she’s heavily restrained by the Eldest Princess, unable to step out of the palace, and currently locked in deep within, unable to come out.”
“Disgusting!”
Lu Wushuang angrily slapped the table:
“Were it not for her being the Eldest Princess, I would certainly slap her a few times to show her my power!”
“Alas.”
Cheng Ying sighed deeply:

“Yang Guo’s uncle is the Prince, the Immortal Realm Emperor, a supreme figure traversing several worlds. If one day he descends, knowing Guo Fu’s audacity and rudeness, do you think Guo Fu will have a good outcome? I worry she might cause friction between the Prince and the Emperor, and that would be troublesome.”
“What kind of person is the Prince? Naturally, he sees clearly.”
Lu Wushuang said sharply:

“I’ve seen the Prince before. He’s very easy to talk to. I’m eager for him to arrive in our world soon. I’ve inquired with the Alien. The Prince has visited the Historical Plane, the Celestial Dragon Plane, The Smiling, Proud Wanderer Plane, and soon, he will arrive in our Divine Eagle Plane.”
The concept of Plane.
Was coined by the Alien.
Lu Wushuang and the others have heard it countless times, so they naturally adopt the term.
Ding Ling, having witnessed this, had already deduced the general cause of events.
It was likely Guo Fu was resentful of Yang Guo’s choice, her pride hurt, so she sought Da and Xiao Wu’s cooperation.
Da and Xiao Wu were under Guo Fu’s command, obedient to her every word!
If Guo Fu gave an order...
Da and Xiao Wu might genuinely obey.
In a fit of blind rage, Guo Fu might indeed attempt to strike down Yang Guo.
This girl was rash and lacking sense; Ding Ling wouldn’t be surprised if she did something foolish.
That’s why he prefers not to interact with Guo Fu.
Her character is too obnoxious, there is absolutely no way Ding Ling would develop emotional entanglements with such a woman!
“Let’s resolve this ridiculous situation quickly.”
Ding Ling waved his hand, taking Little Dragon Girl and Yelv Yan, and swiftly rose into the air, arriving above the Vice Minister of the Ministry of War’s mansion in an instant.
“So fast!”
Yelv Yan was astonished.

Little Dragon Girl’s heart was filled with joy. Ding Ling exceeded her expectations in strength. Recalling Yang Guo’s frequent mentions of Ding Ling’s ‘legend,’ Little Dragon Girl became even more mesmerized, her gaze at Ding Ling seemed to contain gleaming autumn waters!

Ding Ling descended from high above, landing not far behind Yang Guo, who had been in a confrontation with Xiaang Wentian. Seeing Ding Ling, Xiaang Wentian’s heart trembled, his Great Guan Saber nearly slipping and falling to the ground. He stepped back in shock, bowing respectfully to Ding Ling:
“Greetings, Great Emperor!”
Ding Ling’s reputation now reverberated through the Historical, Martial Arts, and major Plane Worlds.
Even those worlds Ding Ling hadn’t visited before, like The Deer and the Cauldron and Dragon Gate Flying Armor, were filled with tales of his legend.
