chapters.title: Chapter 861: Kill
paragraphs: It can be imagined how intimidating Ding Ling has become to ordinary martial artists nowadays.
Despite Xiaang Wentian’s significant progress over the years, and having become a prestigious general in the Great Ming Dynasty on the Divine Eagle Plane,
compared to Ding Ling, it’s like a firefly to the bright moon, the difference is like heaven and earth, completely incomparable.
Therefore.
Upon seeing Ding Ling, Xiaang Wentian was shocked and trembling, unable to resist performing a grand salute.
He did not expect Ding Ling to suddenly appear on the Divine Eagle Plane.
He truly had no mental preparation!
However, he soon felt relieved, knowing that Yang Guo calls Ding Ling uncle, so he dared not strike hard against Yang Guo and showed mercy everywhere.
Now, it seems he made the right decision; otherwise, a killing gaze from Ding Ling, and he would be doomed.
“Uncle!”
Yang Guo was also surprised and delighted to see Ding Ling.
“Mm.”
Ding Ling nodded and smiled at Yang Guo.
Yang Guo was ecstatic and excited, especially when he saw Yelv Yan signaling him; his restless, agitated heart instantly calmed down.
His encounter, acquaintance, and love with Yelv Yan often allowed them to understand each other with just a glance.
The same was true at this moment; from Yelv Yan’s expression and eyes, he knew his uncle had already comprehended the general situation, making it easier to handle.
He had initially been worried that the wedding would be disrupted, and he and Yelv Yan might face accidents.
Now, it’s all good with his uncle here. Who dares to act impudently?
Everything will sail smoothly and have a festive conclusion!
Swish!
Other soldiers, trying to capture Yang Guo, saw Xiaang Wentian respectfully bowing to the ground first.
And Yang Guo addressing the suddenly appearing handsome young man as uncle!
The soldiers collectively paused, a bit confused.
But soon, they seemed to realize something, involuntarily drawing cold air, their pupils widening!
Especially some old soldiers seeing Ding Ling, becoming both surprised and delighted, simultaneously threw their weapons and kneeled, calling him Prince.
Seeing this, where would the new recruits dare to be negligent, all kneeling to hail Prince.
Only Da and Xiao Wu brothers rode on horseback, face blank, sitting bewildered on their mounts.
They were commanding generals.
Yet now, in this dense crowd of soldiers, none listened to them, reducing them to mere figureheads.
“Ah!”
A middle-aged man with disheveled hair suddenly surged from behind the Da and Xiao Wu brothers.

His hair and beard were oily and dark, his face deeply wrinkled, with vicious eyes full of hatred as he looked at Ding Ling. He charged forward like a steed, bursting from the crowd, aiming to kill Ding Ling. From afar, he fiercely hurled a spear at Ding Ling, with gnashing teeth, evidently wanting Ding Ling dead!
Whoosh!
The spear tore through the air, reaching Ding Ling in an instant. Ding Ling slightly raised his eyebrows, casually waved his hand without looking.
Bang! The spear seemed to gain sentience, suddenly reversed direction, and shot back at faster speed towards where it came from.
In less than half a blink.
Thud!

Like a swift beam, the spear vanished into the void. But hearing a thud sounded past the ears, upon looking again, the middle-aged man was pierced through the abdomen by the spear, seemingly propelled uncontrollable by the immense force on the spear straight onward.
He flew tens of meters away, before the spear embedded him into the estate’s surrounding wall, ceasing the trajectory.
Drip, drip!
The middle-aged man died instantly, blood gushed from his wound, dripping to the ground.
Da and Xiao Wu brothers watched with pale faces, sorrow written on:
“Father!”
As it turned out, the attacker was Wu Santong.
He was deranged.
Yet always remembered Ding Ling once hurt his two sons.
Therefore, upon seeing Ding Ling, he went berserk trying to kill Ding Ling.
However, Ding Ling was no longer the same.
Previously, he would consider the faces of Huang Rong, Guo Jing, sparing Wu Santong.
But now does Ding Ling need to consider these?
He only cares for Little Dragon Girl, and only looks after a few dear friends and relatives like Yang Guo. As for others, any daring offense would be met with due penalty.
“Ding Ling!”
Da and Xiao Wu brothers brandished a whip towards Ding Ling, full of hatred:
“You, you dare kill my father!”
“Huh?”
Ding Ling cast a gaze, thud, thud!
Da and Xiao Wu brothers rolled off their saddles, falling to the ground, their state unknown.
In an instant, Ding Ling’s Spirit Killing Sword had invisibly shredded their souls, pierced their Sea of Consciousness, making them truly living dead.
He wasn’t Guo Jing; he wouldn’t indulge Da and Xiao Wu.
Several years ago, these two brothers provoked him, even wishing to severely injure him.
Times change.
For Guo Fu, the reckless sister, their lack of brains was tolerable, but to openly hate him, isn’t that seeking death?
Xiaang Wentian watched in astonishment, his limbs chilled, lying prostrate, not daring utter a word.
He realized he couldn’t compare over years.
Ding Ling’s decisive killings were sharper than ever!
This sort of person, exalted, would certainly not care about one like Xiaang Wentian dying.
Xiaang Wentian trembled in fear, thinking:
“Years ago I could still call Ding Ling Brother Ding, even spar with him in martial arts. Although not up to mark, not excessively disparate, not devoid of hope to chase.
But now?
Ding Ling’s mere gaze bears down on me like ten thousand mountains, unable to even contemplate resistance! Strong! Indeed, as the Alien said, evolved beyond comprehension and perception.”
Xiaang Wentian felt ashamed, sighed heavily.
All humans alike.
Years elapsed.
He moved with difficulty, progressing slowly, while Ding Ling?
Comparing Ding Ling.
His cultivation paced like snail, cow walking!
To the extent upon seeing Ding Ling again, intending to blurt ‘Brother Ding’ was forced into kneeling in admiration of the Great Emperor!
He knew his own constraint, aware the gap was tremendous, no longer qualified to call Ding Ling brother!
“The Wu Brothers just died like that?”
Yang Guo stood still, looking at Ding Ling:
‘Uncle, you killed Uncle Guo’s disciples, I’m worried...’
“Nothing to worry about.”
Ding Ling looked at Xiaang Wentian:
“Then trouble General Xiaang to clean up here. Afterwards, Yang Guo and Yelv Yan will continue the wedding.”
“Certainly.”
Xiaang Wentian solemnly said:
“The Great Emperor rest assured, today with me here, none shall disturb the feast.”
Ding Ling nodded nonchalantly, then walked with Little Dragon Girl towards the Main Hall of the estate.
Yang Guo, Yelv Yan exchanged looks, immediately following suite.
Meanwhile Xiaang Wentian quickly tidied up the site.
When ordering the transport of Da and Xiao Wu’s bodies, he found both still breathing, yet eyes shut tight, couldn’t be awakened.

sentences.text: It can be imagined how intimidating Ding Ling has become to ordinary martial artists nowadays.
Despite Xiaang Wentian’s significant progress over the years, and having become a prestigious general in the Great Ming Dynasty on the Divine Eagle Plane,
compared to Ding Ling, it’s like a firefly to the bright moon, the difference is like heaven and earth, completely incomparable.
Therefore.
Upon seeing Ding Ling, Xiaang Wentian was shocked and trembling, unable to resist performing a grand salute.
He did not expect Ding Ling to suddenly appear on the Divine Eagle Plane.
He truly had no mental preparation!
However, he soon felt relieved, knowing that Yang Guo calls Ding Ling uncle, so he dared not strike hard against Yang Guo and showed mercy everywhere.
Now, it seems he made the right decision; otherwise, a killing gaze from Ding Ling, and he would be doomed.
“Uncle!”
Yang Guo was also surprised and delighted to see Ding Ling.
“Mm.”
Ding Ling nodded and smiled at Yang Guo.
Yang Guo was ecstatic and excited, especially when he saw Yelv Yan signaling him; his restless, agitated heart instantly calmed down.
His encounter, acquaintance, and love with Yelv Yan often allowed them to understand each other with just a glance.
The same was true at this moment; from Yelv Yan’s expression and eyes, he knew his uncle had already comprehended the general situation, making it easier to handle.
He had initially been worried that the wedding would be disrupted, and he and Yelv Yan might face accidents.
Now, it’s all good with his uncle here.
Who dares to act impudently?
Everything will sail smoothly and have a festive conclusion!
Swish!
Other soldiers, trying to capture Yang Guo, saw Xiaang Wentian respectfully bowing to the ground first.
And Yang Guo addressing the suddenly appearing handsome young man as uncle!
The soldiers collectively paused, a bit confused.
But soon, they seemed to realize something, involuntarily drawing cold air, their pupils widening!
Especially some old soldiers seeing Ding Ling, becoming both surprised and delighted, simultaneously threw their weapons and kneeled, calling him Prince.
Seeing this, where would the new recruits dare to be negligent, all kneeling to hail Prince.
Only Da and Xiao Wu brothers rode on horseback, face blank, sitting bewildered on their mounts.
They were commanding generals.
Yet now, in this dense crowd of soldiers, none listened to them, reducing them to mere figureheads.
“Ah!”
A middle-aged man with disheveled hair suddenly surged from behind the Da and Xiao Wu brothers.
His hair and beard were oily and dark, his face deeply wrinkled, with vicious eyes full of hatred as he looked at Ding Ling.
He charged forward like a steed, bursting from the crowd, aiming to kill Ding Ling.
From afar, he fiercely hurled a spear at Ding Ling, with gnashing teeth, evidently wanting Ding Ling dead!
Whoosh!
The spear tore through the air, reaching Ding Ling in an instant.
Ding Ling slightly raised his eyebrows, casually waved his hand without looking.
Bang!
The spear seemed to gain sentience, suddenly reversed direction, and shot back at faster speed towards where it came from.
In less than half a blink.
Thud!
Like a swift beam, the spear vanished into the void.

But hearing a thud sounded past the ears, upon looking again, the middle-aged man was pierced through the abdomen by the spear, seemingly propelled uncontrollable by the immense force on the spear straight onward.
He flew tens of meters away, before the spear embedded him into the estate’s surrounding wall, ceasing the trajectory.
Drip, drip!
The middle-aged man died instantly, blood gushed from his wound, dripping to the ground.
Da and Xiao Wu brothers watched with pale faces, sorrow written on:
“Father!”
As it turned out, the attacker was Wu Santong.
He was deranged.
Yet always remembered Ding Ling once hurt his two sons.
Therefore, upon seeing Ding Ling, he went berserk trying to kill Ding Ling.
However, Ding Ling was no longer the same.
Previously, he would consider the faces of Huang Rong, Guo Jing, sparing Wu Santong.
But now does Ding Ling need to consider these?
He only cares for Little Dragon Girl, and only looks after a few dear friends and relatives like Yang Guo.
As for others, any daring offense would be met with due penalty.
“Ding Ling!”
Da and Xiao Wu brothers brandished a whip towards Ding Ling, full of hatred:
“You, you dare kill my father!”
“Huh?”
Ding Ling cast a gaze, thud, thud!
Da and Xiao Wu brothers rolled off their saddles, falling to the ground, their state unknown.
In an instant, Ding Ling’s Spirit Killing Sword had invisibly shredded their souls, pierced their Sea of Consciousness, making them truly living dead.
He wasn’t Guo Jing; he wouldn’t indulge Da and Xiao Wu.
Several years ago, these two brothers provoked him, even wishing to severely injure him.
Times change.
For Guo Fu, the reckless sister, their lack of brains was tolerable, but to openly hate him, isn’t that seeking death?
Xiaang Wentian watched in astonishment, his limbs chilled, lying prostrate, not daring utter a word.
He realized he couldn’t compare over years.
Ding Ling’s decisive killings were sharper than ever!
This sort of person, exalted, would certainly not care about one like Xiaang Wentian dying.

chapters.title: Chapter 862: Commotion
paragraphs: Xiaang Wentian could not understand the true reason behind the situation.
He ordered people to carry the Wu Brothers back to the Wu Mansion.
As for Wu Santong’s corpse, he had it placed in a coffin.
Soon.
The Vice Minister of the Ministry of War’s Mansion was cleaned thoroughly.
The wedding proceeded as scheduled.
Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl attended and witnessed the wedding as Yang Guo’s elders.
Halfway through the wedding.
A beauty with a face like white jade, appearance as morning blossoms, and extraordinary demeanor rushed into the wedding site with a hundred guards.
She pointed at Yang Guo, her flower-like face flushed red:
“Yang Guo! You deserve to die!”
The person was none other than Guo Fu.
She had been ordering her people to keep a close watch on the Vice Minister’s Mansion, reporting to her immediately at any sign of disturbance.
Initially, everything was fine.

Yang Guo was about to be captured and beaten, and Guo Fu felt both pleased and proud, thinking: “Yang Guo, let’s see if you still dare to plead with me. If you don’t, I’ll lock you up in a death cell, and I’ll capture and torture Yelv Yan, making it impossible for you both to meet or marry!”
However, Yang Guo had not been captured.
Instead, news came that Wu Santong was dead, Da and Xiao Wu were lying on the ground unconscious, not aware of life or death.
Guo Fu was shocked and angry, unable to believe things had reached this point!
This was the Emperor’s domain, the Imperial City’s territory, her turf as Guo Fu, who dared defy her? Didn’t they value their lives?!

Anger flared, and without further inquiry, she mounted her horse and charged out of the Eldest Princess’s Mansion, rampaged all the way, and upon reaching the Vice Minister’s Mansion, Xiaang Wentian, a mere little officer dared to block her, further enraging Guo Fu to whip out her horse whip, lashing at Xiaang Wentian while haughtily shouting, ‘You insolent servant, dare to block me? Don’t you know who I am!’

Xiaang Wentian was whipped in the face, dared not express anger, much less act against Guo Fu, as his promotion to this point had not been easy, he was just a few steps away from entering the Imperial Palace Library to learn the Nine Yin Scripture and other techniques, how could he give up such a hard-won opportunity?
Thus, he could only swallow his grievances, thinking, ‘Just you wait, unwise Eldest Princess! When you realize whom you face, let’s see how you continue your arrogance!’
Thus, he deliberately stepped aside, allowing Guo Fu to charge into the Vice Minister’s Mansion.
Thereafter, he pretended to follow in panic behind Guo Fu.
“Guo Fu!”

Yang Guo, clad in a bright red wedding robe, looked even more handsome, distinguished, and graceful; his face was full of joy as he toasted the guests, Guo Fu’s sudden intrusion naturally displeased him.
He initially had a fairly amicable relationship with Guo Fu.
But later discovered their worldview, life philosophy, values, etc. were entirely different, often one wanted to go east, while the other insisted on going west.
Both were stubborn and highly self-respecting, once a decision was made, it was hard to change.

Thus, over the following years, conflicts arose endlessly, during one such conflict, Yang Guo nearly had his arm cut off, causing cold sweat with the memory of what the Alien had told him, ‘Yang Guo, if events follow their normal trajectory, Guo Fu will cut off one of your arms!’
Yang Guo distanced himself from Guo Fu, better to avoid provocation than to endure it?!
Though he didn’t believe in story trajectories, he trusted the Alien’s analysis of Guo Fu’s character, her reckless impulsiveness was indeed brainless, truly capable of doing absurd things.
And Yang Guo couldn’t possibly tolerate her, they were destined never to be together, thus facing Guo Fu’s intrusion, he sternly said:
“I told you years ago, we’ll never marry. Why must you escalate this situation? Don’t you think you’re bringing disgrace to Uncle Guo and Lady Guo?”
“Pah!”

Overwhelmed by anger, grievance, unwillingness, and depression, Guo Fu, especially seeing Yang Guo dressed in wedding attire, heroic and outstanding, her heart churned with mixed emotions, some words burst out without thought:

“It’s you who disgraces my parents! You’d rather marry a wretched, low-born, vile foreign ugly girl than me, the noble and beautiful Eldest Princess! This is an insult to me, and even worse, an insult to my parents! You dare mention Uncle Guo, Lady Guo, don’t you feel embarrassed, ashamed?! You don’t deserve to call them Uncle Guo, Lady Guo! You illegitimate son! Just like your father, only knows to chase after rotten peach blossoms!”
“You!”
Yang Guo’s eyes reddened, he rushed over, slapped Guo Fu hard, the slap sounded crisp:
“Get out!”
Yang Guo pointed towards the door:
“You’re not welcome here.”
“You, you, you dare hit me?!”

A clear palm print appeared on Guo Fu’s face, she felt a fiery pain, incredulously covering her face with her hand, her tearful eyes filled with rage, she screamed and suddenly drew her sword at Yang Guo.
Yang Guo, it seemed, had anticipated this, promptly dodging the thrust.
Guo Fu chased after Yang Guo in a frenzy, thrusting and slashing.
The guests instantly suffered.
Some failed to dodge, struck by Guo Fu, blood gushed forth.
Yang Guo, furious:
“You’ve gone mad!”
He regretted, in hindsight, hitting Guo Fu in front of so many.
But Guo Fu calling him illegitimate, insulting his father, touched his Inverted Scale, he couldn’t bear it.

But only after hitting her did he realize he might have acted impulsively, feeling somewhat remorseful, yet seeing Guo Fu truly trying to hack him, he tossed this remorse aside, immensely grateful he didn’t marry a reckless, arrogant woman like Guo Fu!
Otherwise, he couldn’t imagine how he’d survive the rest of his life!
“Ah!”
Guo Fu could only scream, disregarding everything, chasing Yang Guo with her sword.

Being humiliated by Yang Guo in front of so many, she, a dignified Eldest Princess, losing such face, heart disheartened, even contemplating death, how would she let Yang Guo off, no matter what Yang Guo said, she just raised her sword to stab him.

Yang Guo looked towards Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl’s seats, seeing Ding Ling expressionless, and Little Dragon Girl somewhat worried, seemed ready to intervene, his heart skipped a beat, realizing his action didn’t gain Ding Ling’s approval.
Feeling disappointed, though his actions didn’t slow, he immediately picked up a stool, to clash with Guo Fu’s Treasure Sword, attempting to disarm her.
But at the moment of contact, the stool was effortlessly sliced as if through tofu.
“True Ziwei Soft Sword?!
“You dare use this sword against me?!”
Yang Guo too was enraged, grabbing another chair, aimed to smash Guo Fu’s arm.

chapters.title: Chapter 863: The Wind's Direction
paragraphs: Guo Fu was ultimately not as skilled in martial arts as Yang Guo, although she initially had some advantage with the Divine Weapon.
But after only a few exchanges, she was hit on the arm, and the Ziwei Soft Sword in her hand fell to the ground.
Even so, she did not want to let Yang Guo go. Instead, her arm was hurt again, further fueling her anger. She screamed and grabbed a dish from a nearby table, hurling it at Yang Guo.
This caused quite a messy scene for Yang Guo.
Various dishes covered his celebratory attire.
His hair had some soup slowly dripping down.
Some of it dripped onto Yang Guo’s face, sliding down his chin, landing on the ground with a splash.
“Guo Fu!!”
Yang Guo’s face was livid, his expression dark as if about to burst into tears. On such a joyous wedding day, Guo Fu caused such chaos, and he was on the verge of cracking!
“Ah!”
Guo Fu continued her assault.
The guests had already fled or ran away, some headed towards the Main Hall where Ding Ling was, others directly to a corner of the courtyard.
Yet no one left.
After all, Ding Ling, the Immortal Realm Emperor, hadn’t left, so who would dare to go?
No need to give Yang Guo face, but Ding Ling’s face must be respected!!
Xiaang Wentian was also shocked, watching Guo Fu’s arrogance and unruly behavior, rare to witness in this world.
Yet, was Guo Fu’s eyesight poor, or what?
She actually didn’t see Ding Ling sitting high up in the Main Hall?!

But considering the distance from the courtyard to the Main Hall was quite far, Guo Fu’s skills were average and her eyesight wasn’t up to par with experts, it made sense. Plus, Guo Fu was solely focused on humiliating Yang Guo, ignoring others wasn’t unimaginable.
After Xiaang Wentian figured it out, he smiled wryly and was about to go to the Main Hall to plead for forgiveness from Ding Ling.
Ding Ling suddenly pointed into the air.
Bang!
A stream of light hit Guo Fu.

Who had been screaming and wrecking the wedding scene, relentlessly hurling ‘dishes’ at Yang Guo—Guo Fu froze, then uncontrollably fell down, landing with a splash into the soup and water on the ground, her head, face, and body now covered in various dishes.
Guo Fu’s face was green, her eyes wide, shocked, terrified. She wanted to scream but found she couldn’t utter a sound, her entire body paralyzed, completely out of control.
“Thank you, uncle, for the rescue.”
Yang Guo, covered in mess, clasped his hands in thanks to Ding Ling.

Guo Fu heard this, her heart burning with anger suddenly doused in ice-cold water. In that instant, she seemed to find herself in Ice Hell, her pupils dilated, her mind replaying ‘uncle’ over and over.
‘Could it be...’
She thought of a possibility.
Fear arose unbidden.
But what followed was grievance, unwillingness, depression.
She felt Ding Ling was biased, unexpectedly helping Yang Guo, not her!
She was the victim!
“General Xiaang, handle the situation please.”
Ding Ling said lightly:
“Guo’Er, go freshen up and head straight to the bridal chamber. This wedding ends here today.”
“Yes. Uncle.”
Yang Guo had no mood to continue toasting guests, only wanting to leave this place and never see Guo Fu again!
Xiaang Wentian even more respectfully complied, immediately ordering the cleanup of the scene.
He felt a bit bitter, originally intending to show off to later receive Ding Ling’s favor.
But now, it seemed Ding Ling had seen through his minor tricks, displeasing Ding Ling.
“Alas.”
Xiaang Wentian felt troubled, despondent:

“What an heroic figure Ding Ling is? That I dared play tricks before him? All because I was infuriated by Guo Fu, that so-called Eldest Princess. Had I been more sensible, I certainly wouldn’t have let her come through.”
But the deed was done.
Guo Fu indeed turned the wedding upside down.
The promise given to Ding Ling that ‘no one would affect the wedding banquet’, naturally, was shattered.
“Alas.”
Upon seeing Ding Ling not even sparing him a glance, pulling the Little Dragon Girl, and disappearing in a leap without a trace, Xiaang Wentian couldn’t help sighing endlessly.
He felt he missed a colossal opportunity.
Just because he feared Guo Fu, wanted to obtain Nine Yin Scripture and other techniques, so he let Guo Fu through?
Yet he didn’t consider, if he had successfully completed the task given by Ding Ling, what would the minor Nine Yin Scripture be worth?
The Kung Fu Ding Ling casually offered would crush the Nine Yin Scripture across countless levels!
The more Xiaang Wentian thought, the more depressed, unwilling; naturally harboring no goodwill towards Guo Fu!
He was fearless, the Celestial King on earth, and now nearly stumbled over a woman! Infuriating, hateful, lamentable!
The events at the Vice Minister of the Ministry of War’s Mansion, like a whirlwind, swiftly spread to every household, within two hours, everyone inside and outside the Imperial City knew of it.
Various discussions ensued.
Some laughed heartily, some sneered, some were touched, some were terrified, some were deeply thoughtful...
The wedding banquet of Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue Yelv Qi and Hong Lingbo was rather smooth.
Because Xiaang Wentian’s troops guarded it, and without Da and Xiao Wu, Guo Fu, others dared not provoke both Xiaang Wentian and Yelv Qi simultaneously?
Come wedding mid-way.
Cheng Ying and Lu Wushuang learned of the events at the Vice Minister of the Ministry of War’s Mansion, exchanging glances.
Lu Wushuang whispered:
“Guo Fu has really caused big trouble now. Hehe. Truly satisfying. I just want to see how this wicked girl plans to wrap things up?”
Regarding Guo Fu’s situation, Lu Wushuang was somewhat happy at another’s misfortune.
Clearly, she had disliked Guo Fu for a long time!
Cheng Ying gave her a playful glare, then gently said:

“No one expected the Prince to also attend Yang Guo’s wedding. The implications are obvious. Looks like the Emperor and Empress may hastily return from the West, comparing the situation in the West, clearly the Prince’s matter is far more significant.”
“Indeed.”
Lu Wushuang agreed deeply:

“With the Prince taking charge, what matter can’t be resolved? Matters very difficult for the Emperor and Empress, for the Prince, will undoubtedly be trivial. Possibly, upon hearing of the Prince’s return, the opposing side may be so frightened they pee their pants, voluntarily surrender to our Great Ming Dynasty, who knows?”
“That’s certainly the case, unless the opposition wants to die.”
Cheng Ying said:

“If the Prince really acts, do you think the opposing royal family could survive? They definitely wouldn’t do something so foolish, previously dared to contend with the Great Ming Dynasty because they had many Ascenders join them, giving them some confidence.
And for state tranquility, the Emperor had to go negotiate with them.

But now if the news of the Prince descending to the Lower Realm reaches the West. Those Ascenders will surely abandon the Western Kingdom and flee. The Western Kingdom, to appease the Prince’s wrath, voluntarily surrendering is most likely a nailed-down certainty.”

After Xiaang Wentian figured it out, he smiled wryly and was about to go to the Main Hall to plead for forgiveness from Ding Ling.
Ding Ling suddenly pointed into the air.
Bang!
A stream of light hit Guo Fu.

Who had been screaming and wrecking the wedding scene, relentlessly hurling ‘dishes’ at Yang Guo—Guo Fu froze, then uncontrollably fell down, landing with a splash into the soup and water on the ground, her head, face, and body now covered in various dishes.
Guo Fu’s face was green, her eyes wide, shocked, terrified.
She wanted to scream but found she couldn’t utter a sound, her entire body paralyzed, completely out of control.
“Thank you, uncle, for the rescue.”
Yang Guo, covered in mess, clasped his hands in thanks to Ding Ling.
Guo Fu heard this, her heart burning with anger suddenly doused in ice-cold water.
In that instant, she seemed to find herself in Ice Hell, her pupils dilated, her mind replaying ‘uncle’ over and over.
‘Could it be...’
She thought of a possibility.
Fear arose unbidden.
But what followed was grievance, unwillingness, depression.
She felt Ding Ling was biased, unexpectedly helping Yang Guo, not her!
She was the victim!
“General Xiaang, handle the situation please.”
Ding Ling said lightly:
“Guo’Er, go freshen up and head straight to the bridal chamber.
This wedding ends here today.”
“Yes.
Uncle.”
Yang Guo had no mood to continue toasting guests, only wanting to leave this place and never see Guo Fu again!
Xiaang Wentian even more respectfully complied, immediately ordering the cleanup of the scene.
He felt a bit bitter, originally intending to show off to later receive Ding Ling’s favor.
But now, it seemed Ding Ling had seen through his minor tricks, displeasing Ding Ling.
“Alas.”
Xiaang Wentian felt troubled, despondent:
“What an heroic figure Ding Ling is?
That I dared play tricks before him?
All because I was infuriated by Guo Fu, that so-called Eldest Princess.
Had I been more sensible, I certainly wouldn’t have let her come through.”
But the deed was done.
Guo Fu indeed turned the wedding upside down.
The promise given to Ding Ling that ‘no one would affect the wedding banquet’, naturally, was shattered.
“Alas.”
Upon seeing Ding Ling not even sparing him a glance, pulling the Little Dragon Girl, and disappearing in a leap without a trace, Xiaang Wentian couldn’t help sighing endlessly.
He felt he missed a colossal opportunity.
Just because he feared Guo Fu, wanted to obtain Nine Yin Scripture and other techniques, so he let Guo Fu through?
Yet he didn’t consider, if he had successfully completed the task given by Ding Ling, what would the minor Nine Yin Scripture be worth?
The Kung Fu Ding Ling casually offered would crush the Nine Yin Scripture across countless levels!
The more Xiaang Wentian thought, the more depressed, unwilling; naturally harboring no goodwill towards Guo Fu!
He was fearless, the Celestial King on earth, and now nearly stumbled over a woman!
Infuriating, hateful, lamentable!
The events at the Vice Minister of the Ministry of War’s Mansion, like a whirlwind, swiftly spread to every household, within two hours, everyone inside and outside the Imperial City knew of it.
Various discussions ensued.
Some laughed heartily, some sneered, some were touched, some were terrified, some were deeply thoughtful...
The wedding banquet of Vice Minister of the Ministry of Revenue Yelv Qi and Hong Lingbo was rather smooth.
Because Xiaang Wentian’s troops guarded it, and without Da and Xiao Wu, Guo Fu, others dared not provoke both Xiaang Wentian and Yelv Qi simultaneously?
Come wedding mid-way.
Cheng Ying and Lu Wushuang learned of the events at the Vice Minister of the Ministry of War’s Mansion, exchanging glances.
Lu Wushuang whispered:
“Guo Fu has really caused big trouble now.
Hehe.
Truly satisfying.
I just want to see how this wicked girl plans to wrap things up?”
Regarding Guo Fu’s situation, Lu Wushuang was somewhat happy at another’s misfortune.
Clearly, she had disliked Guo Fu for a long time!
Cheng Ying gave her a playful glare, then gently said:
“No one expected the Prince to also attend Yang Guo’s wedding.
The implications are obvious.
Looks like the Emperor and Empress may hastily return from the West, comparing the situation in the West, clearly the Prince’s matter is far more significant.”
“Indeed.”
Lu Wushuang agreed deeply:
“With the Prince taking charge, what matter can’t be resolved?
Matters very difficult for the Emperor and Empress, for the Prince, will undoubtedly be trivial.
Possibly, upon hearing of the Prince’s return, the opposing side may be so frightened they pee their pants, voluntarily surrender to our Great Ming Dynasty, who knows?”
“That’s certainly the case, unless the opposition wants to die.”
Cheng Ying said:
“If the Prince really acts, do you think the opposing royal family could survive?
They definitely wouldn’t do something so foolish, previously dared to contend with the Great Ming Dynasty because they had many Ascenders join them, giving them some confidence.
And for state tranquility, the Emperor had to go negotiate with them.
But now if the news of the Prince descending to the Lower Realm reaches the West.
Those Ascenders will surely abandon the Western Kingdom and flee.
The Western Kingdom, to appease the Prince’s wrath, voluntarily surrendering is most likely a nailed-down certainty.”

chapters.title: Chapter 864: Pleading for Forgiveness
paragraphs: And indeed, things unfolded just as Cheng Ying had said.
The return of Ding Ling and Guo Fu’s disruption of Yang Guo’s wedding banquet had spread almost throughout the world’s top echelons in less than a day through player transmission.
Upon hearing the news, Guo Jing and Huang Rong were taken aback and, disregarding negotiations with various Western Kingdoms, directly chose to return to the Imperial City.

The heads of the Western Kingdoms, having learned the details, were also scared with cold sweat running down their foreheads, each of them angrily reprimanding their strategists, accusing them of enchanting the king’s mind and calling for their execution!
Completely blaming their strategic misstep and greed-fueled ambitions on the strategists.
They were just finding scapegoats.
The Ascenders were fully aware of this and left the same day.
Their cultivation was profound, their Lightweight Skill exceptional, and ordinary people simply couldn’t handle them. If they truly wanted to flee, who could stop them?
Moreover, due to the sudden turn of events, the kingdom hadn’t formulated any measures to bind or control the Ascenders, and could only watch helplessly as they left one by one.
They did want to force the Ascenders to stay, but they dared not.

Only because most Ascenders were heroes, champions, and formidable figures from the Lower Realm, all quite formidable, and if pushed to the brink, they could band together and overturn the Western Kingdom, leading to endless troubles.
“See how Ding Ling’s attitude is towards Huang Rong and Guo Jing couple. If Ding Ling continues to support the Great Ming Dynasty, we’ll surrender to them!”
The more they understood Ding Ling.
The more they realized Ding Ling’s fearsome nature.

They were also worried that Ding Ling might descend at any time. Even with a large number of Ascenders assisting, they didn’t dare truly encroach upon the Great Ming Dynasty’s territory, but instead used the Great Army and Ascenders to threaten and coerce Ming Dynasty’s border forces, forcing Guo Jing to negotiate and extort some benefits.
Now, no benefits are seen.
But a stench was stirred!
They just hoped that Guo Fu’s disruption of the wedding banquet might anger Ding Ling against the Guo Family.
Then they would profit greatly!
And clearly.
In matters like these, Huang Rong, being a Female Zhuge, naturally saw through it all very clearly. She was also extremely furious!
She hadn’t expected Guo Fu to be so lawless!
‘When I return, I must discipline her properly!’
Guo Jing galloped rapidly, the whoosh of the wind in his ears unable to drown out the voice stirred by his anger:

“As the Eldest Princess, instead of being positively proactive, she’s been causing trouble for me! It’s been so many years, I originally thought she would show restraint, but she’s becoming increasingly presumptuous!”
“It’s all my fault.”
Huang Rong was distressed and regretful:
“I’ve spoiled her too much.”
“I haven’t disciplined her well either.”
Guo Jing sighed and said:
“Fu’Er is our daughter, and if a child is not taught it is the father’s fault. It’s my mistake, how can I blame you, Rong’Er?”
Huang Rong was moved and ashamed, recognizing her greater responsibility for Guo Fu’s behavior.
If it weren’t for her excessive pampering and indulgence of Guo Fu.
Guo Fu wouldn’t have grown to such an extent.
“I’ve heard that Da and Xiao Wu brothers were beaten into living corpses by Ding Ling.”
As Huang Rong rode alongside Guo Jing, nearly shoulder-to-shoulder, she used the Secret Transmission method to relay to Guo Jing:
“Brother Jing, you must think openly.”
“Da and Xiao Wu caused trouble with Fu’Er, it was a deserved retribution!”
Though Guo Jing was pained by Da and Xiao Wu’s death, upon understanding the original circumstances, he couldn’t help but sigh:

“I entrusted the military leadership token to the two brothers because I valued them, wanting to groom them for talent so they could form good ties with Xiaang Wentian, Long Qie, Zhangg Han while I was away.
But they listened to Fu’Er too much!
They even ordered Xiaang Wentian and other fierce generals to besiege the Vice Minister of the Ministry of War’s Mansion, an utterly unforgivable act!
Now that they have become living corpses, it is but the cycle of cause and effect, a fate ordained. Perhaps this calamity was destined in their lives.”
“These aren’t the worst of it. I’m afraid of Ding Ling’s anger.”
Huang Rong was deeply worried:
“Ding Ling traverses many worlds, with a single command, can bring change to the entire world.

His influence is unbelievably immense. I originally thought he’d stay in The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World for at least four or five months. I didn’t expect him to come to our world so quickly. Alas, human calculation cannot surpass Celestial Calculation! Miscalculation, it’s all my fault! We shouldn’t have kept Fu’Er in the Imperial City, which led to such an unbelievable event!”
Due to the players.
Almost all Natives know some names of the Planes.
Also because of the players.
Ding Ling’s movements are known by the high echelons of almost every world.
Huang Rong was precisely deducing from various information that Ding Ling was bound to come to the Divine Eagle Plane, but the time should be a few months away.

And these months are just right to resolve some major issues, and then wait peacefully for Ding Ling’s arrival, so they can grandly welcome him and let him feel the Guo Family’s sincerity and enthusiasm!
The result?
Reality poured cold water, nearly scaring Huang Rong to death!
Fortunately, Guo Fu didn’t provoke Ding Ling.
Otherwise, the consequences would be unimaginable!
As for Da and Xiao Wu?
It can only be said that their failure meant their end, and they deserved no pity.
No wonder Huang Rong thought so, having been a queen for years, wielding countless lives and deaths, she naturally carried a prestige and commanding presence of life and death.
Her feelings towards Da and Xiao Wu had unknowingly transformed, while her sentiments for Guo Jing, Guo Fu, and other family members remained unchanged.

Ultimately, it was Da and Xiao Wu’s lack of progress, being consistently inferior to Yang Guo, Long Qie, Xiaang Wentian, not to mention becoming puppets of Guo Fu, listening obediently to her every command.
For such brothers, Huang Rong was helpless, and upon hearing of their misfortune, she felt an inner calm, as she had long foreseen this day might come.
She had advised the Da and Xiao Wu brothers.
But how could good advice persuade those destined for demise?
Given the situation, she could only try to manage the aftermath!
Guo Jing, however, being more simple and honest than Huang Rong, felt deep sorrow upon the plight of Da and Xiao Wu, regretting deeply.
Huang Rong could only offer comfort beside him.
On this day.
The couple arrived at the Imperial City.
Without cleansing themselves, their priority was to visit Ding Ling.
Ding Ling received them.
Both immediately pleaded for forgiveness, hoping Ding Ling would excuse Guo Fu’s disrespect.
Ding Ling said:
“Don’t worry. I long stopped fussing over this matter. There’s no need for such panic, just go about your duties.”
These words were indeed true.
Da and Xiao Wu brothers are living corpses, and Guo Fu has already lost face.
He was merely Yang Guo’s uncle-in-law, Guo Fu hadn’t provoked him directly, so how could he continue to hold onto this matter.
However, Huang Rong, being meticulous, still worried and pleaded repeatedly until she was certain that Ding Ling truly didn’t care about the matter, finally easing her anxiety.

chapters.title: Chapter 865: Reprimand
paragraphs: Afterwards, Huang Rong expressed her desire to invite Ding Ling and his wife to the Imperial Palace for a banquet soon, hoping they would honor the invitation.
Ding Ling nodded in agreement.
Only then did Huang Rong and the Guo Jing couple take their leave.
Upon returning to the Imperial Palace.
Huang Rong immediately found Guo Fu hiding in the Little Princess Guo Xiang’s boudoir, and said angrily:
“Do you know what you’ve done?! How old are you?! Why are you still causing trouble like a child? Where is your demeanor as the Eldest Princess? Your etiquette? Your poise?!”
Speaking of etiquette and poise, Guo Fu felt both wronged and angry:

“I was publicly humiliated by Yang Guo, what poise do I have left? I was knocked down by Ding Ling, covered in soup and water, what elegance do I have? You don’t blame Yang Guo, but you blame me instead!”
The more she spoke, the more tears welled up in Guo Fu’s eyes.
Huang Rong laughed in exasperation:

“If not for Ding Ling, do you think you could become the Eldest Princess? If not for him, do you think we could defeat the countless elite armies of the Mongolian nation?! And what is your father’s character? Aren’t you aware? Have you ever thought about the only outcome if our whole family defended Xiangyang against the Mongolian Army? That’s a family doomed to die!
Even if you escaped. Can you elude the Mongolian Army’s pursuit?
With the help of the self-serving Alien, even if you escape to the ends of the earth, you’ll be captured and killed by the Mongolian Army!
And during the escape, do you think you could still lead the luxurious life of the Eldest Princess, commanding obedience at will?!”
The more Huang Rong spoke, the angrier she became. She glared at Guo Fu, reprimanding:

“You truly have aged but not grown wiser! You’re so grown up. Many daughters have already become mothers, and yet you haven’t married. But still, at Ding Ling’s wedding you caused such a scene in front of everyone. Where do you think that leaves Ding Ling’s dignity?!
You blame Ding Ling for knocking you over. You should be grateful he didn’t kill you directly! Thank Ding Ling for showing mercy!
Do you ever think about what kind of person Ding Ling is?!
A heroic figure who finds defeating millions of troops as easy as eating or drinking!
Invincible across several worlds!
His propensity for killing is beyond our reach!
If he truly intended to kill you, even we wouldn’t be able to save you...”
Guo Fu was no match for Huang Rong.
With just a few words, Huang Rong made Guo Fu turn pale with fright, trembling with fear, she asked timidly:
“Would Ding Ling really, really, really kill me?”
“Humph!”
Huang Rong snorted coldly, saying:

“Now you’re afraid? Go find Ding Ling and plead for forgiveness. Do not return until you have received his forgiveness! Without Ding Ling, you don’t deserve to be the Eldest Princess! You dare to bully Yang Guo due to your status? Who is Yang Guo? His uncle-in-law is Ding Ling! You dare to bully him!
I have told you countless times. Do not quarrel or fight with Yang Guo!
I didn’t expect you not only disobeyed but you’ve escalated the situation! We’ve reached this point now, I think you two are completely impossible. After you obtain Ding Ling’s forgiveness.
I will discuss with Ding Ling about canceling your marriage with Yang Guo.”
Guo Fu was struck like thunder:
“Why?! I don’t want to cancel!”
“Yang Guo will never marry you. You should find another husband!”
“I don’t want to!”
“Then do you want to die?”
“Father, Mother, do you intend to kill your own daughter? You have such a cruel heart.”
Huang Rong reprimanded angrily:

“Since you like Yang Guo, why have you gotten into such a situation with him, why use the Ziwei Soft Sword to stab him, don’t you know how sharp the Ziwei Soft Sword is?! Humph! Lawless, reckless, truly foolish! That’s final.”
“I don’t want it!”
“You may refuse. But only if you can personally obtain Yang Guo’s forgiveness. If he willingly marries you. Your father and I lack the ability to do so.”
“Why? Yang Guo is just a Vice Minister of the Ministry of War?”
“Hehe.”
Huang Rong smiled:

“Haven’t you heard the many legends about Ding Ling in the Lower Realm? With Ding Ling around, do you think Yelv Yan and Yang Guo would find it difficult to ascend to the Upper Realm? It’s just you, uneducated, all these years have passed, with plenty of resources for Martial Dao cultivation provided, you’ve barely made progress, it’s simply a waste of your father’s and my dedicated efforts...”
Huang Rong’s reprimand.
Lasted for over an hour.
Towards the end.
Guo Fu’s eyes were swollen and red, looking pitifully wronged, Huang Rong finally left in a huff.
Before leaving.
She took Guo Xiang with her.

Guo Xiang dared not even breathe loudly, before leaving, she couldn’t help glancing at Guo Fu. Seeing Guo Fu still crying silently, she dared not utter a word, obediently holding Huang Rong’s hand, left the princess’s palace.
As she moved farther away.
Guo Fu seemed as if she could still hear Huang Rong’s admonition to Guo Xiang:

“Xiang’Er, you should never follow your elder sister’s example. Practice martial arts diligently, learn literature, mastering martial arts is the sole path for us martial artists! Besides, as a woman, being educated, understanding, virtuous is also essential...”
Guo Fu heard it, and couldn’t help but feel sad and hurt.
Thinking of her mother’s reprimand, she had to seek willow branches, preparing to apologize to Ding Ling.
It was clear she heeded Huang Rong’s words.
After all, Huang Rong had seldom been this enraged over the years.
Guo Fu was also afraid.
More afraid that Ding Ling would truly settle accounts with her later, and kill her unexpectedly, leaving her with no place to call for help.
She didn’t want to die.
She somewhat overestimated herself.
From beginning to end, Ding Ling didn’t intend to secretly kill her, if he wanted to kill, he would do so openly.
Therefore.
Regarding Guo Fu’s act of seeking forgiveness, he was surprised but chose to let it go.
Guo Fu, having caused such a scene publicly, felt already humiliated. After Ding Ling let it go, she breathed a sigh of relief, choosing to escape hastily.
Every additional second spent in the Prince’s Mansion felt as if she was suffering in hell for a hundred years.
That day.
The Guo Family invited Ding Ling and his wife to a banquet.
Yang Guo and his wife were also among the invited.
Yang Guo originally didn’t want to go, but declined Huang Rong and Guo Jing’s couple invite felt inappropriate, and Ding Ling’s couple also attended, so he went.
In his view.
With Ding Ling there, nothing untoward would happen.
That was indeed the case.
This gathering.
Could only be considered a private banquet between the Guo Family and the Prince’s Mansion.

Although Guo Fu was present, she sat in a corner, not daring to even lift her head to look at Ding Ling, having been reprimanded by Huang Rong and Guo Jing in turn, Guo Jing’s anger even reached the point of hitting her, such an event hadn’t happened before, however foolish Guo Fu was she knew this time things were particularly severe, in this type of venue, especially before Ding Ling, she naturally didn’t dare to be impudent.
Yet occasionally, she couldn’t help but feel envious and jealous when seeing Little Dragon Girl so blissful!
Why does Little Dragon Girl get to be so lucky, gaining the favor of such a great hero and grand figure like Ding Ling?!

“Would Ding Ling really, really, really kill me?”
“Humph!”
Huang Rong snorted coldly, saying:
“Now you’re afraid?
Go find Ding Ling and plead for forgiveness.
Do not return until you have received his forgiveness!
Without Ding Ling, you don’t deserve to be the Eldest Princess!
You dare to bully Yang Guo due to your status?
Who is Yang Guo?
His uncle-in-law is Ding Ling!
You dare to bully him!
I have told you countless times.
Do not quarrel or fight with Yang Guo!
I didn’t expect you not only disobeyed but you’ve escalated the situation!
We’ve reached this point now, I think you two are completely impossible.
After you obtain Ding Ling’s forgiveness.
I will discuss with Ding Ling about canceling your marriage with Yang Guo.”
Guo Fu was struck like thunder:
“Why?!
I don’t want to cancel!”
“Yang Guo will never marry you.
You should find another husband!”
“I don’t want to!”
“Then do you want to die?”
“Father, Mother, do you intend to kill your own daughter?
You have such a cruel heart.”
Huang Rong reprimanded angrily:
“Since you like Yang Guo, why have you gotten into such a situation with him, why use the Ziwei Soft Sword to stab him, don’t you know how sharp the Ziwei Soft Sword is?!
Humph!
Lawless, reckless, truly foolish!
That’s final.”
“I don’t want it!”
“You may refuse.
But only if you can personally obtain Yang Guo’s forgiveness.
If he willingly marries you.
Your father and I lack the ability to do so.”
“Why?
Yang Guo is just a Vice Minister of the Ministry of War?”
“Hehe.”
Huang Rong smiled:
“Haven’t you heard the many legends about Ding Ling in the Lower Realm?
With Ding Ling around, do you think Yelv Yan and Yang Guo would find it difficult to ascend to the Upper Realm?

It’s just you, uneducated, all these years have passed, with plenty of resources for Martial Dao cultivation provided, you’ve barely made progress, it’s simply a waste of your father’s and my dedicated efforts...”
Huang Rong’s reprimand.
Lasted for over an hour.
Towards the end.
Guo Fu’s eyes were swollen and red, looking pitifully wronged, Huang Rong finally left in a huff.
Before leaving.
She took Guo Xiang with her.
Guo Xiang dared not even breathe loudly, before leaving, she couldn’t help glancing at Guo Fu.
Seeing Guo Fu still crying silently, she dared not utter a word, obediently holding Huang Rong’s hand, left the princess’s palace.
As she moved farther away.
Guo Fu seemed as if she could still hear Huang Rong’s admonition to Guo Xiang:
“Xiang’Er, you should never follow your elder sister’s example.
Practice martial arts diligently, learn literature, mastering martial arts is the sole path for us martial artists!
Besides, as a woman, being educated, understanding, virtuous is also essential...”
Guo Fu heard it, and couldn’t help but feel sad and hurt.
Thinking of her mother’s reprimand, she had to seek willow branches, preparing to apologize to Ding Ling.
It was clear she heeded Huang Rong’s words.
After all, Huang Rong had seldom been this enraged over the years.
Guo Fu was also afraid.
More afraid that Ding Ling would truly settle accounts with her later, and kill her unexpectedly, leaving her with no place to call for help.
She didn’t want to die.
She somewhat overestimated herself.
From beginning to end, Ding Ling didn’t intend to secretly kill her, if he wanted to kill, he would do so openly.
Therefore.
Regarding Guo Fu’s act of seeking forgiveness, he was surprised but chose to let it go.
Guo Fu, having caused such a scene publicly, felt already humiliated.
After Ding Ling let it go, she breathed a sigh of relief, choosing to escape hastily.
Every additional second spent in the Prince’s Mansion felt as if she was suffering in hell for a hundred years.
That day.
The Guo Family invited Ding Ling and his wife to a banquet.
Yang Guo and his wife were also among the invited.
Yang Guo originally didn’t want to go, but declined Huang Rong and Guo Jing’s couple invite felt inappropriate, and Ding Ling’s couple also attended, so he went.
In his view.
With Ding Ling there, nothing untoward would happen.
That was indeed the case.
This gathering.
Could only be considered a private banquet between the Guo Family and the Prince’s Mansion.

Although Guo Fu was present, she sat in a corner, not daring to even lift her head to look at Ding Ling, having been reprimanded by Huang Rong and Guo Jing in turn, Guo Jing’s anger even reached the point of hitting her, such an event hadn’t happened before, however foolish Guo Fu was she knew this time things were particularly severe, in this type of venue, especially before Ding Ling, she naturally didn’t dare to be impudent.
Yet occasionally, she couldn’t help but feel envious and jealous when seeing Little Dragon Girl so blissful!
Why does Little Dragon Girl get to be so lucky, gaining the favor of such a great hero and grand figure like Ding Ling?!

chapters.title: Chapter 866: Guo Xiang
paragraphs: Why can’t Guo Fu receive such heroic favor?!
Even the Yang Guo she fancied was a worthless boy who compared poorly to Ding Ling. She didn’t despise him, yet he abandoned her for a lowly foreign race girl!
Thinking more.
The more discontent Guo Fu felt in her heart.
She had been jealous of Little Dragon Girl years ago and naturally considered marrying a peerless hero like Ding Ling!
But it was evident this was unrealistic.
A character like Ding Ling is rarely seen in a thousand years, he already has someone, and seems to look down on her, so she naturally has no chance.
Choosing the lesser Yang Guo was barely acceptable.
But the most difficult thing was that even the lesser dared to openly humiliate her.
Compare Little Dragon Girl’s current happy, joyous situation.
Guo Fu’s envy and jealousy surged in her heart, threatening to overwhelm her, her eyes nearly reddened!
Guo Xiang saw her and softly comforted her:
“Big sister, don’t be sad. Even the Great Emperor has forgiven you. Just be careful in the future.”

Guo Fu glanced at Guo Xiang, seeing her eyes like lacquer spots, beautifully snow-white, her face etched with concern, a warm feeling surged in her heart, rubbed her hair, and involuntarily glanced at Little Dragon Girl again, envious, she saw Yang Guo serving Yelv Yan and felt a sharp pang of bitterness once more.
At the moment, she thought the delicacies in her mouth tasteless.
When the banquet ended.
Guo Jing and Huang Rong, along with Guo Xiang and Guo Polu, came to bid Ding Ling farewell.
Furiously hinting at their children.
Guo Xiang, being clever, ran forward, hugging Ding Ling’s leg, looked up at him, her big dewy eyes blinking, speaking crisply:
“Great Emperor, can I go with you?”
“Why do you want to follow me?”
Ding Ling slightly lowered his head to look at Guo Xiang.
She appeared five or six years old, yet was beautiful and graceful, a divine beauty in the making, showing glimpses of her extraordinary future.
Ding Ling felt favorable towards Guo Xiang, for anyone who had watched the Divine Condor television series found it hard not to like this cute little girl.
Moreover, she appeared even younger now, yet more clever, lovable, and pleasing.
“I want to learn martial arts from you. I want to be your disciple.”
Guo Xiang’s cheeks were flushed like rouge:

“My mother said martial arts were the way forward for our Guo Family. My parents are to guard the Great Ming Dynasty and can’t ascend easily to the Upper Realm, probably never to tread the Martial Dao. So they have hope for me. I don’t want to disappoint them. I want to try to find this way through.”
“So young, yet profound.”
Ding Ling turned his gaze, moved, glancing at Huang Rong, saying:
“Looks like the Empress spared no effort in her upbringing.”
‘Xiang’Er is naturally intelligent, rarely gifted. Divine Child since youth. As such, her knowledge at such a young age is not unusual.’
Huang Rong seemed quite relieved, having raised an impulsive, reckless, naive Guo Fu troubled her greatly; Guo Xiang provided immense solace:
“Hope the Great Emperor agrees to let Xiang’Er learn martial arts with you.”
Speaking, she prepared to bow.
Ding Ling stopped her, saying:
‘Alright, let Guo Xiang stay with me for a while. After some time, I’ll leave this world. Then you can continue to personally cultivate Guo Xiang.’
“Thank you, Great Emperor.”
Huang Rong was overjoyed, quickly pulling Guo Xiang to bow together.
Ding Ling didn’t mention Guo Polu.
Huang Rong dared not pursue, fearing greed would provoke Ding Ling’s dislike.
An astute woman, aware when to stop.
“Let’s go.”
Ding Ling took Guo Xiang away.
Guo Xiang obediently followed, her legs short, walking slowly, needing to run to catch up.
Occasionally turning to look at Huang Rong.
Receiving her encouraging gaze, Guo Xiang gathered courage, ran behind Ding Ling with short strides again:
“Great Emperor, Great Emperor, can I call you Master from now?”
“Yes.”
“Master, Master, do I start learning martial arts today?”
“As you wish.”
“Master, I want to start today.”
Fragmented, crisp child voice echoed through the air, entering Huang Rong’s ears.
Huang Rong, both excited and relieved, couldn’t help but sigh:
“If only all three children were as worry-free as Xiang’Er.”
“Hehe.”
Guo Jing’s stern face finally revealed a small smile:

“To be accepted as a disciple by the Great Emperor is truly fortunate for three lifetimes. Thanks to ancestors’ blessings. Imagine how happy father-in-law and master must be to know Xiang’Er has found such an excellent teacher.”
“My father and Elder have ascended to the Upper Realm years ago; we’ve never heard from them, unsure of their situation.”
“Let’s ask the alien to inquire. Plenty of benefits should encourage them to find father-in-law.”
Upon returning to the Prince’s Mansion.

Ding Ling used the Empowerment Method, opening the Eight Meridians for Yang Guo, Yelv Yan, and Guo Xiang, forcibly using Martial Arts True Qi to advance their cultivation to the Realm of Innate Perfection!
With Ding Ling’s prowess growing daily.
His Dharma Transmission Skill was smooth, empowering Yang Guo and the others took little time, completing it within moments.
“What?!?”
Yang Guo was shocked.
Yelv Yan’s limbs trembled, feeling as if she were in a dream, knowing how difficult cultivation is for martial artists, often taking years to advance only a small step.
Yet Ding Ling?
Almost instantly helped her reach her dreamed cultivation realm! This felt like a beggar suddenly becoming wealthy! Unreal!
Though young, Guo Xiang was bright and clever, shocked by her transformation, exclaimed loudly:
“Master, amazing, amazing! Is martial arts so fast?! Why is it entirely different from what my parents said!”
Guo Xiang had begun learning martial arts and reciting Secret Manuals at a young age.
Regarding Martial Dao.

She was not ignorant, even saying since she memorized numerous Martial Arts Secret Manuals, frequently immersed in the Royal Library, her understanding of Martial Dao surpassed ordinary second or third-rate martial artists in Jianghu.
Understanding Martial Dao’s difficulty.
She listened intently to Huang Rong.

Yet contrary to her impression, after years training struggling beyond third-rate, suddenly she traversed third-rate, second-rate, first-rate, half-step innate threshold, reaching the Realm of Innate Perfection!
Unthinkable, like a fairy tale.
Naturally eliciting her exclamations, shocking reactions, a child like her didn’t know restraint; ecstatic, couldn’t help but run around, releasing joyous emotions.

chapters.title: Chapter 867: Little Dragon Girl's Progress
paragraphs: In that moment.
In the Main Hall of the Prince’s Mansion, a small figure was circling like lightning, and by the end she was even stirring up sharp whooshing sounds as she tore through the air.
A glimpse through a tube.
One could tell how high her cultivation was, and how extraordinary her body technique.

Ding Ling recognized the body technique she was using; it was the Spiral Nine Shadows. He guessed she had learned it from reciting the Nine Yin Scripture in the Royal Library, and now that all eight meridians in her body were open and she had advanced to Innate Perfection, using this body technique again naturally made her fast as a Phantom, impossible for ordinary eyes to make out.
Whoosh!
Guo Xiang came to a sudden stop in front of Ding Ling, her delicate little face filled with excitement:
“Master, Master, it’s really so fast, so fast! I feel like I’ve really become a peerless Martial Arts expert!”
She bounced with joy:

“My father and mother don’t seem as fast as me. Incredible, incredible. In just a brief instant, I’ve become a great expert. If Father, Mother, Elder Sister and Younger Brother find out, won’t they be jealous of me to death?!”
Speaking of this, she looked at Ding Ling with utter worship on her face:
“Thank you, Master. Master, you’re so good to me. In the future I’ll definitely be filial to you. I’ll definitely treat you well!”
At such a young age, how could she understand any kind of routine?
Besides, Ding Ling’s Observing People Skill was Full Level; with one glance he could see that Guo Xiang was indeed speaking from the bottom of her heart right now.
But he didn’t take it too much to heart either; he only smiled and glanced at the few people present:

“Stop practicing the cultivation techniques you cultivated before. From now on, cultivate the Martial Dao True Understanding I’ve passed on to you! Once this cultivation technique is trained to Great Perfection, it can easily add twenty thousand years to your lifespan. Cultivate it well, and you’ll surely have bright futures ahead. Now, listen as I explain the Esoteric Truth of this technique’s mantra...”
Ding Ling began explaining in a torrent of words.

Yang Guo and Yelv Yan knew this was a peerless opportunity. If they missed it, they’d regret it for the rest of their lives. They forcibly suppressed the surging waves in their hearts and listened carefully.
The more they listened.
The more intoxicated they became.
Their hearts rolled up endless towering waves along with it!
Because this Martial Dao True Understanding was simply too inconceivable—an ultimate method that seemed able to directly ascend to the Immortal Sect!
A technique like this—let alone actually having it, they had never even heard anyone mention such a thing.
Any technique that could be cultivated to the Grandmaster Realm was already treated as a precious treasure!
As for a technique that could directly ascend to the Celestial Palace Immortal Sect, how priceless it was went without saying!

Yang Guo and Yelv Yan were deeply moved; their recognition, gratitude, and worship of Ding Ling shot up in a rush. The two of them secretly decided that whatever their uncle asked them to do in the future, as long as it didn’t violate their principles, they would go all out to accomplish it! Even if it meant staking their lives, they would complete whatever their uncle wanted them to do!

Guo Xiang was young, but after listening to just half, she already felt the vastness and profundity and boundless mysteries within this Martial Dao True Understanding, surpassing the Nine Yin Scripture by who knew how many times. Her big, watery eyes couldn’t help but go round as saucers as she thought:

“When I go back and tell Father and Mother about all this, how shocked and happy will they be? And I wonder if Elder Sister will be envious and jealous of me when she finds out? If Elder Sister would get jealous, then I won’t tell her; I’ll just tell Father and Mother and let them be happy.”
Little Dragon Girl and Ding Ling were husband and wife, and her devotion to Ding Ling was firm as gold; there was no need to say more.
Time flowed like water.
In the blink of an eye.
Three months had already passed.

Ding Ling didn’t step out the door. By day, he guided the others in cultivating the Martial Dao True Understanding; by night, he and Little Dragon Girl cultivated the Divine Technique that only a husband and wife could practice together, and this Divine Technique easily helped Little Dragon Girl’s cultivation surge forward at a tremendous pace.
It was visible to the naked eye.
Little Dragon Girl’s cultivation soared all the way up through Grandmaster, Great Grandmaster, and Shattered!
When she reached Shattered Perfection.
The aura she casually let leak out was like a great mountain dropping out of the sky, as if it could easily crush a master at Innate Perfection!
Yang Guo, Yelv Yan, and Guo Xiang all sensed it and were indescribably shocked:
“This?!”
They were intensely curious.
Guo Xiang spoke quickly and crisply asked:

“Master, Master, why is it that Madam is cultivating the same Martial Dao True Understanding as us, yet her progress is so fast? We’ve been cultivating for three months and only moved forward a small step, reaching the flawless state of Innate Great Perfection. Why is Madam different? Right now she gives me a feeling of being incredibly strong and fierce, like she could crush me to death with a single finger. Master, is that just my imagination?”
Yang Guo and Yelv Yan turned their heads, unable to stop their eyes from gleaming as they looked at Ding Ling, the confusion in them so intense.
Before Ding Ling could speak.
Little Dragon Girl blushed and said:
“It’s because your Master used a special technique to help me break the shackles of this world step by step—that’s how I reached this realm.”
“Then I want Master to help me too.”
Little Dragon Girl waved her hand:
“That won’t do; you’re too young. Wait until you’re of age and grown up, then we’ll talk.”
“Oh.”
Guo Xiang pouted:
“So it’s because I’m too young.”
She suddenly pointed at Yang Guo and Yelv Yan:
“Then why can’t they either?”
“They’re a married couple. Of course they can’t.”
“Eh.”
Guo Xiang’s eyes spun around, then she clapped her little hands:
“I get it. You have to become Master’s wife for it to work, right?”
“Smart.”
Little Dragon Girl’s features were cool and aloof, but her heart was clear and bright, with nothing she felt she couldn’t say to others. Her temperament was extremely gentle:
“That’s exactly it.”
Ding Ling stayed in the World of Divine Condor for a few more months.
Then he chose to leave.
Little Dragon Girl left together with him.
In Little Dragon Girl’s eyes, there was nothing in this world worth her attachment; Ding Ling was her world, her everything.
Originally she still thought about Yang Guo—after all, she had promised Granny Sunx that she would look after Yang Guo for a lifetime.
But after this half year.
Yang Guo had already attained the Grandmaster Realm, and with the Martial Dao True Understanding protecting his body, he was already invincible in the human world!
There was no one who could hurt him!
Little Dragon Girl herself was cultivating the Martial Dao True Understanding and naturally knew how powerful it was.
It could resolve severe poisons, automatically repair the body, keep one forever youthful, grant immortality, cloak the body in Vajra protection...
With such a technique.
And with Yelv Yan’s companionship.
Little Dragon Girl was naturally at ease, determined to leave this world together with Ding Ling, and there was no reason for Ding Ling to refuse.
For Little Dragon Girl to stay in this world really was a waste of time; she ought to go to a more advanced world.
The two of them bid farewell to Yang Guo, Yelv Yan, and Guo Xiang in the Prince’s Mansion.
“Master, Madam, I can’t bear to part with you.”
Guo Xiang’s eyes were brimming with tears as she tugged at Ding Ling’s trouser leg, raising her head to look up at him:
“Can’t you not leave? I want to train every day with you both.”
This half year.
Had been the happiest time in Guo Xiang’s life.
Only because in the Prince’s Mansion nobody constrained her, and everyone got along harmoniously.

Moreover, cultivating the Martial Dao True Understanding and feeling herself improve every moment made it impossible for her to stop. Now Ding Ling was leaving, and with no one to guide her cultivation of the Martial Dao True Understanding, her progress would naturally plummet.
That was secondary.

Time flowed like water.
In the blink of an eye.
Three months had already passed.
Ding Ling didn’t step out the door.

By day, he guided the others in cultivating the Martial Dao True Understanding; by night, he and Little Dragon Girl cultivated the Divine Technique that only a husband and wife could practice together, and this Divine Technique easily helped Little Dragon Girl’s cultivation surge forward at a tremendous pace.
It was visible to the naked eye.
Little Dragon Girl’s cultivation soared all the way up through Grandmaster, Great Grandmaster, and Shattered!
When she reached Shattered Perfection.
The aura she casually let leak out was like a great mountain dropping out of the sky, as if it could easily crush a master at Innate Perfection!
Yang Guo, Yelv Yan, and Guo Xiang all sensed it and were indescribably shocked:
“This?!”
They were intensely curious.
Guo Xiang spoke quickly and crisply asked:
“Master, Master, why is it that Madam is cultivating the same Martial Dao True Understanding as us, yet her progress is so fast?
We’ve been cultivating for three months and only moved forward a small step, reaching the flawless state of Innate Great Perfection.
Why is Madam different?
Right now she gives me a feeling of being incredibly strong and fierce, like she could crush me to death with a single finger.
Master, is that just my imagination?”
Yang Guo and Yelv Yan turned their heads, unable to stop their eyes from gleaming as they looked at Ding Ling, the confusion in them so intense.
Before Ding Ling could speak.
Little Dragon Girl blushed and said:
“It’s because your Master used a special technique to help me break the shackles of this world step by step—that’s how I reached this realm.”
“Then I want Master to help me too.”
Little Dragon Girl waved her hand:
“That won’t do; you’re too young.
Wait until you’re of age and grown up, then we’ll talk.”
“Oh.”
Guo Xiang pouted:
“So it’s because I’m too young.”
She suddenly pointed at Yang Guo and Yelv Yan:
“Then why can’t they either?”
“They’re a married couple.
Of course they can’t.”
“Eh.”
Guo Xiang’s eyes spun around, then she clapped her little hands:
“I get it.
You have to become Master’s wife for it to work, right?”
“Smart.”
Little Dragon Girl’s features were cool and aloof, but her heart was clear and bright, with nothing she felt she couldn’t say to others.
Her temperament was extremely gentle:
“That’s exactly it.”
Ding Ling stayed in the World of Divine Condor for a few more months.
Then he chose to leave.
Little Dragon Girl left together with him.
In Little Dragon Girl’s eyes, there was nothing in this world worth her attachment; Ding Ling was her world, her everything.
Originally she still thought about Yang Guo—after all, she had promised Granny Sunx that she would look after Yang Guo for a lifetime.
But after this half year.
Yang Guo had already attained the Grandmaster Realm, and with the Martial Dao True Understanding protecting his body, he was already invincible in the human world!
There was no one who could hurt him!
Little Dragon Girl herself was cultivating the Martial Dao True Understanding and naturally knew how powerful it was.
It could resolve severe poisons, automatically repair the body, keep one forever youthful, grant immortality, cloak the body in Vajra protection...
With such a technique.
And with Yelv Yan’s companionship.
Little Dragon Girl was naturally at ease, determined to leave this world together with Ding Ling, and there was no reason for Ding Ling to refuse.
For Little Dragon Girl to stay in this world really was a waste of time; she ought to go to a more advanced world.
The two of them bid farewell to Yang Guo, Yelv Yan, and Guo Xiang in the Prince’s Mansion.
“Master, Madam, I can’t bear to part with you.”
Guo Xiang’s eyes were brimming with tears as she tugged at Ding Ling’s trouser leg, raising her head to look up at him:
“Can’t you not leave?
I want to train every day with you both.”
This half year.
Had been the happiest time in Guo Xiang’s life.
Only because in the Prince’s Mansion nobody constrained her, and everyone got along harmoniously.
Moreover, cultivating the Martial Dao True Understanding and feeling herself improve every moment made it impossible for her to stop.
Now Ding Ling was leaving, and with no one to guide her cultivation of the Martial Dao True Understanding, her progress would naturally plummet.
That was secondary.

chapters.title: Chapter 868: Farewell
paragraphs: The primary root cause lies in the deep emotional connection between Guo Xiang and the couple, Ding Ling.
Their attachment to her perhaps only comes second to that of her own parents.
It’s understandable to feel reluctant to part.
“There are no eternal banquets in the world.”
Ding Ling smiled and touched Guo Xiang’s little head. This little girl is extremely clever and quirky, obedient and well-behaved, deeply loved by the Ding Ling couple and the Yang Guo couple:
“Xiang’Er, you should stay with your parents for a while. When you grow up and miss your master and mistress, you can naturally ascend to the Upper Realm.”
Ding Ling then advised Yang Guo and the others that if they ascended to the Celestial Dragon Plane, they must find Little Mountain Sea and train by its side!
As for who Little Mountain Sea is, Ding Ling gave a rough idea.
Yang Guo and the others were naturally very surprised, unable to believe that such a little girl like Little Mountain Sea could be so strong, so remarkable.
“I have said all that needs to be said, farewell from now on.”
Ding Ling smiled, waved to Yang Guo and the others, touched Guo Xiang’s head again, and finally took Little Dragon Girl’s hand, stepping into the void and disappearing without a trace.
Even though Guo Xiang, Yang Guo couple have already reached the Grandmaster Realm, they still could not see how Ding Ling and the couple left.
The three looked at each other, clearly seeing the shock, admiration, and reverence in each other’s eyes.
“Master just left like that.”
Guo Xiang felt dejected and crestfallen, her little face scrunched up, calling for Master and Mistress, but where is someone to respond?
“It seems they really left.”
Her eyes were teary as if about to cry. Seeing this, the Yang Guo couple comforted her:

“Little Sister, you don’t need to worry about not seeing Aunt and Uncle again. When you grow up, you can naturally search for them. You’ve heard the legend of the Upper Realm too. Surely you understand in your heart, as long as you strive hard, meeting them again in the future is not a problem.”
Because Yelv Yan is also considered a registered disciple.
So she called Guo Xiang Little Sister.
Yang Guo followed Yelv Yan’s lead and called her that too.
“Mm!”
Guo Xiang nodded vigorously, clenched her little fists, and said with determination:
“I will definitely follow in the footsteps of Master and Mistress!”

The Yang Guo couple did not dampen her spirits, but each was thinking in their hearts, chasing Aunt might have a one in a ten thousand chance, chasing Uncle? In this life, and the next, there might never be a chance!
In the eyes of the couple.
Ding Ling seemed like an unparalleled existence akin to a super deity, not like someone from the same dimension or world!
Ding Ling took a step, under his feet, Star Shifting, with a swish, he and Little Dragon Girl stepped onto the Celestial Ladder.
At this time.
There were also some martial artists running upwards on the Celestial Ladder.
Among them were some familiar faces, and there was Xiaang Wentian.
It seems he achieved his wish in the Divine Eagle Plane and felt that there was little more to gain in strength there, so he chose Ascension?
Ding Ling had no intention of going down to communicate with Xiaang Wentian, swiftly bypassing him, leaping directly to the end of the Celestial Ladder, standing before the Gate of Glory.
“Is this the Gate of Glory?”
Little Dragon Girl asked curiously.
“Indeed.”
Ding Ling looked at the three great paths within the gate: Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber, The Generation’s Twin Heroes, and Celestial Dragon Eight Books, then turned to Little Dragon Girl:

“You go first. I will watch you from here. If you go to the Celestial Dragon Plane, remember to find Little Mountain Sea and train earnestly. If you go to another plane, just climb the Heaven-Ascending Ladder again to reach an even higher world, remember to be cautious and act low-key...”
Ding Ling advised Little Dragon Girl once more.
Under his help, Little Dragon Girl’s cultivation had already reached the Shattering Great Perfection level, just a step away from the Martial Arts Golden Core.
Because Ding Ling himself was only at the Half-Step Primordial Spirit Realm, he was unable to assist Little Dragon Girl in advancing into the Golden Core Realm. She must rely on herself.
In order for Little Dragon Girl to live smoothly in other worlds.
Ding Ling even took her to disguise as ordinary people, visiting other cities.
Only when Little Dragon Girl knew how to interact normally with people did Ding Ling feel slightly at ease.
“Husband. Can we meet again?”
Little Dragon Girl was unwilling to part with Ding Ling.
“Certainly.”
Ding Ling replied with certainty:
“It’s easy to find out about me. Just inquire with the Alien.”
After some exchanges.
Little Dragon Girl reluctantly stepped into the Gate of Glory, turning back every few steps, until a ray swept over, whoosh!
Sweeping Little Dragon Girl into the Celestial Dragon Plane.
Seeing this, Ding Ling breathed a sigh of relief and followed into the Celestial Dragon Plane.

Upon reaching the Celestial Dragon Plane, his Divine Meditation Technique illuminated, and within moments, found Little Dragon Girl’s presence, followed her for a while, observing her successfully connecting with Little Mountain Sea and Zhong Ling, only then did Ding Ling quietly leave.
This time he chose to ascend directly to the Heaven-Ascending Ladder, entering the Wind and Cloud Plane, returning to the Imperial Palace!
Time flows back.
Divine Eagle Plane.
Guo Xiang bid farewell to the Yang Guo couple, walked out of the Prince’s Mansion alone, heading towards the Imperial Palace.

She appeared like a little five or six-year-old child, adorably charming, evoking pity, some traffickers saw her, not recognizing her as the Little Princess, thus harboring sinister intentions, wanting to abduct her, purposely calling her over, offering her candied haw to eat.

Guo Xiang, after all, is still a little girl, unable to resist the temptation of candied haw, so she ate a few sticks, after consuming this sweet and sour treat, the melancholy and depression in her heart dissipated a fair bit.
After all, a little girl inherently cheerful.
With the dispelling of dejection, her face was adorned with more smiles, occasionally expressing gratitude for the uncle’s candied haw.

Traffickers are usually vicious and ruthless, though the little girl was increasingly endearing, they showed no mercy, luring Guo Xiang into a deserted corner, then took out a burlap sack, quickly ensnaring her, and with a chop to the neck ensured she was incapacitated, then attempted to flee.
Yet in the next moment.
The burlap sack tore open, the trafficker was sent flying ten meters away by a small foot, tumbling on the ground, knocking out a few teeth before coming to a stop.
The trafficker looked at Guo Xiang in disbelief:
“You, you, little girl, how could you...”
“Hmph.”
Guo Xiang was furious, her face as red as an apple engraved with anger, pointing at the trafficker:
“You’re a bad guy!”
She realized what the trafficker was:
“I will capture you all!”
The trafficker was merely a second-rate or third-rate martial artist, priding himself on having formidable Palm Power, thinking capturing a child was a piece of cake.

Moreover, his Lightweight Skill was first-class, excellent for escape, not heeding Guo Xiang’s words, but he had indeed witnessed her prowess, unwilling to contend with Guo Xiang in broad daylight, glared balefully at her, then attempted to flee.
