chapters.title: Chapter 869: Guo Xiang's Showcase
paragraphs: Guo Xiang leaped swiftly, her body transformed into nine spiral silhouettes, and in a blink, she was in front of the human traffickers, then delivered a powerful kick.
Smack!
Within just a few rounds, Guo Xiang had knocked out the two traffickers, then carried them with one hand each, and using her Lightweight Skill, ran wildly down the street.
Countless people were stunned along the way.
Among these people were also players, who exclaimed in surprise upon witnessing the scene:
“Who is that little girl, to have such speed and skill?!”
“Unbelievable! Judging by her deft maneuvers and Lightweight Skill, she must have reached the Innate Realm?!”

“Ordinary Innate Experts would find it difficult to achieve such extraordinary and clever capture techniques. And she looks no more than five or six years old, how can she be so powerful? Who exactly is she?!”
Ultimately, it’s because players have sources of information.
A moment later.
The news that the little girl was the Little Princess Guo Xiang spread through the Imperial City, causing an uproar and astonishment.
Once it was confirmed that Guo Xiang had apprenticed under Ding Ling, people realized suddenly, feeling both enlightened and relieved:

“So she’s the disciple of the Immortal Realm Emperor Ding Ling, that makes sense now! It’s said that Qu Feiyan, Taishi Ci, Fan Kuai, Huang Zhonggong, and others progressed smoothly into the Innate Realm with his help. Guo Xiang has been with Ding Ling for more than half a year now, progressing to such a realm is actually normal!”
“But thinking carefully, it’s still absolutely incredible. She’s so young, yet her Cultivation Power has reached a realm that ordinary people could never achieve in a lifetime! I’m so envious!”

“Indeed. People have long said that as long as you hold onto Ding Ling’s coattails, you can definitely soar to great heights, and now numerous vivid examples stand before us, further proving this assertion!”
The Imperial City was full of discussions and excitement!

Players already held Ding Ling in such high regard, and now were even more excited; countless were eager to seek closeness with Ding Ling, but thinking of Ding Ling’s aloof demeanor, they sighed deeply.
Wanting to get close to Ding Ling and make friends with him is too difficult.
Let’s put it this way.
From a player’s perspective, becoming confidants with Cao Mengde is easier than becoming ordinary friends with Ding Ling!
It’s because the game has been in operation for over ten years now.
In such a long period.
There have been no small number of players who became confidants and close friends with Cao Mengde, but as for those who became friends with Ding Ling?
None!!
Not one!
The difficulty level is not just heaven-defying, it’s practically at the Hell Level!
Guo Xiang handed the two traffickers over to the relevant authorities.
Upon learning of her return, Guo Fu was the first to find her and tested her martial arts face-to-face.
Initially, Guo Xiang only knew how to dodge.
Guo Fu saw this and crossed her arms, saying with disdain:
“Is this the result of Ding Ling’s teaching for over half a year? Considering he’s the Immortal Realm Emperor, he’s just so-so.”

This angered Guo Xiang, who couldn’t help but turn and matched Guo Fu’s palm strike. It was a single strike, but with a bang, Guo Fu screamed miserably, vomiting blood and tumbling back dozens of yards.
“Oh no!”
Guo Xiang was horrified, her face full of fear, and quickly ran to Guo Fu, catching her before she hit the ground:
“Big sister, are you okay?”
She carefully laid Guo Fu on the grass nearby, feeling both aggrieved and apologetic:
“I didn’t mean to.”
“You, you, cough cough...”
Guo Fu, feeling both angry and hurt, pointed at Guo Xiang, uttered two words, then couldn’t refrain from spitting out two mouthfuls of fresh blood.
Guo Xiang turned pale.
Just then, Guo Jing and Huang Rong arrived with Guo Polu. Knowing that Guo Xiang returned today, they were extremely happy and came to see Guo Xiang’s progress from her cultivation.
Unexpectedly.
From afar, they saw the scene where Guo Fu was struck and sent flying by Guo Xiang.
They were stunned, and couldn’t help but speed up to get closer; upon seeing Guo Fu’s severely injured state, Huang Rong couldn’t help but glare at Guo Xiang.
Guo Xiang pleaded:
“I can heal big sister, please don’t be upset, Father and Mother.”
“Then hurry and heal her.”
Guo Jing approached and inspected carefully; finding the domineering True Qi rampaging through Guo Fu’s Meridians Dantian, he was shocked.
Only because he could do nothing about this True Qi, upon hearing Guo Xiang had a solution, he turned his head and said:
“Quickly try it.”
“Yes.”

Guo Xiang stepped forward and first used the Martial Dao True Understanding’s method of absorption to reabsorb Martial Dao True Understanding back into her Dantian, then employed the Martial Arts True Qi’s strong healing ability to repair Guo Fu’s Meridians Dantian.
Guo Fu, who initially seemed about to breathe her last, actually recovered visibly.
In just moments.
She not only completely recovered, but also healed some minor issues left from practicing martial arts within her Dantian and Meridians.
Guo Jing perceived carefully and couldn’t help but be shocked, detailing what he observed.
Huang Rong and Guo Fu were also astonished and moved.
Huang Rong asked:
“Xiang’Er, is this the method your master taught you?”
“Yes, Mother.”
Guo Xiang replied crisply:
“Master is amazing. The day I returned with Master to the Prince’s Mansion, Master immediately used the Empowerment Method to open the Eight Meridians in my body...”
Guo Xiang did not hold back at all.
She recounted her experiences over the past six months in detail.
As they listened.
Huang Rong, Guo Jing, Guo Fu, and Guo Polu couldn’t help but become more shocked and envious.
By the end.
Huang Rong and Guo Jing were filled with admiration and gratitude towards Ding Ling:
“For the Great Emperor to assist Xiang’Er like this, it might be difficult to repay him in this lifetime!”
They looked at Guo Xiang:
“Xiang’Er, you should train well, and in the future, you must honor your word, treat your master well, and do not disappoint his training!”
“Hmm!”
Guo Xiang earnestly nodded her little head:
“I will.”

Guo Fu watched beside them, filled with envy and jealousy; her own little sister had soared to the heavens, leaping to greatness! At such a young age, she’d reached a degree of strength able to crush and defeat her with a finger!
And her?
How many years had she diligently cultivated?! Her Martial Arts remained at a Second-class Level, neither rising nor falling, it hadn’t been noticeable before without comparison.
Now comparing with Guo Xiang.
Her confidence and self-esteem suffered greatly!
She could not accept this!
Especially thinking that even that wretched woman Yelv Yan had obtained such a lucky chance, becoming a Grandmaster Level figure, she was even more furious!
For this opportunity should have belonged to her!
If she had married Yang Guo, then Ding Ling would be her uncle!
By then, who would dare to bully her, Guo Fu?!
And surely Ding Ling would have trained her intensively, making her Cultivation Power ascend to the top of this world, keeping all beneath her! Even her parents might not be able to defeat her!
Just thinking about it made her yearn and excited. But realizing all had been ruined by Yelv Yan, her hatred for Yelv Yan, at this moment, was deeper than ever!

They were stunned, and couldn’t help but speed up to get closer; upon seeing Guo Fu’s severely injured state, Huang Rong couldn’t help but glare at Guo Xiang.
Guo Xiang pleaded:
“I can heal big sister, please don’t be upset, Father and Mother.”
“Then hurry and heal her.”
Guo Jing approached and inspected carefully; finding the domineering True Qi rampaging through Guo Fu’s Meridians Dantian, he was shocked.
Only because he could do nothing about this True Qi, upon hearing Guo Xiang had a solution, he turned his head and said:
“Quickly try it.”
“Yes.”

Guo Xiang stepped forward and first used the Martial Dao True Understanding’s method of absorption to reabsorb Martial Dao True Understanding back into her Dantian, then employed the Martial Arts True Qi’s strong healing ability to repair Guo Fu’s Meridians Dantian.
Guo Fu, who initially seemed about to breathe her last, actually recovered visibly.
In just moments.
She not only completely recovered, but also healed some minor issues left from practicing martial arts within her Dantian and Meridians.
Guo Jing perceived carefully and couldn’t help but be shocked, detailing what he observed.
Huang Rong and Guo Fu were also astonished and moved.
Huang Rong asked:
“Xiang’Er, is this the method your master taught you?”
“Yes, Mother.”
Guo Xiang replied crisply:
“Master is amazing.
The day I returned with Master to the Prince’s Mansion, Master immediately used the Empowerment Method to open the Eight Meridians in my body...”
Guo Xiang did not hold back at all.
She recounted her experiences over the past six months in detail.
As they listened.
Huang Rong, Guo Jing, Guo Fu, and Guo Polu couldn’t help but become more shocked and envious.
By the end.
Huang Rong and Guo Jing were filled with admiration and gratitude towards Ding Ling:
“For the Great Emperor to assist Xiang’Er like this, it might be difficult to repay him in this lifetime!”
They looked at Guo Xiang:
“Xiang’Er, you should train well, and in the future, you must honor your word, treat your master well, and do not disappoint his training!”
“Hmm!”
Guo Xiang earnestly nodded her little head:
“I will.”
Guo Fu watched beside them, filled with envy and jealousy; her own little sister had soared to the heavens, leaping to greatness!
At such a young age, she’d reached a degree of strength able to crush and defeat her with a finger!
And her?
How many years had she diligently cultivated?!
Her Martial Arts remained at a Second-class Level, neither rising nor falling, it hadn’t been noticeable before without comparison.
Now comparing with Guo Xiang.
Her confidence and self-esteem suffered greatly!
She could not accept this!
Especially thinking that even that wretched woman Yelv Yan had obtained such a lucky chance, becoming a Grandmaster Level figure, she was even more furious!
For this opportunity should have belonged to her!
If she had married Yang Guo, then Ding Ling would be her uncle!
By then, who would dare to bully her, Guo Fu?!
And surely Ding Ling would have trained her intensively, making her Cultivation Power ascend to the top of this world, keeping all beneath her!
Even her parents might not be able to defeat her!
Just thinking about it made her yearn and excited.
But realizing all had been ruined by Yelv Yan, her hatred for Yelv Yan, at this moment, was deeper than ever!

chapters.title: Chapter 870: The Wind and Cloud Plane Concludes! Top-level Geniuses
paragraphs: Guo Fu was filled with imbalance, her self-esteem bruised, naturally seeking a scapegoat.
Guo Xiang was no match.
Yang Guo couldn’t be hit, nor was he a match.
She could only target Yelv Yan, though she knew she couldn’t beat Yelv Yan now, it didn’t stop her from envying her!
No one knows a daughter like her mother.
Huang Rong, observing from the side, promptly shifted the topic:
“Xiang’Er, why were you fighting with your big sister?”
“It was because big sister insulted my master.”
Guo Xiang, looking pitiful:
“I got angry and didn’t control my strength, so...”
“I understand. It’s not your fault.”
Huang Rong immediately turned to Guo Fu, scolding:

“Fu’Er, how many times have I told you?! Not long ago, I even asked you to apologize personally to Ding Ling. How could you forget so quickly?! How long has it been?! And you dare insult Ding Ling again?! Do you really want to anger your mother to death?!”
“Mother.”
Guo Fu’s expression slightly changed, awkwardly replying:
“I understand. It won’t happen again.”
“And it better not be a next time!”
Huang Rong glared.
“There won’t be, there won’t be. Absolutely no next time.”
Guo Fu, stunningly beautiful, exuded an enchanting presence. Even when pouting in grievance, she appeared pitiful and endearing:
“But I just can’t accept it. I could have been an absolute expert too. It’s all because of that wretched Yelv Yan.”
“You’re still talking?”
Huang Rong gave Guo Fu a fierce glance:

“Who told you not to win Yang Guo’s heart, or Ding Ling’s affection? If you could have won either of their affections, it wouldn’t have come to this! Fine, in the future, you can be the Eldest Princess, train in Martial Dao if possible, and if not, in a few years we’ll find you a husband and you can get married and live a good life.”
“I won’t!”

Guo Fu, having heard from Guo Xiang that cultivating the Martial Dao True Understanding could keep one from aging or dying, easily extending life by twenty thousand years, and if fortunate, achieving immortality, immediately became interested:
“I want to cultivate the Martial Dao True Understanding. I want to practice martial arts.”
Huang Rong couldn’t help but look at Guo Xiang:
“Did your master permit you to pass on the skill to family members?”
“Master said that some parts of Martial Dao True Understanding can be passed to family. If they can learn, more can be shared.”
“The Great Emperor is generous.”
Guo Jing lamented:
“Our family is indebted to him too deeply.”
“Alas.”
Even Huang Rong, skilled in calculations, couldn’t help but nod, clearly agreeing with Guo Jing:
“Favors are hard to repay. If ever there’s a chance for repayment, we must give our all in return!”
She looked at Guo Polu and Guo Xiang:
“It’ll be up to both of you in the future.”
“What about me?”
Guo Fu objected.
Huang Rong was too tired to deal with Guo Fu:

“For now, you’re not allowed to leave the palace. Stay in the Imperial Palace and focus on training the foundational methods of the Martial Dao True Understanding with Xiang’Er. If you can’t even grasp the foundational methods, Xiang’Er, don’t teach your big sister any more of the Martial Dao True Understanding. To avoid her causing more trouble and being taken advantage of by bad people. If things go wrong, our Guo Family couldn’t atone even by dying a hundred times! We cannot let Ding Ling down!”
Guo Fu felt belittled, underestimated. Her pride once more suffered a heavy blow!
But soon, she thought of a retort:

“Sister received personal instruction and guidance from Ding Ling, which allowed her rapid advancements. And me? I have to learn from my sister. Such treatment is worlds apart; isn’t it normal that I can’t be like my sister? Father, Mother, you can’t say that about me!”
“You still have the nerve to argue?!”
The Divine Eagle Plane wouldn’t cease its open and secret ‘struggle’ just because Ding Ling and Little Dragon Girl were absent.
On the contrary.
With Ding Ling’s departure.
The undercurrents became even more turbulent.
Yet, after a few interventions by Yang Guo couple, making people realize that the Great Ming Dynasty still had such unparalleled experts, some undercurrents also dissipated.

But the conflict between Yang Guo couple and Guo Fu had reached an irreconcilable, unsolvable stage. Even with Ding Ling suppressing and deterring from behind, their differing worldviews and past conflicts still existed, which was a fact.
Upon realizing this, the Yang Guo couple, after several discussions, eventually chose to leave the Divine Eagle Plane and head to the Upper Realm after staying for some time.
With the continuous loss of various National Guardian level experts, the Great Ming Dynasty seemed increasingly precarious.

If it wasn’t for Ding Ling’s disciple Guo Xiang repeatedly appearing at various places with absolute martial prowess, intimidating the ten directions, the Great Ming Dynasty would certainly have fallen into a passive situation once again.
At least it wouldn’t be as peaceful and prosperous as it is now!
And Guo Xiang’s few interventions.
Yet further proved Ding Ling’s unrivaled nature.

This greatly increased the player’s, natives’, and ascenders’ admiration and awe for Ding Ling. Considering Guo family’s connection with Ding Ling, many groups of players, natives, and ascenders who wanted to stir trouble in the Great Ming Dynasty all withdrew.
They couldn’t bear to think about what would happen if Ding Ling descended again to cleanse them, and whether they could escape Ding Ling’s ‘clutches’.
The mere thought of it sent shivers down their spines!
Thus.
They turned their focus to other worlds.
Upon learning the truth, the Guo Jing couple felt not only happiness and pride for having Ding Ling as the backing of the Great Ming Dynasty!
Of course.
More so, gratitude and reverence!
After returning to the Wind and Cloud Plane, Ding Ling didn’t interact much with others, spending every day with Little Zhao, cultivating the magic and skill between spouses.
On this particular day.
Ding Ling and Little Zhao, along with others, headed to the Ten-Mile Pavilion outside Chang’an City.
Choosing this location again.
Was naturally for the consideration of friends and family.
Not wishing for them to be in the dark, unable to find the Celestial Ladder’s point.

chapters.title: Chapter 871: End of the Wind and Cloud Plane! Top-tier Genius_2
paragraphs: Along with him, there were two Qilin Horses on the journey.
These two horses were exactly the Ferghana Horses that had been following him for many years.
After devouring all the Qilin Eggs and various Great Medicines, having been baptized by Martial Arts True Qi.
They have already transformed to the Grandmaster Peak Level. Just a step away from breaking through.
From this, it can be seen.
Little Zhao often invested resources in them.
Especially the cleansing of Martial Arts True Qi—this was evidently Little Zhao’s doing. It was her years of continuous assistance.
That made the potential of the two Qilin Horses so high, unmatched by ordinary fierce beasts, with an aura far stronger than Grandmaster Peak masters of the same level.
[Mission overachieved! Do you want to claim the Glory Medal now? Proceed to a higher-level Xianxia World?]
Ding Ling clicked ‘Yes’!
[Redemption successful!]
[Mission 1. Defeat more than 20 Plane Masters 1531898/20. Obtain Glory Medal, Glory Bonus 76594.9%. Final Glory Medals approximately 766 pieces.]
The reason for such a huge quantity.
Was because the defeated Demon Realm and Sword Realm masters were also counted. Otherwise, it wouldn’t have been this much.
[2, you must defeat the strongest master of the Plane. Prove that you are the rightful World’s Number One. Progress 100%]
[Mission 2. Obtain Glory Medal 1]
[3: You must make your name as World’s Number One resound throughout the Plane World. 100%/100%.]
[Mission 3: Obtain Glory Medal 1]
The final number of Glory Medals obtained was: 768 pieces.
[Glory Medals have been fully settled.]
[Do you want to open the Path of Glory now?]
Ding Ling clicked ‘Yes’!
[The Path of Glory is about to open. Please choose a location to place the Path of Glory.]
[Friendly reminder: The Path of Glory is the Heaven-Reaching Dao...]
Ding Ling didn’t look much further and directly chose the Ten-Mile Ancient Pavilion outside Chang’an City.
[Selection complete. Cannot be changed again!]
Boom!
The next instant.
Various phenomena followed as the Celestial Ladder descended upon the mortal world.
Ding Ling bade farewell to Little Zhao and the others, stepping onto the Celestial Ladder.
Soon after.
He arrived at the Gate of Glory.
[Congratulations to player Ding Ling for being the first to open the portal of the fourth layer of the Martial Hero Plane!]
[As the first to open the fourth layer of the Martial Hero Plane, you will receive the following rewards:]
[1: A Martial Hero Plane World that only you can set foot on!]
[2: A chance to return to the World of Wind and Clouds once.]
[3: Reward free choice of the right to the first layer of Xianxia Plane! Annotation...]
[4: Reward of Ascension items that can be carried: six weapons, six pets...]
The rewards have been upgraded.
Ding Ling had long anticipated this.
Therefore, he had already prepared five weapons in his Storage Pouch: Xuanyuan Sword, Human Emperor Saber, Supreme Sword Pill, Divine Bow, and a Divine Arrow.
The Divine Bow and Divine Arrow were created by Ding Ling using the Profound Lady Sword, fragments of the Immortal Weapon Long Halberd, and some top-grade materials.
Because the tip of the Divine Arrow was crafted from the spearhead of the Immortal Weapon Long Halberd, it was extremely sharp, truly indomitable and remarkable!
Moreover, this Divine Arrow had been refined by Ding Ling using his own essence blood, with a bit of Sword Thought infused into it, so when shot out, it would return automatically, quite impressive.
The Divine Bow was crafted from the body of the Profound Lady Sword, the Immortal Weapon Long Halberd, and others.
“Even though I can bring six weapons, five is enough.”
The Emperor’s Sword, Green Sword, and other Divine Weapons were left to Little Zhao by Ding Ling.
If these Divine Weapons were melted down, it would be too wasteful. Ding Ling would never do such a foolish thing.
“Before they were mounts, now they’re pets, and it seems Poxun Flower is also considered a pet?”
Ding Ling this time chose Poxun Flower, and two Qilin Horses.
A flash of light.
The Qilin Horses had already appeared beside him. They were calm and composed, evidently used to this.
[First layer of Xianxia Plane: Painted Skin, Painted Wall, A Chinese Ghost Story. Please choose one of the three.]
Ding Ling chose A Chinese Ghost Story.
Compared to the other two worlds, it seems A Chinese Ghost Story had more upper limits and opportunities?
[Selection complete. Choice cannot be changed.]
[Do you want to spend 10 Achievement Medals and 1 Glory Medal to open the Gate of Glory?]
Yes!
The medals formed an imprint, opening the Gate of Glory.
What met the eyes were three Heaven-Reaching Dao.
Ding Ling was swept by golden light to the front of the Dao belonging to A Chinese Ghost Story.
With him were the Qilin Horses.
[Player is about to enter the A Chinese Ghost Story Plane World.]
[Before entering, do you wish to exchange for Storage Space? Bone Treasure?]
‘Yes.’
Kaong!
Ding Ling once again saw the familiar Seven-Colored Glazed Chaos Counter.
This time, it was somewhat different from earlier; this time many of the formerly sealed counters were opened.
Thus allowing Ding Ling to see the treasures inside clearly.
Ding Ling knew this was definitely because his deposits had grown enough to afford them.
He glanced at the Character Panel:
[Achievement Medals: Ordinary 529, E-grade 273, D-grade 195, C-grade 15]
The reason there were so many.
Was because there were numerous masters from the Demon Realm and Sword Realm.
Among this, because Ding Ling had exchanged all his power back to reality, it consumed quite a bit; otherwise, the quantity would surely be more.
[Glory Medals: 768]
Previously, 1 remained, 1 was spent opening the Gate of Glory.
“With so many medals, this time I can buy quite a few things.”
Ding Ling walked towards the new counter.
Casting a casual glance.
[King-grade Tier One Pill: 200 Glory Medals]
[King-grade Second-stage Pill: 300 Glory Medals]
“So expensive?!”
Ding Ling raised his brows.
In comparison, a True First-Order Pill only required 5 Achievement Medals.
This King-grade Tier One was somewhat exaggerated.
Ding Ling also looked at the True Second-stage needed 10 medals, Third-stage 20, Fourth-stage 30, and so forth.
He thought for a moment and still decided to purchase the best pills. After all, Glory Medals once obtained are meant to be used.
Therefore, he directly spent 700 Glory Medals to buy a King-grade Tier Six Pill.
One pill in hand.
Ding Ling felt complex emotions.
The quantity of pills here was limited, and King-grade Tier Six was only a single piece.
He ate this one, and others even with Glory Medals couldn’t buy it.
Ding Ling lifted his head and swallowed the pill whole.
Soon a boiling sensation spread through his limbs and body.
Ding Ling felt an itch, pain, and numbness at the same time, and almost like bathing, so comfortable he seemed intoxicated.
After a while.
[Root Bone +70]
[Root Bone: 76]
Ding Ling suddenly opened his eyes.
At this moment.
He felt as if he underwent a fundamental transformation.
Like a wild chicken becoming a phoenix, a carp becoming a dragon!
That indescribable clarity and comfort made him feel as if he was floating on the clouds.
“Is this the feeling of being a peerless genius?!”
Ding Ling felt that his bindings seemed lifted layer by layer.
As if he formerly carried heavy shackles and mountains during ‘cultivation’.
Now those mountains and shackles have been removed.
It is foreseeable.
His cultivation speed in the future would be terrifyingly fast!
Even without cheats.
With his absolute Root Bone, he certainly would become one of the top prodigies!
“So powerful.”
“Worthy of being a King-grade Golden Core!”
Ding Ling exclaimed in praise!
No wonder it requires so many Glory Medals; it is indeed worth the price!
“I previously went through so many worlds, and my Root Bone was only 6 points. Now it’s jumped up a full 70 points! Isn’t this like having cheats?!”
Ding Ling estimated his aptitude for martial arts now definitely doesn’t fall short compared to talents like Feng Qingyang and Yang Guo!
It’s just that his perception and other aspects might be lacking, but his Root Bone is absolutely top-notch!
“There’s still some Glory Medals left, might as well use them all.”
The ability to immediately boost Root Bone.
This for Ding Ling is indeed a great benefit.
Because in the Xianxia World, without strong Root Bone, one might not even be able to cultivate immortality!
Thus.
Root Bone is naturally the stronger, the better.
He then used 60 Glory Medals to purchase a True Seventh-stage Pill.
After swallowing it.
This time, the heat sensation compared to King-grade Pills was almost nonexistent.
But perhaps because it was his first time consuming a True Seventh-stage Pill, the effect was also quite good.
[Root Bone +7]
The second time consuming True Second-stage Pill only increased the Root Bone by 1 point!
Because the pills had resistance.
Seventh-stage Pill could increase 7 points.

This time, it was somewhat different from earlier; this time many of the formerly sealed counters were opened.
Thus allowing Ding Ling to see the treasures inside clearly.
Ding Ling knew this was definitely because his deposits had grown enough to afford them.
He glanced at the Character Panel:
[Achievement Medals: Ordinary 529, E-grade 273, D-grade 195, C-grade 15]
The reason there were so many.
Was because there were numerous masters from the Demon Realm and Sword Realm.
Among this, because Ding Ling had exchanged all his power back to reality, it consumed quite a bit; otherwise, the quantity would surely be more.
[Glory Medals: 768]
Previously, 1 remained, 1 was spent opening the Gate of Glory.
“With so many medals, this time I can buy quite a few things.”
Ding Ling walked towards the new counter.
Casting a casual glance.
[King-grade Tier One Pill: 200 Glory Medals]
[King-grade Second-stage Pill: 300 Glory Medals]
“So expensive?!”
Ding Ling raised his brows.
In comparison, a True First-Order Pill only required 5 Achievement Medals.
This King-grade Tier One was somewhat exaggerated.
Ding Ling also looked at the True Second-stage needed 10 medals, Third-stage 20, Fourth-stage 30, and so forth.
He thought for a moment and still decided to purchase the best pills.
After all, Glory Medals once obtained are meant to be used.
Therefore, he directly spent 700 Glory Medals to buy a King-grade Tier Six Pill.
One pill in hand.
Ding Ling felt complex emotions.
The quantity of pills here was limited, and King-grade Tier Six was only a single piece.
He ate this one, and others even with Glory Medals couldn’t buy it.
Ding Ling lifted his head and swallowed the pill whole.
Soon a boiling sensation spread through his limbs and body.
Ding Ling felt an itch, pain, and numbness at the same time, and almost like bathing, so comfortable he seemed intoxicated.
After a while.
[Root Bone +70]
[Root Bone: 76]
Ding Ling suddenly opened his eyes.
At this moment.
He felt as if he underwent a fundamental transformation.
Like a wild chicken becoming a phoenix, a carp becoming a dragon!
That indescribable clarity and comfort made him feel as if he was floating on the clouds.
“Is this the feeling of being a peerless genius?!”
Ding Ling felt that his bindings seemed lifted layer by layer.
As if he formerly carried heavy shackles and mountains during ‘cultivation’.
Now those mountains and shackles have been removed.
It is foreseeable.
His cultivation speed in the future would be terrifyingly fast!
Even without cheats.
With his absolute Root Bone, he certainly would become one of the top prodigies!
“So powerful.”
“Worthy of being a King-grade Golden Core!”
Ding Ling exclaimed in praise!
No wonder it requires so many Glory Medals; it is indeed worth the price!
“I previously went through so many worlds, and my Root Bone was only 6 points.
Now it’s jumped up a full 70 points!
Isn’t this like having cheats?!”
Ding Ling estimated his aptitude for martial arts now definitely doesn’t fall short compared to talents like Feng Qingyang and Yang Guo!
It’s just that his perception and other aspects might be lacking, but his Root Bone is absolutely top-notch!
“There’s still some Glory Medals left, might as well use them all.”
The ability to immediately boost Root Bone.
This for Ding Ling is indeed a great benefit.
Because in the Xianxia World, without strong Root Bone, one might not even be able to cultivate immortality!
Thus.
Root Bone is naturally the stronger, the better.
He then used 60 Glory Medals to purchase a True Seventh-stage Pill.
After swallowing it.
This time, the heat sensation compared to King-grade Pills was almost nonexistent.
But perhaps because it was his first time consuming a True Seventh-stage Pill, the effect was also quite good.
[Root Bone +7]
The second time consuming True Second-stage Pill only increased the Root Bone by 1 point!
Because the pills had resistance.
Seventh-stage Pill could increase 7 points.

chapters.title: Chapter 872: Storage Ring
paragraphs: For Ding Ling, this was also acceptable.
[Constitution: 83]
Broke through the 80 Attribute Points threshold.
Ding Ling felt as if another heavy shackle had fallen off him, and his whole being was light as if he were stepping on clouds.
He took a breath and discovered that his speed of cultivating the Martial Dao True Understanding had once again climbed!
“Am I now on par with geniuses like Zhao Zilong and Huang the Herbalist?!”
The talents of Zhao Zilong and Huang the Herbalist are considered among the very best.
Ding Ling estimated their constitution to be at least above 80 or 90 points.
He had now reached this level!
It could be said that across several worlds, among billions of people, his constitution was among the top few standing at the pinnacle of the Pyramid!
It is an age-old truth that shallow waters cannot sustain a true dragon.
Yet, the appearance of a Dragon Heir in shallow water is also unlikely.

Across various dimensional worlds, only a few like Little Dragon Girl, Yang Guo, Feng Qingyang, Li Canghai, Wu Xingyun, Master Xiaoyao, Huang the Herbalist, Zhao Zilong, Lü Bu, Xiang Yu, Li Yuanba, Nie Feng, and Bu Jingyun could be considered Dragon Heirs!
The others were either ordinary people or extraordinary geniuses who were stronger than average individuals.
“Ordinary geniuses likely have a constitution around 10 points. 7 or 8 points are considered within this talented range, and there are many such geniuses.”
In contrast, extraordinary geniuses should have around 70 points.

There is a vast gap between ordinary geniuses and extraordinary geniuses. In between, there are extraordinary talents who are not as strong as extraordinary geniuses but much stronger than ordinary ones, including people like Wang Bodang and Cao Ang.
The extraordinary geniuses are Yuwen Chengdu, Long Qie, Dian Wei, and Xuu Chu.
Those surpassing extraordinary geniuses could be considered Dragon Heirs.
These Dragon Heirs.
As long as they step into the cultivation realm without any cultivation shackles, they will surely progress smoothly into the supreme realm.
“I should now be considered a Dragon Heir as well.”
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
[Glory Medal: 8]
Only 8 left.
There were indeed many things to purchase.
But Ding Ling was uninterested. Simply because his current Divine Weapons and Cultivation Techniques were extremely strong.
Although many Divine Weapons, Cultivation Techniques, and treasures were displayed on the new counter.
They were all very expensive.
He couldn’t afford the ones he wanted.
The affordable ones were far inferior to the Human Emperor Saber and Supreme Sword Pill, so he didn’t want to buy them, as they would be pure waste.
Earning Glory Medals is hard!
This time he earned so much entirely because he found a rare opportunity.
Not every world is like the Wind and Cloud Plane, with so many strong figures.
“Let’s buy another Storage Pouch.”
Ding Ling glanced over.
He discovered a Storage Ring and couldn’t help but take a closer look.
Genuine Storage Ring first tier: 40 E-level Achievement Medals, 20 D-level Achievement Medals, and 4 C-level Achievement Medals. Space of 100 cubic meters.
“Affordable.”
Ding Ling continued to look.
Storage Ring second tier: 80 E-level/40 D-level/8 C-level, with 200 cubic meters.
Third tier: 160 E-level, 80 D-level/16 C-level. 300 cubic meters.
Ding Ling checked his savings.
He could only afford the second-tier ring.
So he decisively bought it.
Swish!
Streams of light flew from Ding Ling, landing in the counter.
And from the counter, a ring flew out.
Ding Ling reached out to catch it and infused True Qi into it.
As expected.
This ring could be opened by infusing True Qi.
Of course.
Ding Ling’s Martial Arts True Qi far surpassed the True Qi of ordinary Martial Artists, and he didn’t know if others’ True Qi could open it, but as long as Martial Arts True Qi could, it was fine.
“200 cubic meters. The length, width, and height all close to six meters!”
This was a tremendously large space.
The size of a regular truck is: length 4.2/width 1.9/height 1.8.
This space could probably stack several trucks.
“Excellent.”
Ding Ling put the Storage Ring on his finger.
He originally had two Storage Pouches.
But he knew this time he would exchange for a large space Storage Pouch or other treasures again.
So he gave the other Storage Pouch to Little Zhao.
Now, besides the 200 cubic meter Storage Ring, he had an 8 cubic meter Storage Pouch.
Compared to the Storage Ring.
The Storage Pouch immediately seemed lacking.
Ding Ling took everything out of the Storage Pouch and put it into the Storage Ring.
He put the Storage Pouch in his arms, as it could later be given to Little Dragon Girl and others.
Thinking of this.
He glanced at the various treasures in the cabinet.
Truly, there was everything one could desire.
But the Secret Manuals and Divine Weapons he wanted were unaffordable.
As for the lesser Divine Weapons and Secret Manuals, they were far inferior to the Human Emperor Saber and Martial Dao True Understanding, so there was no need to buy them.
Moreover, he had learned most of these Secret Manuals!
Thinking of this, Ding Ling then bought a Tier Six Mortal Storage Pouch.
This Storage Pouch required 320 Ordinary Achievement Medals, 64 E-level Achievement Medals, with 32 cubic meters.
After buying it.
[Achievement Medals: Ordinary 209, E-level 129, D-level 155, C-level 7]
“These will be saved for next time.”
Ding Ling turned and stepped onto the Heaven-Reaching Dao leading to A Chinese Ghost Story World.
[Player is about to enter A Chinese Ghost Story Plane. Please prepare yourself.]
[Countdown.]
Boom!
Golden light like brocade rolled up Ding Ling along with two Qilin Horses, drawing them to the end of the path, breaking through dimensions, and sending them in.
The familiar dizziness hit.
Ding Ling widened his eyes, perceiving carefully.
Complete darkness, deathly silence.
Nothing could be sensed.
And this time it lasted longer and felt more oppressive and suffocating.
Ding Ling knew.
This was the transition from the Martial World to the Xianxia World.
The dimensional layers traversed were essentially different.
Thus.
It was unclear how much time had passed.
Suddenly, it brightened before him, and Ding Ling felt himself stepping onto solid ground. He quickly turned his head to look back but saw nothing.
Clearly, the black hole passage of transmission disappeared faster this time, already beyond his perception range.
“Where is this place?”
Instinctively, Ding Ling operated the Divine Meditation Technique.
To his surprise, in the Martial World, it could reflect several hundred miles, at the very least more than a hundred miles.
Here, it could only reflect around a thousand meters.
“The rules of this world are quite restrictive on a technique like the Divine Meditation Technique.”
Ding Ling pondered thoughtfully.
Every world’s rules differ.

Some worlds might not allow immortal cultivation, while others might not allow martial arts? It seems understandable that such a world would greatly suppress a technique like the Divine Meditation Technique.
Besides.
Ding Ling experimented a bit.
Discovering that this world was far more solid than the Martial World.
With his power, he could barely fly a hundred feet in the air. Sword Control could fly several hundred feet!
This was rather exaggerated.
“It seems each Xianxia world is interconnected. If this world is like this, the other Xianxia worlds are likely the same.”
Ding Ling didn’t think further, but slightly operated the Martial Dao True Understanding.
Whoosh!
Surging Spiritual Qi rushed over, instantly engulfing him.
[Inner Power Value +2]
[Inner Power Value +2]
His strength was soaring.

chapters.title: Chapter 873: A Chinese Ghost Story
paragraphs: “As expected. The level, quality, and concentration of spiritual vitality in this Xianxia World far surpass the Lower Realm!”
In the Lower Realm, even when Ding Ling rapidly operated the Martial Dao True Understanding, it was completely impossible to achieve such an effect.
But here, he achieved it with just a slight operation.
Besides the extremely rich spiritual vitality, it was also related to his enhanced physique, as he had become a Dragon Heir level genius.
At his level of genius, simply normal cultivation could naturally ascend to a supreme realm.
Moreover.
His Martial Dao True Understanding is already full level, and now he just needs the filling of spiritual vitality.
[Inner Power Value +3]
[Inner Power Value +3]
By slightly speeding up the operation, the efficiency of refining the rolling spiritual vitality increased even more.
“Very good.”
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
At this rate.
Perhaps it won’t take long.
He might ascend again.
“But where exactly is this place?”
Unleashing his Divine Meditation Technique, Ding Ling saw an area of a thousand meters around him vaguely reflected in his Sea of Consciousness.
Ding Ling could only roughly judge that this place was in a desolate wilderness.
A hundred meters away, there was a bumpy, muddy dirt road.
The dirt road snaked like a serpent, extending all the way into the unknown distance under the dim afterglow of dusk.
Ding Ling, in a flash, traveled more than ten meters, seeming to shrink the ground to inches, reaching the dirt road within a few breaths.
Without a doubt.
In this Xianxia World.
His ability to travel hundreds of miles in an instant had already disappeared.
This world was unimaginably sturdy; unless Ding Ling could break the void in the future, he might be able to travel hundreds of miles in an instant again.
Currently, that situation did not exist.
Simply put.
In the Lower Realm, Ding Ling was like in water, able to swim freely;
But here, he was like in glue, hardly able to walk, let alone swim!
Yet, even so, he could still travel ten or so meters in an instant.
This was evidently because his ‘technique’ in the Martial Dao True Understanding was extremely powerful, and he had reached the Half-Step Primordial Spirit Realm.
Neigh!
Roar!
Two Qilin Horses, almost as fast as Ding Ling, galloped over, neighing beside him with sounds reminiscent of dragon roars and tiger growls, startling the birds throughout the forest.

Their speed was purely due to their physique, and the Qilin Horses, with their physique rivaling Divine Beasts, unleashed their latent speed talents upon arriving in this world, greatly enhancing their abilities, with four flaming clouds underhoof, seemingly able to fly into the sky.
Ding Ling was extremely familiar with the Qilin Horses.
He went up to them, carefully sensing for a moment, and then relaxed.
Since the Qilin Horses relied purely on their physical talents for speed without depending on techniques and laws, their capabilities were neither suppressed nor reduced.
Ding Ling, however, relied primarily on techniques and laws in addition to his physique for speed.
“Looks like I can ride a horse in the future.”
With this in mind, Ding Ling glanced at the character panel.
[Character: Ding Ling
Age: 33
Race: Human
Faction: Late Eastern Han Dynasty World (Great Wei Kingdom)... World of Wind and Clouds (Great Ming Kingdom)
Profession: Late Eastern Han Dynasty World (First-Rank Prince)... World of Wind and Clouds (Emperor)
Level: 6 (Note: Congratulations on leveling up! Only qualifying levels...)
Strength: [Constitution 83, Intelligence 11.3, Power 160, Agility 160, Physique 160, Defense 160, Charm 13.1. True Power Value: 491 points]
Weapons: Xuanyuan Sword, Human Emperor Saber, Supreme Sword Pill, Divine Bow, a Divine Arrow...
Mount: Qilin Horse

Skills: Nine Tripod Pill Scripture, Celestial Escape Swordsmanship (Incomplete), Taiqing Pill Scripture, Nine Golden Liquid Gold, Astrology, Thunder and Lightning Control, Wind-and-Rain Summoning, Martial Dao True Understanding...]
[The Glory Road in A Chinese Ghost Story World has not been activated. Activate now?]
Yes.
[Activation successful!]
[Given the player’s choice of the Path of the War God. The Path of Glory in the War God will be reopened for the player!]

[The Path of the War God rule in this Plane World is as follows: 1: You must create the world’s number one sect of the last nearly hundred millennia in this Plane World! 2: You must defeat over twenty strong individuals in this Plane. The more you defeat, the more glory bonuses you receive. 3: ...]
The rules were almost identical to those in the previous Martial Arts Worlds.
The only difference.
Was the world’s number one sect point.
“To create the world’s number one sect of the last hundred millennia, wouldn’t that mean tracing back to the Ancient Era?”
Ding Ling pondered:
“It seems this world needs a selection of martial talents. Otherwise, how can it achieve the world’s number one sect?”
“Also, based on the pattern deduction, this task system is extremely simple; once a task is set, it almost never changes, which suggests that this task will exist in other Xianxia Worlds as well.”
Ding Ling thought:
“It looks like I must prepare in advance. Select and train more talents. So that after I complete the task, they can ascend together with me. By then, the sect won’t have to start from scratch!”
Fortunately, he was a martial arts myth, an emperor, a prince, a guardian god in the Lower Realm.
With countless followers.
When the time comes, he waves his arm, surely countless people would want to join his sect.
Thus.
He was not worried about recruiting disciples for the sect; what he contemplated was how to cultivate some loyal talents convenient to take to other worlds.
“It’s time to go.”
Suppressing his thoughts, Ding Ling leapt onto the horse’s back, randomly selected a direction, and galloped away.
In the process.
To avoid attracting attention.

Ding Ling used Stargazing Skill, mineral identification skills, Geomancy Skill, Divination Skill, and others to lock onto a vein, mined some iron ore, used the techniques of Martial Dao True Understanding to smelt the iron ore, and then applied the Forging Technique to craft two decent sets of harnesses.
He equipped the two Qilin Horses with the harnesses, concealing their brilliance.
With the harnesses on, they appeared much more ordinary.
If the harnesses are not removed, ordinary people would only see them as regular war horses.
“The extent of the sparse population here is beyond my imagination. No wonder it’s A Chinese Ghost Story World.”
Ding Ling had seen the movie A Chinese Ghost Story World.
It was in complete chaos.
Evil spirits ran rampant!
Fierce ghosts were rampant.
Even the Underworld was occupied by evil spirits, and the Human World Court was controlled by the so-called Centipede Spirit National Preceptor.
It was understandable that there was no crowing of roosters for miles, and white bones were exposed in the wilderness.
After crossing the wilderness and mountain paths, entering the plains, he could barely see some traces of life.
But without exception, their eyes seemed filled with gloom, dispiritedness, despair;
Only the infants in swaddling clothes, unversed in the world, untainted by worldly pollution, could look at this world with innocent and pure eyes.
As Ding Ling entered a village.
They watched him with wary, panicked, and confused eyes.
A trembling old man with a cane walked over to Ding Ling and said,
‘Honored army officer. The food of fifty households in our village was taken by other army officers yesterday. Now, the village truly has nothing to eat. Could you please spare us?’

2: You must defeat over twenty strong individuals in this Plane.
The more you defeat, the more glory bonuses you receive.
The rules were almost identical to those in the previous Martial Arts Worlds.
The only difference.
Was the world’s number one sect point.
“To create the world’s number one sect of the last hundred millennia, wouldn’t that mean tracing back to the Ancient Era?”
Ding Ling pondered:
“It seems this world needs a selection of martial talents.
Otherwise, how can it achieve the world’s number one sect?”
“Also, based on the pattern deduction, this task system is extremely simple; once a task is set, it almost never changes, which suggests that this task will exist in other Xianxia Worlds as well.”
Ding Ling thought:
“It looks like I must prepare in advance.
Select and train more talents.
So that after I complete the task, they can ascend together with me.
By then, the sect won’t have to start from scratch!”
Fortunately, he was a martial arts myth, an emperor, a prince, a guardian god in the Lower Realm.
With countless followers.
When the time comes, he waves his arm, surely countless people would want to join his sect.
Thus.
He was not worried about recruiting disciples for the sect; what he contemplated was how to cultivate some loyal talents convenient to take to other worlds.
“It’s time to go.”
Suppressing his thoughts, Ding Ling leapt onto the horse’s back, randomly selected a direction, and galloped away.
In the process.
To avoid attracting attention.

Ding Ling used Stargazing Skill, mineral identification skills, Geomancy Skill, Divination Skill, and others to lock onto a vein, mined some iron ore, used the techniques of Martial Dao True Understanding to smelt the iron ore, and then applied the Forging Technique to craft two decent sets of harnesses.
He equipped the two Qilin Horses with the harnesses, concealing their brilliance.
With the harnesses on, they appeared much more ordinary.
If the harnesses are not removed, ordinary people would only see them as regular war horses.
“The extent of the sparse population here is beyond my imagination.
No wonder it’s A Chinese Ghost Story World.”
Ding Ling had seen the movie A Chinese Ghost Story World.
It was in complete chaos.
Evil spirits ran rampant!
Fierce ghosts were rampant.
Even the Underworld was occupied by evil spirits, and the Human World Court was controlled by the so-called Centipede Spirit National Preceptor.
It was understandable that there was no crowing of roosters for miles, and white bones were exposed in the wilderness.
After crossing the wilderness and mountain paths, entering the plains, he could barely see some traces of life.
But without exception, their eyes seemed filled with gloom, dispiritedness, despair;
Only the infants in swaddling clothes, unversed in the world, untainted by worldly pollution, could look at this world with innocent and pure eyes.
As Ding Ling entered a village.
They watched him with wary, panicked, and confused eyes.
A trembling old man with a cane walked over to Ding Ling and said,
‘Honored army officer.
The food of fifty households in our village was taken by other army officers yesterday.
Now, the village truly has nothing to eat.
Could you please spare us?’

chapters.title: Chapter 874: Fu Qingfeng
paragraphs: Ding Ling was moved.
He couldn’t believe that the people here had reached the point where eating was a problem.
No.
They had nothing to eat at all!
He had already imagined the situation here to be terrible, but obviously some places, especially this village near the mountains, were extremely difficult.
Almost on the verge of extinction.

The Divine Meditation Technique of Ding Ling swept across, although unable to sense clearly, he could roughly see that out of the fifty households, their majority were children, elderly people, and women, seemingly not a single adult man.
Ding Ling inquired about the reason.
The elderly, on the verge of tears, said:

“Because we are near the mountains, we are often plundered by mountain bandits. And the soldiers who come to eliminate the bandits would also frequently come here to extort us. Not only that, both parties recruit men here. The able-bodied adult men were taken away, those who dared to refuse were killed. No one dares to resist.”
Ding Ling asked a few more questions.
He couldn’t help but sigh, understanding the root cause.
The court is corrupt.
Leading to Jiuzhou being filled with greedy, money-hungry individuals forever attempting to satisfy their insatiable desires.
These people are either selfish, murderous mountain bandits;
or county magistrates who extort the villagers;
or luxury-loving merchants who hoard goods.
or landlords who devour farmers’ lands.
And the village at hand can be said to be a reflection of the common people suffering under layers of exploitation!
From the pipe to see the leopard.
This world must have reached a crisis point.
To let the common people live a better life, to bring the world back on track, there must be great governance—a reconstruction of Heaven and Earth!
Therefore.

Faced with the sorrow, helplessness, and pity of the elderly, Ding Ling, while sighing, did not talk about eliminating bandits or killing corrupt officials, he simply went to the mountains and hunted some game for them, as a way to repay the elderly for his guidance and answers.
Because the elderly mentioned, Ding Ling now knew where he was.
After placing down the food, he chose to leave on horseback.
“Hero, may I know your esteemed name?”
The old man tried several times to keep Ding Ling, but since Ding Ling was determined to leave, he could only loudly ask for his name.

Behind him were a group of children and women, all looking at Ding Ling with disbelief, evidently unable to believe that such a clear current like Ding Ling could appear in this decaying, filthy, and murky world!
The elderly initially didn’t believe it, but when Ding Ling offered him food, he had to believe.
This world indeed has good people! Not everyone is a villain.
“Ding Ling.”
A name came from afar, leaving the elderly unable to come back to his senses for a long time.
Among the villagers were two women dressed as women, seeing Ding Ling about to leave, they couldn’t care less about being exposed and called out in haste:
“Hero Ding, Hero Ding, wait, wait!”
Their voices were melodious, like pearls dropping onto a jade plate, even like water flowing through the mountain spring, sweet to the depths of one’s soul.
Hearing this pleasant voice, Ding Ling was surprised.
In a village that suffers from such long-term plunder, are there still such women?
Would the bandits or soldiers let her go?!
With curiosity, Ding Ling instinctively turned his head to take a look, this glance made his eyes light up.
He saw two girls running toward him.
They wore simple and plain clothes, with their faces covered by a light veil.
But now the veil had been blown off by the wind as they ran so fast, revealing two remarkably beautiful faces!
In their rush to catch up with Ding Ling, they couldn’t care less about hiding themselves, only calling out hero.
Ding Ling pulled the reins to stop.
Whoosh!
The two young women rushed to the side of Ding Ling, panting heavily, eagerly saying:
“May I ask who Hero Ding studied under? Why is it so easy to capture tigers and deer?”
The two of them.
Both had refined brows and fine noses, cherry-like mouths, and bright intelligent eyes!
The older was as gentle as jade, like a lotus in the morning dew, indescribably lovely.
The younger was as pure as snow, like a spring flower in its first bloom.
Such two extraordinary beauties appeared in this rundown village.
Upon seeing them, Ding Ling felt surprised and more convinced that they were likely outsiders, and said:
“If you have something to say, just say it directly. No need to beat around the bush.”
The two young women looked at each other, still, the elder was bolder, took a step forward, cupped her hand towards Ding Ling solemnly:
“I am Fu Qingfeng.”
She pointed at the younger:

“This is my younger sister, Fu Yuechi. We are the daughters of Fu Tianchou, a former Minister of the Imperial Army. We were pursued by the imperial soldiers and had no choice but to hide in this mountain village temporarily. We originally planned to head to Kaifeng to seek help from masters in the sect, but unexpectedly encountered the hero here. Upon seeing the hero catch a tiger and deer for the villagers, we thought the hero must be a good person and wanted to seek your help to see if you could assist in saving our father.”
Saying this.
Fu Qingfeng blushed and nervously said:

“We know this seems reckless and rude. But the two of us sisters are truly in a helpless situation. Along our journey, we have mostly encountered unscrupulous people; such a kind-hearted person as Hero Ding is indeed rare. We couldn’t help but rush out, hoping to make your acquaintance and hoping you could help us. We would be eternally grateful!”
Ding Ling didn’t expect to meet Fu Qingfeng and Fu Yuechi here!
Moreover, Fu Qingfeng was so straightforward, she really said everything, Ding Ling used his Observing People Skill to assess Fu Yuechi and Fu Qingfeng, and knew their general disposition.
Needless to say.

Before Fu Tianchou was captured, they certainly were sheltered under his protection as a Minister of the Imperial Army, an absolute high-ranking official in the court, a High Tier presence at the pinnacle of the pyramid in this world, naturally having nothing to do with poverty or sorrow.
Also being of noble lineage.
Influenced by sights and sounds.
This nurtured their simple, kind-hearted, and straightforward nature.
Moreover, seeing their attire and the traces of weathering on their faces, it is evident they endured many hardships to avoid pursuers.

If not, even in their straightforwardness, being a young lady of high status, surely there would be times of arrogance, but now Ding Ling saw no arrogance in them, as if the cruel reality had smoothed those edges.

chapters.title: Chapter 875: Kneel
paragraphs: However, Ding Ling couldn’t interfere just because they were loyalists’ descendants, so after a brief look, he calmly said:
“You’ve found the wrong person.”
After speaking.
Ding Ling was about to leave.
Fu Qingfeng bit her lip, opened her arms, and blocked the Qilin Horse, loudly saying:

“Hero Ding. Although we are somewhat naive, we’ve wandered the Jianghu for over two months. We’ve seen too much separation and death, brutality and ugliness. People like Hero Ding are truly rare. We definitely haven’t found the wrong person.”
With a thud!
She directly knelt before Ding Ling, her apricot eyes slightly red, choking up:
“If there were another option, we wouldn’t want to trouble Hero Ding.”
Seeing her sister kneel, Fu Yuechi hurriedly knelt down too, saying crisply:

“Hero Ding. My sister is right. We haven’t eaten anything for two days. We are starving. And we are being pursued by soldiers who are searching and wandering around. If we don’t find shelter, it’s hard to escape from here, not to mention going to Kaifeng. Please, pity us.”
As if to prove her point.
As soon as her words landed. Grumble, grumble!
Her stomach started growling, indeed she was very hungry.
Ding Ling glanced sideways, seeing the sisters with tearful eyes, pitiful and touching, he couldn’t help but feel compassion. Thinking of several tasks, he pondered:

“In this world, I must establish the world’s number one sect and cultivate talent. These two sisters have eyes full of spiritual light, suggesting they have good roots. Just not sure about their bone structure.”
Thinking of this.
He jumped off the horse and personally stepped forward to help the sisters stand.
During the support process.
The True Qi of Martial Dao True Understanding activated, quickly detecting their bone attributes.
Each surprisingly reaching at least around 79 points of bone structure.
Just a bit short of being a Dragon Heir!
Absolutely exceptional talent.
Especially Fu Qingfeng, who was infinitely close to 80 points, just short of a chance to break through 80 points of bone structure. Becoming someone of Dragon Heir level!
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows.
Thinking these two are undoubtedly major Qi Fortune figures from the A Chinese Ghost Story Plane, he pointed to another Qilin Horse, saying:
“You may ride the horse first.”
“Hero Ding agreed?!”
Fu Qingfeng and Fu Yuechi were overjoyed.
They had already reached the Extreme Realm, if they didn’t make a plan to escape this Earth Realm, even if not caught and taken to the Capital City, they would probably be half-starved.
But how to get out?
They were also worried.
Ding Ling’s arrival was like a ray of light shining into the depths of their helpless hearts!
During these months! It was the first time they saw a man with high martial power, willing to be kind to the people!
Moreover, after seeing their appearance, his gaze remained clear without any evil thoughts, truly rare!
This further solidified their previous view of Ding Ling: he was a good person!
In distress, Ding Ling seemed like hope, like a straw to save a drowning person, how could they bear to let go?
This was the reason why they decisively knelt to seek help!
The sisters, albeit naive, have seen many men during their wandering months, what kind haven’t they encountered?
Not saying they’re born with Eyes of Golden Flame, but they definitely know how to discern good and evil!
“Let’s talk while we walk.”
Ding Ling leapt back onto the horse, glanced at them, and said:
“If you want to follow, be quick about it.”
“Yes, yes, yes.”

The sisters wiped their red eyes, nodded repeatedly with their delicate heads, extremely delighted, and immediately they mounted the Qilin Horse, with Fu Qingfeng holding the reins controlling the horse.

Initially controlling the horse, Fu Qingfeng sensed the Qilin Horse’s uniqueness, secretly amazed, considering Ding Ling must be from a distinguished family or an expert, otherwise, how could he obtain such two unparalleled horses?
Towards Ding Ling.

Fu Qingfeng and Fu Yuechi were extremely curious, knowing that this place, plagued with bandits year-round, rarely had visitors, how could Ding Ling dare to boldly enter here alone, not afraid of being killed by bandits?
Curious, they asked about this.
Ding Ling didn’t reply, but instead asked numerous questions.
When Ding Ling learned that over the years, a lot of Great Medicine had been sent to the Royal Pharmacy in the Capital City and Chang’an, his mind stirred, having an idea:
“We’ll detour to the Capital City.”
“Not going to Kaifeng?”
The sisters were stunned:
“Our sect is there. We can find many helpers. With this, rescuing our father is more assured.”
“Where is your father imprisoned?”
“In Chang’an.”
“You’ve run quite far.”
This is in the northern Taiyuan.
“No choice. The court seems to know our connections, blocking all paths south. We can only flee north.”
Fu Qingfeng’s expression darkened:
“In the course of fleeing, our guards have died or been crippled, to the point now it’s only us two sisters left. If it weren’t for Hero Ding’s arrival, we wouldn’t know how long we could hold out.”
Yet Ding Ling knew these two would eventually escape from here safely and proceed to Kaifeng for reinforcements.
Though he didn’t know how they escaped, it seemed they had gone through a thrilling ordeal and hardship.
However, his arrival.
Will completely reverse this situation, the storyline’s collapse will start with him.
“Then we’ll first head to Chang’an. Then to the Capital City.”
“Just Hero Ding alone?”
Fu Qingfeng hesitated for a while, eventually speaking:

“Seeing Hero Ding capture fierce beasts like tigers without much effort as if it were nothing, one must think he has a distinguished background; if Hero Ding could summon more reinforcements, the chances would be even greater.”
Fu Yuechi nodded vigorously behind Fu Qingfeng, her big eyes staring intently at Ding Ling.
Both were very curious about Ding Ling’s background.
But since Ding Ling wouldn’t say, they couldn’t force him.
The three conversed along the way.
Learning more about each other.
Of course, for the sisters, the more they conversed, Ding Ling appeared more mysterious and unpredictable in their eyes.
Because Ding Ling remained calm and unflustered throughout—all calm even when the skies fell—he was even the same when discussing the Grand National Preceptor Pudu Cihang, who held sway over all.
The sisters were uncertain and intrigued.
But as their interactions deepened.
Their admiration for Ding Ling grew stronger.
Ding Ling seemed like an omnipotent king, knowledgeable of astronomy and geography, cooking, hunting, Feng Shui, astrology... seemingly capable of anything.
With Ding Ling present.
In these few months, they ate their first meal full of color, aroma, and flavor.
The sisters touched their round bellies, shy yet happy, they swore—growing up, it was truly their first time eating such delicious barbecue!
This truly couldn’t blame them for devouring ravenously, nor criticize them for not being ladylike; it was really because Ding Ling’s cooking was too delicious!
Anyone would inevitably indulge!

They felt that they could never forget Ding Ling and this ‘meal’ for the rest of their lives.
Extremely memorable!
“Let’s go.”
Ding Ling saw that they were full, and then prepared to mount the horse again and hit the road, but unexpectedly, just at this moment, clop clop clop!
Accompanied by a series of hoofbeats, a large cavalry force suddenly appeared on the road ahead.
They galloped with whips, rushing forward, roughly estimated at no less than two hundred people.

The leader carried two swords on his back, his face sinister and evil. Upon seeing Ding Ling and the two women, his eyes lit up, and he couldn’t help but glance at Fu Qingfeng and Fu Yuechi, then laughed heartily:
“Truly, it’s like breaking iron shoes searching nowhere but easily coming by chance! Fu Qingfeng, Fu Yuechi. You two maidens are really good at hiding, it’s been two months. Finally, I’ve found you!”
“Qi Mingyu!”
Fu Qingfeng’s complexion slightly changed:
“Isn’t this area under Left Thousand Households Officer’s jurisdiction? Why are you here?!”
“Haha...”
Qi Mingyu drew the two swords from his back, holding one in each hand.

He seemed extremely excited, his eyes wantonly gazing at the two sisters, clearly confident in capturing them, never once paying attention to Ding Ling, more so never facing Ding Ling directly, solely fixating on the sisters and said:

“There’s no harm in telling you, Left Thousand Households Officer went to slaughter mountain bandits. Hehe, nowadays, Jiuzhou is plagued with bandits everywhere, killing a batch leads to another, incessant, how could it be completely eradicated, Left Thousand Households Officer is too foolish, giving this credit to me. Naturally, I won’t be polite.”
He hummed coldly, pointing his sword at Fu Qingfeng and Fu Yuechi:
“Ladies, if you are sensible, cooperate obediently with me. Otherwise, if I become heavy-handed, leaving you crippled, that would be too unpleasant.”
“My father is one of the few righteous and resolute men in the world! You clearly know he’s a loyal minister, why still capture him? Even wishing to annihilate us completely!”
Fu Qingfeng angrily questioned in grief!
With her hands secretly signaling frantically to Ding Ling to escape quickly.
Clearly, she also didn’t believe the three of them could defeat the two hundred Embroidered Guards opposite them!
Fu Yuechi even retracted her tense round belly, pressing her hand on the sword hilt with a cautious face, watching Qi Mingyu with vigilance.
“Don’t think about escaping.”
Qi Mingyu saw through Fu Qingfeng’s little actions completely:
“Two months of fleeing, it seems you’ve become much smarter, knowing what to do in public and in private. If it were months ago, you would frankly reveal your father’s whereabouts.”
He sighed:
“Indeed, adversities are most likely to foster personal growth.”
He jumped off the horse, twirling his swords, staring directly at the two women:

“Have you made up your mind? If you surrender obediently, I won’t bind or mistreat you. In fact, I can willingly take you in, allowing you to become my concubines, exempting the label of being guilty officials. You know, my father is the Minister of Revenue. I possess such capability.”
“Bah.”
Fu Qingfeng blushed, angered and ashamed:
“Don’t even think about it!”
Fu Yuechi also rebuked: “Shameless!”
“Alas.”
Qi Mingyu shook his head:
“Truly, you refuse the good offer and demand punishment. But I actually like your fiery nature, I like to subdue fierce women like you.”
He walked towards the two women with an evil smile, his long sword slicing the void creating shadows:
“Come on, let me witness your prowess. It’s rumored you’re the descendants of the Sword Birth Sect. I’m curious about how quick your swords can be.”
Before he could finish speaking.

He had already leaped up three zhang high, in mid-air, his double swords flowing down, fiercely slashing downward, in an instant generating overwhelming sword lights and sword qi in the void, sword qi and sword lights converging into smoke, transforming into mist, slashing towards Ding Ling and the two others like a flowing sheet.
Seemingly intending to severely injure the three of them in an instant.
Especially as ninety percent of the sword qi transformed into mist, all shrouded towards Ding Ling.
Clearly, Qi Mingyu intended to first kill Ding Ling, then slowly torment and play with Fu Qingfeng and Fu Yuechi.
Yet he didn’t know, he provoked the wrong person.
Amid Fu Qingfeng and Fu Yuechi’s exclamation, ‘Hero Ding be careful!’
Ding Ling casually struck out with a palm!
Heaven-Flipping Palm!
All Things Return to Void!

With a single palm strike, a massive Chaos Hand Seal condensed in the void, as it passed, it seemed to crush everything, more like Wind-Rolling Clouds, in an instant the sky full of sword lights and sword qi were covered and annihilated.
Then in Qi Mingyu’s shocked and stunned expression, Bang!
His entire body was struck by the hand seal!
Afterward, he knew nothing, only vaguely felt as if he was completely shattered into ashes by this palm!
“Too terrifying!”
“I am anyhow a generation of Martial Arts Grandmaster! Among the top experts in the imperial court! How could I be easily killed with a single slap by him!”
“How can such a pretty boy be so powerful?!”
“Such a figure, even Left Thousand Households Officer, this arrogant character, is far inferior! How did those two harlots Fu Qingfeng and Fu Yuechi find such a reliance?!”
Qi Mingyu was utterly eradicated with complete bewilderment, regret, and frustration.
Fu Yuechi and Fu Qingfeng saw Qi Mingyu under the moonlight and firelight, being slapped into broken mud and were stunned, in disbelief, after several confirmations it wasn’t a hallucination.
The two couldn’t help but shiver.
Yet feeling excited, happy, and struck to the extreme while also somewhat dismayed.
Only because after Ding Ling slapped Qi Mingyu to death, there wasn’t the slightest emotional fluctuation, as if just now what he killed wasn’t a person! But a fly!
Such expressions and actions seemed like those who walked out from a sea of blood!
Otherwise, how could ordinary people reach this level!
“Who exactly is Hero Ding?!”
“Who is the master? Who are the family members? Did he really kill so many that he now kills without batting an eye? Or is he just aloof? Cold-faced?”
Fu Qingfeng and Fu Yuechi’s minds were in a tumult.
They knew Ding Ling was strong, otherwise they wouldn’t have begged him for help.
But they truly didn’t expect Ding Ling would be this strong!!
Extremely terrifying!
Bang bang bang!
Once Ding Ling had the intention to kill, it was hard to stop.
He casually struck towards the direction of the Embroidered Guards with a palm, and upon hearing the loud boom, two hundred Embroidered Guards were instantly slapped to death!
Those who cunningly fled far were easily executed by a casual Finger Sword from him.
Effortlessly obliterating strong enemies!
Two hundred grandmaster-level Embroidered Guards, died just like that?!
Fu Qingfeng and Fu Yuechi just recovering from the shock of Qi Mingyu’s death, and witnessing this scene again, couldn’t help but fall into a stupor once more.
The two sisters were dumbfounded, blankly staring at the brutal scene ahead.
Even under the moonlit night.
The scattered corpses and blood were especially vivid, chilling!!”

chapters.title: Chapter 877: Celestial Smoke Saber Technique Full Level
paragraphs: [Obtained D-level Achievement Medal: Intimidating Qi Mingyu.]
[Obtained Achievement Medal: Intimidating Fu Yuechi.]
[Obtained Achievement Medal: Intimidating Fu Qingfeng.]
[Note: Your decisive and powerful hand gestures completely stunned everyone present!]
Previously, two E-level High Recognition Medals had already been gained from Fu Yuechi and Fu Qingfeng.
Gained again.
Just an ordinary achievement medal now.
The two women also possessed cultivation, with Fu Qingfeng being a Grandmaster Level Martial Arts Expert. Fu Yuechi was slightly inferior, but had also reached Innate Perfection!
The spiritual qi of this world is too abundant, and its quality is far superior to the lower realm many times over!
Therefore, as long as one is willing to put in hard work and has a decent cultivation technique inheritance, anyone can cultivate to the Innate Realm!
Not to mention that both Fu Qingfeng and Fu Yuechi have qualifications close to the Dragon Heir level.
If the two women had been practicing diligently for over ten years, it would be impossible for them to just be at Innate Perfection and Initial Tier Grandmaster.
Clearly, they lived too comfortably in the past and did not practice hard.
Perhaps Fu Qingfeng mustered the Grandmaster Realm due to the relentless pursuit and diligent practice over the couple of months.
Who knows.

Ding Ling did not ask much, but as he used Divine Meditation Technique to clear the battlefield, he discovered something unusual from one side of a war horse, and floated up to grab the package from the horse’s side and opened it.
Inside were several secret manuals.
He quickly flipped them open and read through them.
[Celestial Smoke Saber Technique Internal Power Heart Method Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +300]
[Celestial Smoke Saber Technique External Heart Method Full Level]
[Strength +0.6]
[Agility +0.6]
[Constitution +0.6]
This is a technique with inner and outer dual cultivation at the Shattering Level.
It’s a divine skill that can be cultivated to the utmost extent to easily crush opponent’s bodies with saber qi.
It was precisely the sword skill previously used by Qi Mingyu.
In an instant, Celestial Smoke Saber Technique reached full level.
Ding Ling realized this.
He also browsed through the other secret manuals.
[Green Blood Swordsmanship Internal Power Heart Method Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +300]
[Green Blood Swordsmanship External Heart Method Full Level]
[Strength +0.5]
[Agility +0.5]
[Constitution +0.5]
This is a sword technique slightly inferior to Celestial Smoke Saber Technique.
It belongs to the exclusive sword technique of the Embroidered Guard.
Only the Thousand-Household Officer of the Embroidered Guard would be equipped with a complete heart method manual.
And the Qi Mingyu just slain was certainly among the Thousand-Household Officers of the Embroidered Guard.
And the war horse was just his mount; he was slain but his mount wasn’t dead, allowing Ding Ling to obtain some secret manuals.
[True Power Value: 493]
Along with two divine skills reaching full level, Ding Ling’s True Power Value increased by 2 points again.
He felt himself moving a step closer to the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit Realm.
Physical quality also increased significantly, with growth in speed, life, recovery, and endurance among other aspects.
And all this happened at an extremely fast pace.
Fu Qingfeng and Fu Yuechi looked at Ding Ling in disbelief.
What did they just witness?!
Ding Ling merely glanced over the secret manuals of Celestial Smoke Saber Technique and Green Blood Swordsmanship, and then endless spiritual qi surged towards Ding Ling, overwhelming him.
“Is this the celestial phenomenon that appears at Divine Skill Great Perfection?!”
“Gasp!”
The two women gasped in shock.
At this moment, they understood why Ding Ling, seemingly only seventeen or eighteen years old, possesses such formidable offensive power.!
It turns out Ding Ling is actually a super invincible peerless genius!
“Let’s go.”
Ding Ling casually stored the secret manuals in the package and placed it on the side of the Qilin Horse’s belly.
He mounted the horse and looked at the two women:
“Shall we go?”
“Go, go, go.”
The women snapped out of it and hurriedly mounted their horses.
Before long.
The three of them rode away from the place.

On the way, the two women gradually recovered from their state of shock. After all, they weren’t newcomers inexperienced in Jianghu; two months of brutal ordeal had deeply embedded an understanding of the hardships of the world, and upon realizing Ding Ling had only killed villains, their attitude subtly changed.
Their recognition of Ding Ling rose again.
This time, there was a sense of admiration and worship amidst the acknowledgment!
Just like little girls seeing their idol, the intense gaze seemed capable of melting Ding Ling.
“Hero Ding, have you always been this talented since childhood?”

Fu Yuechi, looking around sixteen or seventeen, was more naive and straightforward, and after exchanging a few words with Ding Ling and finding him still easy-going, she relaxed and her courage increased a bit, then asked:
“Your martial arts practice speed is truly fast!”
“Haha.”
Ding Ling laughed without speaking, and instead asked:
“Do you want to learn Celestial Smoke Saber Technique or Green Blood Swordsmanship? If you want to learn, I can give you the secret manuals.”
“That’s not appropriate.”
The two women hesitated:
“Unrewarded without merit.”
“Don’t you want me to rescue your father? Compared to that matter, what’s reading a secret manual count as?”
The two women thought it over and blushed. At this moment, they suddenly realized that if Ding Ling truly rescues their father, they’d have no way to repay him!
They hadn’t considered this before.
Because they hoped Ding Ling could help them escape the encirclement and head to Kaifeng for reinforcements.
Now, seeing Ding Ling’s exceptional combat skills, they completely believed that Ding Ling might possibly save their father alone!
If that’s the case.
How would they repay such kindness?!
With this thought.
The two women felt confused and helpless.
Ding Ling noticed this but didn’t ask. Instead, he tossed the package over.
Fu Yuechi caught it clumsily, unsure how to respond:
“This, this, I, Hero Ding...”
“It’s indeed a bit embarrassing. You might as well share the Sword Birth Sect’s techniques with me.”
“This...”
The two women exchanged glances, and eventually Fu Qingfeng nodded and said:
“Alright. We are direct lineage closed-door disciples of the Sword Birth Sect. We have the rights to teach the techniques. Hero Ding, would you mind if we dismount and practice here?”
“Alright.”
The moon was high.
The three, along with two horses, were far from their previous killing site.
Fu Qingfeng dismounted from the horse.
And began discussing the heart method mantra of Sword Birth Sect.

At the same time, she drew her sword and practiced the moves carefully, without adding unnecessary explanations. After witnessing Ding Ling instantly mastering the exclusive Green Blood Swordsmanship of the Embroidered Guard, she understood Ding Ling’s brilliance and naturally didn’t bother with redundant remarks.
Moments later.
She completed her practice.
[Cloud Sea Swordsmanship Internal Power Heart Method Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +300]
[Cloud Sea Swordsmanship External Heart Method Full Level]
[Strength +0.6]
[Agility +0.6]
[Constitution +0.6]
This is a top-tier sword technique entirely on par with Celestial Smoke Saber Technique.
It is a law that can be cultivated to Shattering Great Perfection.
After instantly reaching full level.
A cloud-like sword qi naturally emanated from Ding Ling.
Fu Qingfeng and Fu Yuechi understood, their hearts trembling, filled with shock.
